Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.

sanctorale.02-05.title: Santu Agata, Virgo na Martir
sanctorale.02-05.collect:
Lord, yu bin amamas long pasin bilong Santu Agata,
em i Virgo na Martir bilong yu.
Long wanem, em i bin sanap strong long taim bilong dai,
na oltaim em i bin bihainim klinpela pasin.
Mipela i askim yu, bai pre bilong em i ken helpim mipela
long kisim marimari bilong yu.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.02-05.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Martir: bilong wanpela Virgo Martir (p. 885). O Misa bilong ol Virgo: bilong wanpela Virgo (p. 910).

sanctorale.02-06.title: Santu Pol Miki, Wantaim ol Lain Martir bilong Siapan
sanctorale.02-06.collect:
God, yu strong bilong ol Santu.
Yu bin singautim Martir Santu Pol na ol lain bilong em
long bihainim rot bilong Diwai Kros.
Na long dispela rot, ol i bin kisim laip bilong oltaim.
Mipela i askim yu, bai pre bilong ol i ken helpim mipela
long holim strong bilip bilong mipela inap long indai.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.02-06.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Martir: bilong planti Martir (p. 865).

sanctorale.02-08.title: Santu Jerom Emiliani
sanctorale.02-08.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Santu Manmeri: bilong ol Tisa (p. 928).
sanctorale.02-08.collect:
God, yu Papa bilong marimari,
yu bin singautim Santu Jerom
bilong kamap helpim na papa bilong ol pikinini
i no gat papamama.
Mipela i askim yu, harim ol pre bilong em,
na helpim mipela long wokabaut oltaim
olsem trupela pikinini bilong yu.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.

sanctorale.02-10.title: Santu Skolastika, Virgo
sanctorale.02-10.collect:
Lord, tude mipela i tingim Virgo Santu Skolastika.
Mipela i pre, bai mipela i ken bihainim pasin bilong em,
na mekim wok bilong yu wantaim klinpela hat.
Olsem na mipela tu bai inap long kisim dispela gutpela pe
yu save givim long ol manmeri i laikim yu.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.02-10.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Virgo: bilong wanpela Virgo (p. 910). O Misa bilong ol Santu Manmeri: bilong wanpela Sista (p. 923).

sanctorale.02-11.title: Santu Maria Virgo bilong Lourdes
sanctorale.02-11.collect:
God bilong marimari,
yu save lukautim ol manmeri i no gat strong.
Tude mipela i tingim Santu Maria,
em i Mama bilong God na em i Klin Olgeta.
Mipela i askim yu, bai pre bilong em i ken helpim mipela
long kirap bek taim mipela i pundaun long sin.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.

sanctorale.02-14.title: Santu Siril, Monk, na Metodius, Bisop

entrance.text:
Ol dispela man holi i bin kamap pren bilong God, ol i bin autim tok tru
bilong em, na ol i bin kisim biknem.

sanctorale.02-14.collect:
God, long wok bilong tupela brata Santu Siril na Metodius,
yu bin bringim lait bilong Gutnius
long ol lain manmeri bilong Isten Yurop.
Helpim mipela, bai mipela i ken holim olgeta tok bilong yu
insait long hat bilong mipela.
Olsem na bai mipela i ken kamap wanpela lain pipel
i bung long trupela bilip na long wanpela lotu tasol.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.02-14.offerings:
Lord, tude mipela i tingim Santu Siril na Metodius,
na mipela i bringim dispela ofa i kam long ai bilong yu.
Mipela i pre, lukdaun long dispela ofa,
na mekim em i kamap olsem mak
bilong nupela wokabaut bilong mipela.
Long wanem, yu bin mekim mipela i kamap wanbel wantaim yu
long laikim pasin bilong yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Ol disaipel i bin i go na autim Gutnius. Na Bikpela i bin wok wantaim
ol, na em i bin mekim ol mirakel i kamap bilong strongim tok bilong ol.

sanctorale.02-14.postcommunion:
God, yu Papa bilong olgeta lain manmeri.
Yu bin bungim mipela long wanpela Bret
na long wanpela Spirit,
na yu bin promis long bringim mipela long kaikai bilong oltaim.
Tude mipela i tingim Santu Siril na Metodius,
na mipela i pre, bai olgeta pikinini bilong yu
i ken holim strong wanpela bilip tasol, na ol i ken wok wantaim
bilong kamapim Kingdom bilong stretpela pasin na bel isi.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.02-17.title: Ol Sevenpela Santu i bin Kirapim Orda bilong ol Servait
sanctorale.02-17.collect:
Lord, ol Sevenpela Santu Brata
i bin givim ol yet olgeta long Mama bilong God,
na ol i bin mekim wok bilong bringim pipel bilong yu
i kam bek long yu.
Mipela i askim yu, givim dispela kain laik long mipela tu,
na helpim mipela long mekim wok bilong yu oltaim.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.02-17.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Santu Manmeri: bilong ol Relijis (p. 924).

sanctorale.02-21.title: Santu Pita Damian, Bisop na Tisa bilong Sios
sanctorale.02-21.collect:
God, yu strong olgeta,
Bisop Santu Pita i bin laikim Krais
moa long olgeta arapela samting,
na em i bin wok hat bilong helpim Sios bilong yu.
Mipela i pre, helpim mipela
long bihainim skul na pasin bilong em,
bai mipela tu i ken kamap long amamas bilong oltaim.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.02-21.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Tisa bilong Sios (p. 906). O Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong wanpela Bisop (p. 890).

sanctorale.02-22.title: SIA BILONG SANTU PITA, APOSEL

entrance.text:
Bikpela i tokim Saimon Pita olsem, “Mi pre pinis bilong helpim yu, bai
bilip bilong yu i no ken pundaun. Na taim yu tanim na yu kam bek,
orait, yu mas strongim ol brata bilong yu.”
I gat Ona long God i stap antap.

sanctorale.02-22.collect:
God, yu strong olgeta,
bilip bilong Aposel Pita em i strong olsem wanpela ston.
Na yu bin mekim mipela i holim dispela bilip.
Mipela i pre, lukautim mipela oltaim,
bai i no gat wanpela samting i ken paulim bilip bilong mipela.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.02-22.offerings:
Lord, Santu Pita em i wasman bilong Sios,
na bilip bilong Sios i kam long skul bilong Pita.
Mipela i askim yu, kisim ol pre na ofa bilong Sios bilong yu,
na bringim em i go long laip bilong oltaim.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Pita i tokim Jisas olsem, “Yu Krais, yu Pikinini bilong God i gat laip.”
Na Jisas i bekim tok long em olsem, “Yu Pita, na bai mi wokim Sios
bilong mi antap long dispela ston.”

sanctorale.02-22.postcommunion:
God, mipela i bin selebretim pestode
bilong Aposel Santu Pita,
na yu bin strongim mipela long Bodi na Blut bilong Krais.
Mipela i pre, bai dispela Sakramen i ken mekim mipela
i stap wan long bilip, na i ken strongim bel isi bilong mipela.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.02-23.title: Santu Polikap, Bisop na Martir
sanctorale.02-23.collect:
God, yu Papa bilong olgeta samting.
Yu bin makim Bisop Santu Polikap
bilong joinim ol lain bilong ol Martir.
Mipela i askim yu, bai pre bilong em i ken helpim mipela
long dring long kap bilong Krais,
na bihain Holi Spirit i ken kirapim mipela long laip bilong oltaim.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.02-23.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Martir: bilong wanpela Martir (p. 874). O Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong wanpela Bisop (p. 890).

sanctorale.02-27.title: Santu Gregori bilong Narek, Abbot na Tisa bilong Sios
sanctorale.02-27.collect:
God, yu strong olgeta na yu stap oltaim.
Yu bin pulapim Santu Gregori long gutpela save
bilong ol samting bilong heven.
Na yu bin mekim em i kamap tisa na stia
bilong ol manmeri bilong kantri Armenia.
Mipela i pre, bai ol skul bilong em i ken helpim mipela
long save gut long toktok wantaim yu,
na long kisim strong long ol Sakramen bilong Sios.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.02-27.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Tisa bilong Sios (p. 906). O Misa bilong ol Santu Manmeri: bilong wanpela Abbot (p. 921).

sanctorale.03-04.title: Santu Kasimir
sanctorale.03-04.collect:
God, yu strong olgeta, man o meri i mekim wok bilong yu
bai i stap king wantaim yu.
Mipela i askim yu, harim pre bilong Santu Kasimir,
na helpim mipela long mekim wok bilong yu
wantaim pasin holi na pasin i stret.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.03-04.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Santu Manmeri: bilong wanpela Santu (p. 919).

sanctorale.03-07.title: Santu Perpetua na Felisiti, Martir

entrance.text:
Sol bilong ol Santu i amamas long heven. Ol Santu i bin laikim Krais
tru, na ol i bin bihainim lek mak bilong em, na i kapsaitim blut bilong
ol. Olsem na nau ol i singaut amamas wantaim Krais inap oltaim.

sanctorale.03-07.collect:
God, tupela Martir Santu Perpetua na Felisiti i bin laikim yu tru,
olsem na tupela i no bin pret long karim pen na i dai.
Mipela i askim yu, bai pre bilong tupela i ken helpim mipela
long kamap strong long pasin bilong laikim yu.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.03-07.offerings:
Lord, tude mipela i tingim Santu Perpetua na Felisiti
i bin win long indai na i go long heven.
Olsem na mipela i amamas long ofarim dispela sakrifais long yu.
Mipela i pre, bai oltaim mipela i ken tokaut long ol wok bilong yu,
na mipela i ken amamas long pre bilong tupela
i save helpim mipela.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Mipela i givim witnes long Jisas, na ol man i laik kilim mipela i dai.
Olsem na laip bilong Jisas i mas kamap ples klia long bodi bilong mipela.

sanctorale.03-07.postcommunion:
Lord, mipela i tingim Santu Perpetua na Felisiti,
na mipela i kisim amamas bilong oltaim long dispela Sakramen.
Mipela i pre, bai dispela presen bilong yu i ken helpim mipela
long luksave long ol gutpela samting yu save givim long mipela.
Olsem na bai mipela i ken soim amamas bilong mipela
long ol gutpela pasin bilong mipela.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.03-08.title: Santu Jon bilong God, Relijis
sanctorale.03-08.collect:
God, yu bin pulapim Santu Jon bilong God
long spirit bilong marimari.
Mipela i pre, bai mipela tu i ken mekim planti wok marimari,
na wanpela de mipela tu i ken kamap long Kingdom bilong yu
wantaim ol manmeri yu bin makim pinis.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.03-08.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Santu Manmeri: bilong ol Relijis (p. 924). O Misa bilong ol Santu Manmeri: bilong ol manmeri i bin mekim wok marimari (p. 927).

sanctorale.03-09.title: Santu Franses bilong Rom, Relijis
sanctorale.03-09.collect:
God, yu bin givim Santu Franses long mipela,
na em i bin soim gutpela pasin long mipela
taim em i stap marit, na taim em i stap sista.
Mipela i pre, helpim mipela long mekim wok bilong yu
wantaim olgeta strong bilong mipela, na long bihainim yu oltaim.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.03-09.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Santu Manmeri: bilong ol Santu Meri (p. 930). O Misa bilong ol Santu Manmeri: bilong ol Relijis (p. 924).

sanctorale.03-17.title: Santu Petrik, Bisop
sanctorale.03-17.collect:
God, yu bin makim Bisop Santu Petrik,
bai em i ken tokaut long ol bikpela wok bilong yu
long ol pipel bilong kantri Ailen.
Mipela i askim yu,
bai pre bilong em na ol gutpela pasin bilong em,
i ken helpim olgeta Kristen manmeri
long tokaut oltaim long ol bikpela wok
yu save mekim bilong helpim ol.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.03-17.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong wanpela Misinari (p. 902). O Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong wanpela Bisop (p. 890).

sanctorale.03-18.title: Santu Siril bilong Jerusalem, Bisop na Tisa bilong Sios
sanctorale.03-18.collect:
God, long wok bilong Bisop Santu Siril,
yu bin skulim Sios bilong yu long ol gutpela samting
yu bin mekim bilong kisim bek mipela.
Mipela i askim yu, harim pre bilong em,
na helpim mipela long save gut long Pikinini bilong yu,
bai mipela i ken kisim laip bilong oltaim.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.03-18.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong wanpela Bisop (p. 890). O Misa bilong ol Tisa bilong Sios (p. 906).

sanctorale.03-19.title: SANTU JOSEP, MAN BILONG SANTU MARIA VIRGO

entrance.text:
Em hia wanpela gutpela wokman, na em i gat gutpela tingting. Olsem
na Bikpela i bin makim em bilong lukautim famili bilong em.
I gat Ona long God i stap antap na Tok Bilip.

sanctorale.03-19.collect:
God, yu strong olgeta,
Pikinini bilong yu i bin kam long graun
bilong kisim bek olgeta manmeri.
Na yu bin makim Santu Josep
bilong was long em na lukautim em.
Mipela i askim yu, bai pre bilong Santu Josep
i ken helpim Sios bilong yu long wok oltaim
bilong inapim gut dispela wok bilong kisim bek olgeta manmeri.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.03-19.offerings:
Lord, Santu Maria Virgo i bin karim Pikinini bilong yu,
na Santu Josep i bin laikim em tru na lukautim em.
Mipela i pre, bai hat bilong mipela i ken klin oltaim,
olsem na wok bilong mipela long dispela alta hia
i ken kamap stret long ai bilong yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.
sanctorale.03-19.prefaceText:
Tru, em i gutpela na i stret,
oltaim na long olgeta ples,
mipela i tenkim yu, Lord, yu Papa na yu holi tru,
yu strong olgeta na yu God bilong oltaim.
Givim tenkyu long yu em i wok bilong mipela,
na em i kisim bek mipela.
Mipela i mas singsing amamas long yu,
onarim yu, na litimapim nem bilong yu,
long dispela Bikpela Pestode bilong Santu Josep.

Santu Josep em i stretpela man,
na yu bin givim em olsem man long Santu Maria Virgo,
em i Mama bilong God.
Yu bin makim em, bai em i ken lukautim famili bilong yu,
na bai em i ken was olsem papa long Jisas Krais,
em i Pikinini bilong yu na Bikpela bilong mipela,
na em i bin kamap man long strong bilong Holi Spirit.

Long em, ol Ensel i presim glori bilong yu.
Ol Dominion i adorim yu,
na ol strongpela lain bilong heven i guria long ai bilong yu.
Heven wantaim ol strongpela lain bilong heven,
na ol Serafim i litimapim nem bilong yu
wantaim bikpela amamas.
Na mipela tu i laik bung wantaim ol
na givim ona long yu, na mipela i sing (tok):

communion.text:
Yu gutpela wokman, yu bin mekim gutpela wok tru. Yu save lukautim
gut wok bilong yu. Yu kam amamas wantaim Bikpela bilong yu.

sanctorale.03-19.postcommunion:
Lord, long dispela de mipela i amamas
long Bikpela Pestode bilong Santu Josep.
Mipela i askim yu, sambai oltaim long famili bilong yu
i bin kisim kaikai long alta bilong yu,
na helpim ol long lukautim gut ol presen bilong yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.03-23.title: Santu Turibio Bilong Mongrovejo, Bisop
sanctorale.03-23.collect:
God, long wok aposel na tok i tru bilong Bisop Santu Turibio,
yu bin mekim Sios bilong yu i kamap bikpela moa yet.
Mipela i pre, bai pipel bilong yu
i ken gro long bilip na long pasin holi.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.03-23.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong wanpela Bisop (p. 890).

sanctorale.03-25.title: ENSEL I BRINGIM TOK LONG SANTU MARIA, NA BIKPELA JISAS KRAIS I KAMAP MAN

entrance.text:
Taim Bikpela i kam long graun, em i tok olsem, “God, mi kam bilong
bihainim laik bilong yu.”
I gat Ona long God i stap antap na Tok Bilip.

sanctorale.03-25.collect:
God, long laik bilong yu yet,
Tok bilong yu i bin kamap trupela man
long bel bilong Santu Maria Virgo.
Na mipela i tokaut, Krais em i Ridima bilong mipela,
na em i God tru na man tru.
Mipela i pre, helpim mipela long bihainim em gut,
bai mipela i ken kisim laip bilong God i stap long em.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
I gat Tok Bilip. Long tok Long strong bilong Holi Spirit, Maria Virgo i
kisim bel, na em i kamap man ol i brukim skru.
sanctorale.03-25.offerings:
God, yu strong olgeta,
Pikinini bilong yu i bin kamap man,
na em i statim wok bilong kisim bek mipela.
Mipela i askim yu, kisim ol dispela presen bilong Sios bilong yu,
na mekim Sios i amamas long selebretim dispela Sakramen
long Bikpela Pestode bilong Pikinini bilong yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.
sanctorale.03-25.prefaceText:
Tru, em i gutpela na i stret,
oltaim na long olgeta ples,
mipela i tenkim yu, Lord, yu Papa na yu holi tru,
yu strong olgeta na yu God bilong oltaim.
Givim tenkyu long yu em i wok bilong mipela,
na em i kisim bek mipela,
long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

Santu Maria Virgo i harim tok bilong Ensel, na em i bilip.
Olsem na strong bilong Holi Spirit i karamapim em,
na Krais i kamap man bilong kisim bek ol manmeri.

Maria i karim em long klinpela bel bilong em
wantaim bikpela laik.
Na long dispela wok bilong yu,
yu bin inapim olgeta promis,
bipo yu bin mekim long ol pikinini bilong Israel.
Na yu bin inapim hop bilong olgeta lain manmeri
i wet long Ridima i kam.

Long em, ol lain bilong Ensel i adorim glori bilong yu.
Na ol i amamas long sanap oltaim long pes bilong yu.
Na mipela tu i laik bung wantaim ol na givim ona long yu,
na mipela i sing (tok):

communion.text:
Lukim! Wanpela Virgo bai i kisim bel na i karim wanpela pikinini
man, na ol bai i kolim nem bilong em Emanuel.

sanctorale.03-25.postcommunion:
Lord, strongim tingting bilong mipela long trupela bilip.
Mipela i tokaut,
Pikinini bilong Santu Maria Virgo em i God tru na man tru.
Mipela i pre, bai strong bilong Kirap Bek bilong em,
i ken bringim mipela long amamas bilong oltaim.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.04-02.title: Santu Fransis bilong Paola, Ermit
sanctorale.04-02.collect:
God, yu save litimapim ol manmeri bilong daunpasin.
Olsem na yu bin litimapim Santu Fransis bilong Paola
na givim bikpela namba long em namel long ol Santu.
Mipela i askim yu, bai ol pre na gutpela pasin bilong em
i ken helpim mipela long kisim ol gutpela pe
yu bin promis long ol manmeri i save daunim ol yet.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.04-02.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Santu Manmeri: bilong ol Relijis (p. 924).

sanctorale.04-04.title: Santu Isidor, Bisop na Tisa bilong Sios
sanctorale.04-04.collect:
Lord, harim ol pre bilong mipela
long de bilong tingim Santu Isidor.
Em i bin skulim Sios bilong yu long ol samting bilong heven.
Mipela i askim yu, bai pre bilong em
i ken helpim Sios long holim strong bilip bilong em.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.04-04.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong wanpela Bisop (p. 890). O Misa bilong ol Tisa bilong Sios (p. 906).

sanctorale.04-05.title: Santu Vinsen Ferrer, Pris
sanctorale.04-05.collect:
God, yu bin singautim Pris Santu Vinsen
long skulim ol manmeri long Gutnius,
na long tokaut strong olsem Krais bai i kam bek gen
bilong mekim kot long olgeta manmeri.
Mipela i askim yu,
bai wanpela de mipela i ken bung wantaim ol Santu,
na lukim Krais i King long Kingdom bilong Heven.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.04-05.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong wanpela Misinari (p. 902).

sanctorale.04-07.title: Santu Jon Baptis de la Salle, Pris
sanctorale.04-07.collect:
God, yu bin makim Santu Jon Baptis
bilong skulim ol yut long pasin Kristen.
Mipela i askim yu, givim planti gutpela tisa long Sios bilong yu,
bai ol i ken givim ol yet olgeta long helpim ol yut
long kamap gutpela manmeri na gutpela Kristen.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.04-07.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong wanpela Wasman (p. 895). Misa bilong ol Santu Manmeri: bilong ol Tisa (p. 928).

sanctorale.04-11.title: Santu Stanislaus, Bisop na Martir
sanctorale.04-11.collect:
God, Bisop Santu Stanislaus i bin mekim wok bilong yu,
na ol i bin kilim em i dai long bainat.
Na long indai bilong em, em i bin givim bikpela ona long yu.
Mipela i askim yu,
helpim mipela long sanap strong long bilip bilong mipela
inap long indai bilong mipela.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.04-11.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Martir: bilong wanpela Martir (p. 874). Sapos em i Taim bilong Ista, lukim p. 882. O Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong wanpela Bisop (p. 890).

sanctorale.04-13.title: Santu Martin 1, Pop na Martir
sanctorale.04-13.collect:
God, yu strong olgeta,
yu no bin larim ol hevi na ol pen
i daunim strong bilong Pop na Martir Santu Martin.
Mipela i askim yu, bai yu ken helpim mipela tu
long winim ol samting nogut bilong graun i laik daunim mipela.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.04-13.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Martir: bilong wanpela Martir (p. 874). Sapos em i Taim bilong Ista, lukim p. 882. O Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong wanpela Pop (p. 887).

sanctorale.04-21.title: Santu Anselm, Bisop na Tisa bilong Sios
sanctorale.04-21.collect:
God, yu bin singautim Bisop Santu Anselm
long kisim bikpela save long yu,
na long skulim ol manmeri long tok i tru bilong yu.
Mipela i askim yu, bai bilip bilong mipela
i ken kliaim tingting bilong mipela,
olsem na bai mipela i ken amamas long harim ol tok bilong yu.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.04-21.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong wanpela Bisop (p. 890). O Misa bilong ol Tisa bilong Sios (p. 906).

sanctorale.04-23.title: Santu George, Martir
sanctorale.04-23.collect:
Lord, tude mipela i tingim Santu George,
na mipela i singsing amamas long bikpela strong bilong yu.
Long wanem, em i bin bihainim Krais
long Pen na Indai bilong em.
Mipela i askim yu, bai pre bilong em i ken helpim mipela
long taim mipela yet i no gat strong.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.04-23.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Martir: bilong wanpela Martir (p. 874). Sapos em i Taim bilong Ista, lukim p. 882.

sanctorale.04-24.title: Santu Fidelis bilong Sigmaringen, Pris na Martir
sanctorale.04-24.collect:
God, Santu Fidelis i bin laikim yu tumas,
na em i bin mekim bikpela wok bilong autim bilip.
Olsem na yu bin amamas long indai bilong em olsem Martir,
na yu bin givim bikpela pe long em.
Mipela i askim yu,
bai pre bilong em i ken helpim mipela long laikim yu tru,
na long luksave long bikpela strong
bilong Kirap Bek bilong Krais.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.04-24.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Martir: bilong wanpela Martir (p. 874). Sapos em i Taim bilong Ista, lukim p. 882. O Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong wanpela Wasman (p. 895).

sanctorale.04-25.title: SANTU MAK, EVANGELIS

entrance.text:
Yupela i mas i go long olgeta hap bilong graun, na autim Gutnius long
olgeta manmeri. Aleluya.
I gat Ona long God i stap antap.

sanctorale.04-25.collect:
God, yu bin makim Santu Mak bilong kamap Evangelis,
na yu bin givim grasia long em, bai em i ken autim Gutnius.
Mipela i pre, helpim mipela long save gut long ol skul bilong em,
bai mipela i ken bihainim gut lek mak bilong Krais.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.04-25.offerings:
Lord, tude mipela i tingim Santu Mak,
na mipela i ofarim dispela sakrifais
bilong litimapim nem bilong yu.
Mipela i pre, bai Sios bilong yu
i ken wok strong oltaim long telimautim Gutnius.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Bikpela i tok olsem, “Harim, mi stap wantaim yupela olgeta de, i go
inap long dispela taim i pinis.” Aleluya.

sanctorale.04-25.postcommunion:
God, yu strong olgeta, mipela i askim yu,
bai dispela presen mipela i bin kisim long alta bilong yu,
i ken mekim mipela i kamap holi.
Na em i ken helpim mipela
long kamap strong long bilip i kam long Gutnius,
Santu Mak yet i bin telimautim.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.04-27.title: Santu Luis Maria Grignion de Montfort, Pris
sanctorale.04-27.collect:
God, yu bin stiaim Pris Santu Luis Maria long wokabaut
long rot bilong salvesen na bilong laikim Krais,
wantaim helpim bilong Santu Maria Virgo.
Mipela i askim yu, bai mipela i ken bihainim pasin bilong em,
na tingim oltaim long bikpela misteri
bilong laikim pasin bilong yu.
Olsem na bai mipela tu i ken wok hat
bilong helpim Sios bilong yu i gro.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
O:
God, yu strong olgeta na yu stap oltaim.
Yu bin mekim Pris Santu Luis Maria
i kamap gutpela witnes na tisa
bilong pasin bilong laikim Krais, Pikinini bilong yu,
wantaim helpim bilong Santu Maria, em i Mama bilong em.
Mipela i askim yu,
helpim mipela long bihainim gut dispela rot em i bin soim,
bai mipela tu i ken mekim wok
bilong mekim Kingdom bilong yu i gro.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.04-27.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong wanpela Wasman (p. 895).

sanctorale.04-28.title: Santu Pita Sanel, Pris na Martir
sanctorale.04-28.collect:
God, yu bin singautim Santu Pita Sanel long mekim wok
bai Sios bilong yu i ken kamap long arere bilong graun,
na yu bin bilasim em wantaim glori bilong ol Martir.
Mipela i askim yu,
mekim mipela i amamas long dispela taim bilong Ista,
na helpim mipela long selebretim gut dispela Sakramen
bilong Indai na Kirap Bek bilong Krais,
bai mipela i ken kamap trupela witnes
bilong nupela laip i kam long yu.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.04-28.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Martir: bilong wanpela Martir (p. 874). Sapos em i Taim bilong Ista, lukim p. 882. O Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong wanpela Wasman (p. 895).

sanctorale.04-29.title: Santu Katarina bilong Siena, Virgo na Tisa bilong Sios

entrance.text:
Dispela em i wanpela virgo i gat gutpela tingting. Em i bin laitim lam
bilong em, na em i go bungim Krais long rot. Aleluya.

sanctorale.04-29.collect:
God, Santu Katarina i bin lait long paia
bilong laikim pasin bilong Pen na Indai bilong Bikpela,
na bilong mekim wok bilong helpim Sios bilong yu.
Mipela i askim yu,
bai pre bilong em i ken helpim pipel bilong yu
long pas wantaim Krais,
na long amamas long lukim glori bilong em.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.04-29.offerings:
Lord, tude mipela i tingim Santu Katarina,
na mipela i ofarim long yu dispela sakrifais
i save kisim bek mipela.
Mipela i pre, bai mipela i ken kisim save long ol skul bilong em,
na bai mipela i ken litimapim nem bilong yu tasol.
Long wanem, yu tasol yu trupela God.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
God i stap long lait, olsem na sapos yumi wokabaut long lait, orait yumi
bai i kamap wan wantaim ol arapela. Na blut bilong Jisas, Pikinini
bilong em, i klinim mipela long olgeta sin. Aleluya.

sanctorale.04-29.postcommunion:
Lord, dispela kaikai bilong heven, mipela i kisim pinis,
i bin strongim Santu Katarina long dispela graun.
Mipela i askim yu,
bai dispela kaikai i ken givim laip bilong oltaim long mipela.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.04-30.title: Santu Paius 5, Pop
sanctorale.04-30.collect:
God, yu bin givim Pop Santu Paius long Sios bilong yu,
bai em i ken was tru long bilip,
na bai em i ken skulim mipela long mekim gutpela lotu
bilong litimapim nem bilong yu.
Mipela i askim yu, bai pre bilong em i ken helpim mipela
long kisim ol Sakramen bilong yu
wantaim bikpela bilip na laikim pasin.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.04-30.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong wanpela Pop (p. 887).

sanctorale.05-01.title: Santu Josep i Wokman

entrance.text:
Man i aninit long Bikpela, na i save wokabaut long rot bilong em, em i
ken amamas. Em bai i kisim kaikai long wok bilong han bilong em. Na
Bikpela i blesim em nau, na em bai i blesim em bihain. Aleluya.

sanctorale.05-01.collect:
God, yu bin mekim olgeta samting i kamap,
na yu bin makim lo bilong wok
long olgeta manmeri bilong graun.
Mipela i askim yu, bai pasin na pre bilong Santu Josep
i ken helpim mipela long inapim gut
olgeta wok yu bin givim long mipela,
bai bihain mipela i ken kisim ol gutpela pe
long han bilong yu, olsem yu bin promisim mipela.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.05-01.offerings:
God, yu as bilong marimari.
Lukdaun long dispela ofa,
mipela i bringim i kam long ai bilong yu,
long de bilong tingim Santu Josep.
Mipela i pre, bai ol dispela presen
i ken helpim ol manmeri i singaut long yu,
bai ol i ken i stap oltaim aninit long lukaut bilong yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.
sanctorale.05-01.prefaceText:
Tru, em i gutpela na i stret,
oltaim na long olgeta ples,
mipela i tenkim yu, Lord, yu Papa na yu holi tru,
yu strong olgeta na yu God bilong oltaim.
Givim tenkyu long yu em i wok bilong mipela,
na em i kisim bek mipela.
Mipela i mas singsing amamas long yu,
onarim yu, na litimapim nem bilong yu,
long dispela de bilong tingim Santu Josep.

Santu Josep em i stretpela man,
na yu bin givim em olsem man long Santu Maria Virgo,
em i Mama bilong God.
Yu bin makim em, bai em i ken lukautim famili bilong yu,
na bai em i ken was olsem papa long Jisas Krais,
em i Pikinini bilong yu na Bikpela bilong mipela,
na em i bin kamap man long strong bilong Holi Spirit.

Long em, ol Ensel i presim glori bilong yu.
Ol Dominion i adorim yu,
na ol strongpela lain bilong heven i guria long ai bilong yu.
Heven wantaim ol strongpela lain bilong heven,
na ol Serafim i litimapim nem bilong yu
wantaim bikpela amamas.
Na mipela tu i laik bung wantaim ol
na givim ona long yu, na mipela i sing (tok):

communion.text:
Olgeta samting yupela i mekim long tok o long pasin, em yupela i mas
mekim long nem bilong Bikpela. Na long nem bilong em, yupela i mas
tenkyu long God. Aleluya.

sanctorale.05-01.postcommunion:
Lord, yu bin givim gutpela kaikai bilong heven long mipela.
Na mipela i pre,
bai pasin bilong Santu Josep i ken skulim mipela
long kamap witnes bilong laikim pasin bilong yu,
na bihain mipela i ken kamap long ples bilong bel isi
na bilong amamas inap oltaim.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.05-02.title: Santu Atanasius, Bisop na Tisa bilong Sios

entrance.text:
Em i bin autim tok namel long Sios, na Bikpela i bin pulapim em
long spirit bilong gutpela save na stretpela tingting. Na Bikpela i bin
karamapim em long klos bilong glori. Aleluya.

sanctorale.05-02.collect:
God, yu strong olgeta na yu stap oltaim.
Yu bin singautim Bisop Santu Atanasius,
bai em i ken sanap strong long tokaut olsem
Pikinini bilong yu em i God tru.
Mipela i pre, marimari long mipela,
na mekim bai mipela i ken amamas long pre na skul bilong em,
bai save na laikim pasin bilong mipela i ken gro moa yet.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.05-02.offerings:
Lord, lukdaun long ol dispela presen,
mipela i ofarim long yu long de bilong tingim Santu Atanasius.
Mipela i askim yu, bai mipela i ken givim witnes
long tok i tru bilong yu wankain olsem em i bin mekim.
Na dispela bilip i ken helpim mipela long i go long heven.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
I no gat wanpela man inap long putim narapela ston bilong wokim
haus antap long em. Nogat. Jisas Krais wanpela tasol i stap, em God i
putim pinis olsem namba wan ston bilong haus. Aleluya.

sanctorale.05-02.postcommunion:
God, yu strong olgeta,
mipela i bilip wantaim Santu Atanasius
olsem Pikinini bilong yu em i God tru.
Mipela i pre, bai dispela Sakramen i ken givim laip long mipela,
na yu ken lukautim mipela oltaim.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.05-03.title: SANTU FILIP NA JEMS, APOSEL

entrance.text:
Bikpela i bin makim ol dispela man holi, long wanem, em i laikim ol
tumas. Na em i givim glori bilong oltaim long ol. Aleluya.
I gat Ona long God i stap antap.

sanctorale.05-03.collect:
God, olgeta yia yu save givim amamas long mipela,
long Pestode bilong tupela Aposel Filip na Jems.
Mipela i askim yu, bai pre bilong tupela
i ken helpim mipela long pas long Pen na Indai na Kirap Bek
bilong Pikinini bilong yu,
bai wanpela de mipela tu i ken lukim yu long heven inap oltam.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.05-03.offerings:
Lord, kisim ol dispela presen, mipela i bringim i kam long yu,
long Pestode bilong tupela Aposel Filip na Jems.
Mipela i pre, bai bilip bilong mipela i ken stiaim mipela
long wokabaut oltaim long klinpela na stretpela pasin.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
“Bikpela, yu soim Papa long mipela, na dispela bai inapim laik na
tingting bilong mipela.” Na Jisas i tokim em olsem, “Filip, man i lukim
mi, em i lukim Papa.” Aleluya.

sanctorale.05-03.postcommunion:
Lord, long strong bilong dispela Sakramen,
klinim sol bilong mipela.
Mipela i pre, bai mipela tu i ken bilip olsem,
taim mipela i lukim Pikinini bilong yu,
mipela i lukim yu tasol.
Helpim mipela long kamap stret long ai bilong yu,
bai mipela i ken kamap long laip bilong oltaim.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.05-10.title: Santu Jon bilong Avila, Pris na Tisa bilong Sios
sanctorale.05-10.collect:
God, long pasin holi na long wok aposel
bilong Santu Jon bilong Avila,
yu bin mekim em i kamap gutpela tisa
bilong helpim ol Pris na ol pipel bilong yu.
Mipela i pre, bai Sios bilong yu i ken gro long pasin holi,
na ol Pris i ken givim ol yet olgeta long mekim wok bilong yu.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.05-10.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong wanpela Wasman (p. 895). O Misa bilong ol Tisa bilong Sios (p. 906).

sanctorale.05-12.title: Santu Nirius na Akilius, Martir
sanctorale.05-12.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Martir: bilong planti Martir (p. 865). Sapos em i Taim bilong Ista, lukim p. 882.
sanctorale.05-12.collect:
God, yu strong olgeta, tupela Martir Santu Nirius na Akilius
i bin sanap strong long taim bilong karim pen,
na tupela i no bin pret long givim witnes long nem bilong yu.
Mipela i askim yu, bai pre bilong tupela
i ken kamap long ai bilong yu,
na mipela i ken pilim helpim bilong yu.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.

sanctorale.05-13.title: Santu Maria Virgo bilong Fatima
sanctorale.05-13.collect:
God, yu bin makim Mama bilong Pikinini bilong yu,
bai em i ken kamap Mama bilong mipela tu.
Mipela i askim yu, bai wok penans na pre bilong mipela
i ken helpim salvesen bilong olgeta manmeri bilong graun,
na i ken helpim Kingdom bilong Krais long kamap strong.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.

sanctorale.05-14.title: SANTU MATIAS, APOSEL

entrance.text:
Bikpela i tok olsem, “Yupela i no bin makim mi bilong i stap wantaim
yupela. Nogat. Mi bin makim yupela bilong i stap ol lain bilong mi. Na
mi bin givim wok long yupela, bai yupela i ken i go na karim kaikai, na
bai kaikai bilong yupela i ken i stap gut.” (Aleluya)
I gat Ona long God i stap antap.

sanctorale.05-14.collect:
God, yu bin makim Santu Matias
bilong joinim lain bilong ol Aposel.
Mipela i askim yu, bai pre bilong em i ken mekim mipela
i amamas oltaim long laikim pasin bilong yu,
na i ken helpim mipela long joinim ol lain
yu bin makim pinis bilong yu yet.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.05-14.offerings:
Lord, kisim dispela ofa bilong Sios bilong yu,
mipela i bringim i kam long Pestode bilong Santu Matias.
Na mekim bai dispela ofa i ken strongim mipela
long grasia bilong yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Bikpela i tok olsem, “Lo bilong mi em i olsem. Yupela wan wan i mas
laikim tru ol arapela, long wankain pasin olsem mi bin laikim yupela.”
(Aleluya)

sanctorale.05-14.postcommunion:
Lord, pulapim famili bilong yu oltaim
wantaim ol presen bilong heven.
Mipela i askim yu, helpim mipela long pre bilong Santu Matias,
na kisim mipela tu i go stap wantaim ol Santu
long ples bilong lait bilong yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.05-18.title: Santu Jon 1, Pop na Martir
sanctorale.05-18.collect:
God, yu save givim gutpela pe
long ol manmeri i mekim gut wok bilong yu.
Na long indai olsem martir bilong Pop Santu Jon,
yu bin mekim dispela de i kamap holi.
Harim pre bilong pipel bilong yu
i tingim ol gutpela pasin bilong em,
na helpim mipela long bihainim strongpela bilip bilong em.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.05-18.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Martir: bilong wanpela Martir (p. 874). Sapos em i Taim bilong Ista, lukim p. 882. O Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong wanpela Pop (p. 887).

sanctorale.05-20.title: Santu Bernardin bilong Siena, Pris
sanctorale.05-20.collect:
God, yu bin mekim Pris Santu Bernardin
i laikim Holi Nem bilong Jisas tumas.
Mipela i askim yu, lukim ol pasin na pre bilong em,
na kirapim paia bilong laikim pasin insait long mipela.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.05-20.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong wanpela Misinari (p. 902). O Misa bilong ol Santu Manmeri: bilong ol Relijis (p. 924).

sanctorale.05-21.title: Santu Kristofer Magallanes, Pris, Wantaim ol Lain Martir bilong Meksico
sanctorale.05-21.collect:
God, yu strong olgeta na yu stap oltaim.
Yu bin strongim Pris Santu Kristofer
wantaim ol lain Martir bilong em,
na ol i bin givim witnes long Krais i King
inap long ol i dai olsem martir.
Mipela i askim yu, harim pre bilong ol,
na strongim bilip bilong mipela,
bai mipela tu i ken tokaut oltaim long trupela bilip,
na bai mipela i ken holim gut ol lo
i kam long laikim pasin bilong yu.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.05-21.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Martir: bilong planti Martir (p. 865). O Sapos em i Taim bilong Ista, lukim p. 882.

sanctorale.05-22.title: Santu Rita bilong Kaskia, Relijis
sanctorale.05-22.collect:
Lord, yu bin pulapim Santu Rita
long gutpela save na strong i kam long Diwai Kros.
Mipela i askim yu, salim dispela save na strong i kam long mipela,
bai mipela i ken sanap strong wantaim Krais
long taim bilong hevi, na bai mipela i ken pas oltaim
long Pen na Indai na Kirap Bek bilong em.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.05-22.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Santu Manmeri: bilong ol Relijis (p. 924).

sanctorale.05-24.title: Maria, Helpim bilong ol Kristen

entrance.text:
Husat tru i lukluk i kam long mi? Pes bilong em i olsem san i laik kamap
na i lait olsem biksan, na pes bilong em i klia tru olsem lait bilong mun.
Mi lukim em na tingting bilong mi i pas olsem man i lukim bikpela
lain soldia i kam wantaim ol plak bilong ol. (Aleluya)

sanctorale.05-24.collect:
God, yu bin makim Mama bilong Pikinini bilong yu
olsem Mama na Helpim bilong olgeta Kristen manmeri.
Mipela i askim yu, bai mipela i ken i stap oltaim
aninit long lukaut bilong em,
na Sios bilong yu i ken painim gutpela taim.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.05-24.offerings:
Lord, lukdaun long ol pre na ofa
bilong ol bilipmanmeri bilong yu,
long dispela de bilong tingim Santu Maria, em i Mama bilong God.
Mipela i pre, bai dispela ofa i ken kamap stret long ai bilong yu,
na long strong bilong em,
yu ken marimari long mipela, na helpim mipela.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Maria Virgo, yu ken amamas. Long wanem, God, em i Bikpela bilong
yumi na em God I Stap Antap Tru, em i bin blesim yu, na givim biknem
long yu i winim tru nem bilong olgeta meri bilong graun. Olsem na
oltaim olgeta manmeri bai i litimapim nem bilong yu. (Aleluya)

sanctorale.05-24.postcommunion:
God, yu Bikpela bilong mipela,
yu bin strongim mipela long dispela Sakramen bilong heven.
Mipela i askim yu, bai ol pre bilong Santu Maria Virgo
i ken helpim kantri bilong mipela,
na em i mekim mipela i kamap nupela manmeri long Jisas Krais.
Em i stap laip na em i King, nau na oltaim.

sanctorale.05-25.title: Santu Bid, Pris na Tisa bilong Sios
sanctorale.05-25.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Tisa bilong Sios (p. 906). O Misa bilong ol Santu Manmeri: bilong wanpela Monk (p. 922).
sanctorale.05-25.collect:
God, long ol skul bilong Pris Santu Bid,
yu bin givim lait bilong gutpela save long Sios bilong yu.
Mipela i askim yu, bai ol skul bilong em
i ken givim gutpela save long ol wokmanmeri bilong yu,
na ol gutpela pasin bilong em i ken helpim ol long i stap gut.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.

sanctorale.05-26.title: Santu Filip Neri, Pris

entrance.text:
Laikim pasin bilong God i bin pulap long hat bilong mipela, long wok
bilong Spirit bilong God i stap insait long mipela. (Aleluya)

sanctorale.05-26.collect:
God, oltaim yu save singautim ol wokman bilong yu
long bihainim pasin holi, na yu save givim biknem long ol.
Mipela i askim yu, bai Holi Spirit i ken kirapim paia
bilong laikim pasin insait long hat bilong mipela,
wankain olsem em i bin mekim insait long hat bilong Santu Filip.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.05-26.offerings:
Lord, tude mipela i tingim Santu Filip,
na mipela i ofarim dispela sakrifais
bilong litimapim nem bilong yu.
Mipela i askim yu, bai mipela i ken bihainim pasin bilong em,
na givim mipela yet olgeta long yu.
Helpim mipela long mekim ol gutpela pasin
bilong givim glori long nem bilong yu,
na bilong helpim ol arapela manmeri.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Bikpela i tok olsem, “Papa i laikim mi tumas, na long wankain pasin mi
bin laikim yupela. Oltaim yupela i mas i stap insait long dispela laikim
bilong mi.” (Aleluya)

sanctorale.05-26.postcommunion:
Lord, mipela i bin kisim strong
long dispela kaikai bilong heven.
Mipela i askim yu,
bai mipela i ken bihainim pasin bilong Santu Filip,
na mangal oltaim long dispela gutpela kaikai
i save givim laip tru long mipela.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.05-27.title: Santu Ogastin bilong Kenteberi, Bisop
sanctorale.05-27.collect:
God, long wok bilong Bisop Santu Ogastin
yu bin skulim ol pipel bilong Englan long Gutnius.
Mipela i pre, bai wok bilong em i ken karim kaikai oltaim
insait long Sios bilong yu.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.05-27.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong wanpela Misinari (p. 902). O Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong wanpela Bisop (p. 890).

sanctorale.05-29.title: Santu Pol 6, Pop
sanctorale.05-29.collect:
God, yu bin makim Pop Santu Pol 6
bilong stiaim Sios bilong yu,
na em i bin i stap gutpela aposel
bilong Gutnius bilong Pikinini bilong yu.
Mipela i askim yu,
helpim mipela long kisim lait long ol skul bilong em,
bai mipela i ken wok strong bilong mekim gutpela sindaun
na laikim pasin i gro long dispela graun.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.05-29.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong wanpela Pop (p. 887).

sanctorale.05-31.title: SANTU MARIA VIRGO I GO LUKIM SANTU ELISABET

entrance.text:
Yupela ol manmeri i save aninit long God, yupela kam na harim. Bai
mi stori long ol samting, Bikpela i bin mekim bilong helpim sol bilong
mi. (Aleluya)
I gat Ona long God i stap antap.

sanctorale.05-31.collect:
God, yu strong olgeta na yu stap oltaim.
Taim Pikinini bilong yu i stap yet
long bel bilong Santu Maria Virgo,
yu bin kirapim tingting long Maria,
bai em i ken i go na visitim Elisabet.
Mipela i askim yu, helpim mipela
long bihainim ol gutpela tingting i kam long Holi Spirit,
bai mipela tu i ken bung wantaim Santu Maria
na litimapim nem bilong yu oltaim.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.05-31.offerings:
Lord, mipela i ofarim dispela sakrifais
i save kisim bek mipela long yu.
Mipela i pre, bai dispela ofa i ken kamap stret long ai bilong yu,
bai yu ken amamas long em,
wankain olsem yu bin amamas long wok marimari
bilong Mama bilong Pikinini bilong yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Nau na bihain tu bai olgeta lain manmeri i tok long God i bin givim
bikpela amamas long mi. Long wanem, God i strong olgeta i bin mekim
narakain samting tru bilong helpim mi, na nem bilong em i stap holi.
(Aleluya)

sanctorale.05-31.postcommunion:
God, Sios bilong yu i ken amamas long ol bikpela wok
yu bin mekim bilong helpim ol bilipmanmeri bilong yu.
Santu Jon bilong Baptais i bin amamas na kalap
long bungim Krais i stap long bel bilong Maria.
Mipela i pre, bai Sios bilong yu i ken amamas oltaim
long bungim Krais long dispela Sakramen.
Em i stap laip na em i King, nau na oltaim.

sanctorale.06-01.title: Santu Jastin, Martir

entrance.text:
Ol manmeri nogut i bin giamanim mi, tasol lo bilong yu em i tru olgeta.
Mi bin tokaut long ol tok bilong yu long ai bilong ol king, na mi no
kisim sem. (Aleluya)

sanctorale.06-01.collect:
God, yu bin skulim Martir Santu Jastin
olsem tok bilong Diwai Kros em i no kranki tok. Nogat.
Dispela tok i soim bikpela save bilong Krais,
na i winim tru olgeta save bilong dispela graun.
Mipela i askim yu, bai pre bilong Santu Jastin
i ken helpim mipela long sakim ol kranki tingting,
na long holim strong bilip tru bilong mipela.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.06-01.offerings:
Lord, Santu Jastin i bin givim witnes long bilip bilong em,
na em i bin daunim ol kranki toktok bilong ol manmeri
i bin agensim Holi Yukaris.
Mipela i pre, helpim mipela long selebretim gut dispela Sakramen,
bai em i ken kamap stret long ai bilong yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Taim mi bin i stap wantaim yupela, mi no laik tingting long narapela
samting. Nogat. Mi tingting long Jisas Krais tasol, em i bin dai long
Diwai Kros. (Aleluya)

sanctorale.06-01.postcommunion:
Lord, yu bin strongim mipela long dispela kaikai bilong heven.
Mipela i askim yu,
helpim mipela long bihainim ol skul bilong Martir Santu Jastin,
na long tenkim yu oltaim
long ol presen yu save givim long mipela.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.06-02.title: Santu Marselainus na Pita, Martir
sanctorale.06-02.collect:
God, long witnes na bilip
bilong tupela Martir Santu Marselainus na Pita,
yu save sambai long mipela na strongim mipela.
Mipela i askim yu, bai mipela i ken bihainim pasin bilong tupela,
na pre bilong tupela i ken helpim mipela oltaim.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.06-02.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Martir: bilong planti Martir (p. 865). O Sapos em i Taim bilong Ista, lukim p. 878.

sanctorale.06-03.title: Santu Charles Lwanga, Wantaim ol Lain Martir bilong Uganda

entrance.text:
God i save traim ol manmeri em i makim pinis, olsem ol man i save
traim gol long paia. Em i kisim ol dispela manmeri olsem ofa bilong
sakrifais bilong em yet. Na long taim em i makim pinis, ol bai i kisim
biknem. Long wanem, God bai i givim bel isi na ol presen bilong em
long ol manmeri em i makim pinis. (Aleluya)

sanctorale.06-03.collect:
God, yu bin mekim blut bilong ol Martir
i kamap olsem pikinini kaikai ol i planim long graun,
bai planti Kristen i ken kamap bihain.
Mipela i pre,
bai Sios bilong yu i ken i stap gut na karim planti kaikai.
Long wanem, Martir Santu Charles na ol lain bilong em
i bin kapsaitim blut bilong ol bilong givim witnes long Krais.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.06-03.offerings:
Lord, yu bin givim grasia long ol Santu Martir,
na ol i bin redi long dai, long wanem, ol i no laik mekim sin.
Nau mipela i ofarim dispela sakrifais long yu, na mipela i pre,
bai mipela tu i ken givim mipela yet olgeta long yu,
na selebretim gut dispela lotu long alta bilong yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Indai bilong ol manmeri i holi, em i dia tumas long ai bilong Bikpela.
(Aleluya)

sanctorale.06-03.postcommunion:
Lord, mipela i bin kisim dispela Sakramen bilong heven
long de bilong tingim ol Santu Martir bilong yu.
Dispela Sakramen i bin strongim ol
long sanap strong long taim bilong hevi, na ol i bin win.
Mipela i askim yu, bai dispela Sakramen
i ken mekim mipela tu i sanap strong long taim nogut,
na long holim bilip na laikim pasin bilong mipela
wantaim olgeta strong bilong mipela.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.06-05.title: Santu Bonifas, Bisop na Martir
sanctorale.06-05.collect:
Lord, Martir Santu Bonifas
i bin skulim bilip long maus bilong em,
na em i bin givim witnes long blut bilong em.
Mipela i pre, bai mipela i ken holim strong bilip bilong mipela,
na givim witnes long ol pasin bilong mipela.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.06-05.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Martir: bilong wanpela Martir (p. 874). Sapos em i Taim bilong Ista, lukim p. 882. O Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong wanpela Bisop (p. 890).

sanctorale.06-06.title: Santu Norbert, Bisop
sanctorale.06-06.collect:
God, yu bin mekim Bisop Santu Norbert
i kamap wanpela gutpela wasman,
na em i bin helpim Sios bilong yu
long pre na long wok aposel bilong em.
Mipela i askim yu, bai pre bilong em i ken helpim ol bilipmanmeri
long painim ol gutpela wasman olsem yu,
bai ol i ken wokabaut oltaim long rot bilong salvesen.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.06-06.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong wanpela Bisop (p. 890). O Misa bilong ol Santu Manmeri: bilong ol Relijis (p. 924).

sanctorale.06-09.title: Santu Efrem, Diken na Tisa bilong Sios
sanctorale.06-09.collect:
Lord, tude mipela i tingim Diken Santu Efrem.
Holi Spirit yet i bin strongim em
long tokaut long ol misteri bilong yu,
na long mekim wok bilong yu tasol.
Mipela i askim yu, salim Holi Spirit i kam long mipela,
bai mipela tu i ken holim wok bilong yu tasol.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.06-09.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Tisa bilong Sios (p. 906).

sanctorale.06-11.title: Santu Barnabas, Aposel

entrance.text:
Dispela Santu i ken amamas. Long wanem, pasin bilong em i stret
olgeta, na ol i bin makim em long lain bilong ol Aposel. Em i gutpela
man, na em i pulap long Holi Spirit na long bilip. (Aleluya)

sanctorale.06-11.collect:
God, Santu Barnabas i bin pulap long bilip na long Holi Spirit,
olsem na yu bin makim em bilong mekim wok
namel long ol manmeri i no bin harim Gutnius bilong Krais yet.
Mipela i pre, bai mipela i ken telimautim Gutnius
long tok na long wok bilong mipela.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.06-11.offerings:
Lord, yu bin laitim paia bilong laikim pasin
insait long Santu Barnabas,
na em i bin karim lait bilong Gutnius long ol manmeri
i no bin save yet long Krais.
Mipela i pre, mekim ol dispela ofa i kamap holi,
bai ol i ken pulapim mipela long bikpela laik
bilong mekim wok bilong yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Mi no kolim yupela “wokboi” moa. Long wanem, wokboi i no save
long ol samting bikman bilong em i save mekim. Mi kolim yupela
“pren.” Long wanem, olgeta tok mi bin harim long Papa bilong mi, em
mi tokim yupela pinis. (Aleluya)

sanctorale.06-11.postcommunion:
Lord, tude mipela i tingim Aposel Santu Barnabas,
na mipela i kisim pinis dispela Sakramen
i save givim laip bilong oltaim.
Mipela i pre, bai dispela Sakramen i ken helpim mipela,
bai wanpela de mipela i ken i go long heven,
na lukim yu long ai bilong mipela.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.06-13.title: Santu Antoni bilong Padua, Pris na Tisa bilong Sios
sanctorale.06-13.collect:
God, yu strong olgeta na yu stap oltaim.
Yu bin givim Santu Antoni long pipel bilong yu,
bilong strongim ol long skul bilong em,
na bilong helpim ol long taim bilong wari.
Mipela i askim yu, bai helpim bilong em i ken stiaim mipela
long wokabaut long Kristen pasin,
na long luksave long helpim bilong yu long taim bilong wari.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.06-13.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong wanpela Wasman (p. 895). O Misa bilong ol Tisa bilong Sios (p. 906). O Misa bilong ol Santu Manmeri: bilong ol Relijis (p. 924).

sanctorale.06-19.title: Santu Romuald, Abbot
sanctorale.06-19.collect:
God, long wok bilong Santu Romuald,
yu bin strongim laip na pasin bilong ol monk
insait long Sios bilong yu.
Mipela i pre, helpim mipela long daunim laik bilong mipela yet,
na bihainim Krais tasol,
bai wanpela de mipela i ken kamap long amamas bilong heven.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.06-19.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Santu Manmeri: bilong wanpela Abbot (p. 921).

sanctorale.06-21.title: Santu Alois Gonsaga, Relijis

entrance.text:
Man bilong stretpela pasin na klinpela hat bai inap long i go antap long
maunten bilong Bikpela. Em bai i stap long ples holi bilong em.

sanctorale.06-21.collect:
God, olgeta gutpela presen bilong heven i kam long yu tasol.
Long laip bilong Santu Alois Gonsaga,
yu bin soim mipela eksampel bilong klinpela pasin
na bilong wok penans.
Mipela i askim yu, bai pasin na pre bilong em i ken helpim mipela,
ol manmeri i no bin bihainim klinpela pasin,
long bihainim wok penans bilong em.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.06-21.offerings:
Lord, strongim mipela long bihainim pasin bilong Santu Alois,
na karamapim mipela long klos bilong stretpela pasin.
Mipela i pre, bai dispela Sakramen i ken pulapim mipela
long grasia bilong yu,
na em i ken helpim mipela
long kamap long bikpela kaikai bilong heven.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
God i bin givim Bret bilong Heven long ol manmeri, na ol i kaikai bret
bilong ol Ensel.

sanctorale.06-21.postcommunion:
Lord, tude mipela i tingim Santu Alois,
na yu bin givim Bret bilong ol Ensel long mipela.
Mipela i pre, bai mipela i ken bihainim pasin bilong em,
na mekim wok bilong yu wantaim klinpela bel,
na tenkim yu oltaim.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.06-22.title: Santu Polainus bilong Nola, Bisop
sanctorale.06-22.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong wanpela Bisop (p. 890).
sanctorale.06-22.collect:
God, yu bin mekim Bisop Santu Polainus
i lustingting long ol samting bilong graun,
na yu bin mekim em i kamap gutpela wasman
bilong pipel bilong em.
Mipela i askim yu,
bai mipela i ken bihainim laikim pasin bilong em,
na mekim wok bilong helpim ol arapela manmeri.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.

sanctorale.06-24.title: SANTU ELISABET I KARIM SANTU JON BILONG BAPTAIS

entrance.text:
God i bin salim wanpela man i kam. Nem bilong em Jon. Em i kam
bilong givim witnes long lait, bai olgeta manmeri i ken redi long
Bikpela i kam.

sanctorale.06-24.collect:
God, yu bin makim Santu Jon bilong Baptais,
bai em i ken redim ol manmeri long bungim Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela.
Mipela i askim yu, givim amamas na grasia bilong yu long mipela,
na stiaim ol bilipmanmeri long wokabaut oltaim
long rot bilong salvesen na bel isi.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.06-24.offerings:
Lord, tude mipela i tingim de bilong Santu Elisabet
i karim Santu Jon bilong Baptais.
Taim Krais i no bin kamap ples klia yet,
Jon i tokim ol manmeri olsem Sevia bai i kam.
Na taim Krais i kam, orait,
Jon i tokaut olsem Sevia bilong graun i kamap pinis.
Olsem na mipela i laik selebretim dispela Bikpela Pestode,
na mipela i pre, Lord, bai yu ken kisim ol dispela ofa,
mipela i bringim i kam long alta bilong yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.
sanctorale.06-24.preface: bilong dispela Bikpela Pestode yet. Lukim neks Misa.

communion.text:
Long bikpela marimari bilong em, God bilong yumi bai i salim tulait
bilong heven i kam long yumi.

sanctorale.06-24.postcommunion:
Lord, tude mipela i amamas long tingim de
bilong Santu Elisabet i karim Santu Jon bilong Baptais,
na mipela i bin kisim kaikai long tebol bilong Krais,
em i Lem i kam long heven.
Mipela i pre, bai Sios bilong yu i ken luksave oltaim
olsem Krais tasol i save mekim em i kamap nupela gen.
Em i stap laip na em i King, nau na oltaim.
sanctorale.06-24.prefaceText:
Tru, em i gutpela na i stret,
oltaim na long olgeta ples,
mipela i tenkim yu, Lord, yu Papa na yu holi tru,
yu strong olgeta na yu God bilong oltaim.
Givim tenkyu long yu em i wok bilong mipela,
na em i kisim bek mipela,
long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.
Santu Jon bilong Baptais i bin i go pas long Krais,
bilong redim rot bilong em.
Olsem na mipela i litimapim nem bilong yu,
long wanem, yu bin makim em bilong mekim dispela wok.
Na yu bin givim biknem long em
i winim nem bilong ol arapela manmeri.

Bikpela amamas i kamap taim mama i bin karim em.
Na taim em i stap yet long bel bilong mama,
em i bin amamas na kalap,
long wanem, salvesen bilong ol manmeri klostu i laik kam.

Na namel long ol profet, Jon wanpela tasol
i bin soim Lem bilong God i kam pinis
bilong kisim bek olgeta manmeri.

Krais i bin kamapim Sakramen bilong Baptais,
tasol Jon i baptaisim em.
Na taim em i mekim olsem, wara i kamap holi.
Na bihain Jon i bin kapsaitim blut bilong em,
bilong givim witnes long Krais.

Olsem na wantaim ol strongpela Ensel bilong heven,
mipela hia long graun i litimapim nem bilong yu,
na oltaim mipela i sing (tok):

sanctorale.06-27.title: Santu Siril bilong Aleksandria, Bisop na Tisa bilong Sios
sanctorale.06-27.collect:
God, yu bin mekim Bisop Santu Siril i kamap gutpela tisa,
na em i tokaut strong olsem
Santu Maria Virgo em i trupela Mama bilong God.
Na mipela tu i bilip olsem Maria em i Mama bilong God.
Long wanem, Krais em i Pikinini bilong yu,
na em i bin kamap man long bel bilong Maria.
Mipela i pre, bai wok bilong Krais i ken helpim mipela
long kamap long laip bilong oltaim.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.06-27.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong wanpela Bisop (p. 890). O Misa bilong ol Tisa bilong Sios (p. 906).

sanctorale.06-28.title: Santu Irinius, Bisop na Martir

entrance.text:
Lo bilong tok tru i bin i stap oltaim long maus bilong em. Em i no bin
skulim ol long pasin nogut. Em i bin wokabaut oltaim wantaim stretpela
pasin na bel isi. Na em i bin helpim planti manmeri long givim baksait
long ol pasin nogut.

sanctorale.06-28.collect:
God, yu bin singautim Bisop Santu Irinius
bilong strongim trupela bilip,
na bilong bringim gutpela taim long Sios bilong yu.
Mipela i askim yu, harim pre bilong em,
na mekim bilip na laikim pasin bilong mipela i kamap nupela gen,
bai mipela i ken redi oltaim
long mekim wok bilong strongim pasin wanbel na pasin bel isi.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.06-28.offerings:
Lord, tude mipela i tingim Santu Irinius,
na mipela i ofarim dispela sakrifais long yu,
bilong givim glori long yu.
Mipela i pre, dispela sakrifais i ken helpim mipela
long bihainim tok i tru tasol,
bai mipela i ken holim bilip bilong Sios,
na i helpim em long kamap wanbel.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Bikpela i tok olsem, “Yupela i mas pas long mi, olsem mi pas long
yupela. Man o meri i pas long mi, na mi pas long em, em i save karim
planti kaikai.”

sanctorale.06-28.postcommunion:
Lord, yu bin givim glori long Bisop Santu Irinius,
long wanem, em i bin holim bilip inap long indai.
Mipela i askim yu, marimari long mipela,
na mekim bai dispela holi Sakramen
i ken mekim bilip bilong mipela i gro,
bai mipela i ken bihainim dispela bilip,
na i kamap klin long ai bilong yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.06-29.title: SANTU PITA NA POL, APOSEL

entrance.text:
Dispela tupela man, taim tupela i bin i stap long graun, i bin kirapim
Sios antap long blut bilong tupela. Tupela i bin dring long kap bilong
Bikpela, na tupela i bin kamap pren bilong God.

sanctorale.06-29.collect:
God, yu mekim mipela i amamas long dispela Bikpela Pestode
bilong tupela Aposel Santu Pita na Pol.
Long skul bilong tupela,
Sios bilong yu i bin kisim save long trupela bilip.
Mipela i pre, helpim Sios bilong yu,
bai em i ken bihainim oltaim skul bilong tupela.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.06-29.offerings:
Lord, mipela i bringim ol ofa bilong sakrifais i kam long yu,
bai yu ken mekim ol i kamap holi.
Mipela i askim yu, bai pre bilong tupela Aposel
i ken helpim mipela long selebretim gut dispela sakrifais.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Pita i tokim Jisas olsem, “Yu Krais, yu Pikinini bilong God i gat laip.”
Na Jisas i bekim tok long em olsem, “Yu Pita, na bai mi wokim Sios
bilong mi antap long dispela ston.”

sanctorale.06-29.postcommunion:
Lord, dispela Sakramen i bin mekim mipela
i kamap nupela gen.
Mipela i askim yu, helpim mipela long i stap gut insait long Sios,
bai mipela i ken strong long pasin bilong brukim Bret,
na long pasin bilong bihainim skul bilong ol Aposel.
Na lukautim mipela,
bai mipela i ken i stap wantingting na wanbel,
na pas oltaim long laikim pasin bilong yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.
sanctorale.06-29.prefaceText:
Tru, em i gutpela na i stret,
oltaim na long olgeta ples,
mipela i tenkim yu, Lord, yu Papa na yu holi tru,
yu strong olgeta na yu God bilong oltaim.
Givim tenkyu long yu em i wok bilong mipela,
na em i kisim bek mipela.

Yu mekim mipela i amamas
long tingim tupela Aposel, Santu Pita na Pol.
Pita i go pas long autim bilip long Krais.
Na Pol i tokaut long dispela bilip long ai bilong olgeta manmeri.
Pita i kirapim namba wan Sios,
namel long ol manmeri bilong Israel.
Na Pol em i bikpela tisa
i skulim ol manmeri bilong ol arapela lain.

Wan wan i gat rot bilong em yet,
tasol tupela wantaim i bin kamapim wanpela famili bilong Krais.
Tupela wantaim i bin kisim biknem long olgeta hap bilong graun.
Na tupela wantaim i bin kisim pe bilong ol Martir long heven.

Olsem na wantaim ol Santu na ol Ensel,
mipela i givim ona long yu, na oltaim mipela sing (tok):

sanctorale.06-30.title: Namba Wan Lain Martir bilong Holi Sios long Rom
sanctorale.06-30.collect:
God, yu bin mekim Sios long Rom i kamap holi
long blut bilong ol Martir,
na yu bin mekim em i karim planti kaikai.
Mipela i pre, bai bilip bilong ol martir
i ken strongim bilip bilong mipela,
na i ken mekim mipela i amamas long ol Martir i bin win pinis.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.06-30.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Martir: bilong planti Martir (p. 865).

sanctorale.07-03.title: SANTU TOMAS, APOSEL

entrance.text:
Yu God bilong mi, na mi tokaut long nem bilong yu. Yu God bilong mi,
na mi litimapim nem bilong yu. Mi tokaut long nem bilong yu, long
wanem, yu Sevia bilong mi.
I gat Ona long God i stap antap.

sanctorale.07-03.collect:
God, yu strong olgeta, tude mipela i amamas
long Pestode bilong Aposel Santu Tomas.
Mipela i askim yu, bai pre bilong em
i ken helpim mipela long bilip strong olsem
Jisas Krais, Pikinini bilong yu, em i Bikpela bilong mipela,
na dispela bilip i ken givim laip bilong oltaim long mipela.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.07-03.offerings:
Lord, mipela i tingim bilip bilong Aposel Santu Tomas,
na mipela i ofarim dispela sakrifais bilong givim ona long yu.
Mipela i pre, long strong bilong dispela ofa,
helpim mipela long holim gut ol presen bilong yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Putim han bilong yu i kam hia, na yu lukim mak bilong ol nil. Na yu no
ken tubel long bilip. Yu mas bilip tasol.

sanctorale.07-03.postcommunion:
God, long dispela Sakramen mipela i bin kisim
trupela Bodi bilong Pikinini bilong yu.
Mipela i pre, helpim mipela long bihainim bilip
bilong Aposel Tomas, bai mipela tu i ken tokaut
long Pikinini bilong yu em i Bikpela na God bilong mipela,
na bai mipela i ken givim witnes long em
long ol wok na pasin bilong mipela.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.07-04.title: Santu Elisabet bilong Portugal
sanctorale.07-04.collect:
God, yu Papa bilong bel isi,
na yu save laikim tumas ol wok marimari.
Yu bin givim grasia long Santu Elisabet
bilong mekim ol birua i sekan na i kamap wanbel gen.
Mipela i askim yu, long pre bilong em,
helpim mipela long mekim wok bilong kamapim bel isi,
bai mipela i ken kamap pikinini bilong yu.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.07-04.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Santu Manmeri: bilong ol manmeri i bin mekim wok marimari (p. 927).

sanctorale.07-05.title: Santu Antoni Sakaria, Pris
sanctorale.07-05.collect:
Lord, Santu Antoni Sakaria
i bin bihainim pasin bilong Aposel Pol,
na em i bin save gut long Jisas Krais i dai long Diwai Kros.
Olsem na em i bin mekim bikpela wok
bilong skulim ol manmeri bilong Sios
long tok bilong yu i save kisim bek mipela.
Mipela i askim yu, givim dispela kain save long mipela,
bai mipela tu i ken tingting oltaim
long Krais i dai long Diwai Kros.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.07-05.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong wanpela Wasman (p. 895). O Misa bilong ol Santu Manmeri: bilong ol Tisa (p. 928). O Misa bilong ol Santu Manmeri: bilong ol Relijis (p. 924).

sanctorale.07-06.title: Santu Maria Goretti, Virgo na Martir
sanctorale.07-06.collect:
God, yu Papa bilong ol pasin holi,
na yu save laikim ol manmeri i bihainim klinpela pasin.
Yu bin givim grasia long wokmeri bilong yu, Santu Maria Goretti,
na em i kamap Martir taim em i yangpela yet.
Na yu bin mekim klinpela pasin bilong em
i win long ol traim nogut.
Long pre bilong em,
helpim mipela long holim strong ol lo bilong yu,
bai mipela tu i ken kisim gutpela pe long han bilong yu.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.07-06.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Martir: bilong wanpela Virgo Martir (p. 885). O Misa bilong ol Virgo: bilong wanpela Virgo (p. 910).

sanctorale.07-07.title: Santu Pita To Rot, Martir
sanctorale.07-07.collect:
God, oltaim yu save was long Sios bilong yu
i wokabaut yet long dispela graun,
olsem na oltaim yu save bilasim em wantaim ol nupela Santu.
Na yu save strongim Sios wantaim ol pasin bilong ol Martir
i bin kapsaitim blut bilong ol bilong givim witnes long yu.
Mipela i pre, bai pre na pasin bilong Santu Pita To Rot
i ken helpim mipela long sanap strong long bilip,
na long painim helpim bilong marimari bilong yu
long taim bilong traim.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.07-07.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Martir: bilong wanpela Martir (p. 874).

sanctorale.07-09.title: Santu Ogastin Sao Rong, Pris, Wantaim ol Lain Martir bilong Saina
sanctorale.07-09.collect:
God, long gutpela save bilong yu,
yu bin strongim Sios bilong yu long witnes
bilong Martir Santu Ogastin wantaim ol lain Martir bilong em.
Mipela i askim yu,
bai pipel bilong yu i ken inapim gut ol wok yu bin givim long ol.
Olsem na ol bai inap long kamap fri,
na givim witnes long tok i tru bilong yu
long olgeta manmeri bilong graun.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.07-09.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Martir: bilong planti Martir (p. 865).

sanctorale.07-11.title: Santu Benedik, Abbot

entrance.text:
Em i wanpela gutpela man, na laip bilong em, em i stret olgeta. Nem
bilong em, Benedik. God i bin blesim em. Em i lusim haus bilong
em wantaim olgeta samting bilong em. Long wanem, em i laik i stap
wantaim God tasol.

sanctorale.07-11.collect:
God, yu bin mekim Abbot Santu Benedik
i kamap wanpela bikpela tisa insait long Sios bilong yu.
Em i bin skulim ol manmeri long bihainim laik bilong yu tasol,
na long mekim wok bilong yu.
Mipela i pre, bai i no gat wanpela samting
i ken pasim mipela long laikim yu.
Olsem na bai mipela tu i ken laikim yu moa long olgeta samting,
na wokabaut oltaim long rot bilong ol lo bilong yu.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.07-11.offerings:
Lord, lukdaun long dispela ofa holi,
mipela i bringim i kam long de bilong tingim Santu Benedik.
Mipela i pre, helpim mipela long bihainim pasin bilong em,
bai mipela tu i ken wok strong long painim yu tasol.
Olsem na bai mipela i ken wok gut wantaim, na painim bel isi.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Dispela wokman i gat gutpela tingting, na i save gut long wok bilong
em. Bikpela i bin makim em bilong bosim famili bilong em, na bilong
skelim kaikai bilong ol.

sanctorale.07-11.postcommunion:
Lord, mipela i kisim pinis kaikai bilong laip bilong oltaim.
Mipela i pre, strongim mipela
long bihainim ol skul bilong Santu Benedik,
bai mipela i ken mekim wok bilong yu,
na laikim wanpela narapela.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.07-13.title: Santu Henri
sanctorale.07-13.collect:
God, yu bin givim grasia long Santu Henri
bilong stiaim gut kantri bilong em hia long graun,
na dispela wok i bin helpim em long winim heven.
Mipela i askim yu, bai pre bilong em i ken helpim mipela
namel long ol hevi na wari bilong dispela graun,
bai mipela i ken wokabaut oltaim long rot i go long yu
wantaim klinpela bel na klinpela tingting.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.07-13.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Santu Manmeri: bilong wanpela Santu (p. 919).

sanctorale.07-14.title: Santu Kamilus bilong Lellis, Pris
sanctorale.07-14.collect:
God, yu bin givim grasia long Pris Santu Kamilus
bilong soim marimari long ol manmeri i gat sik.
Mipela i askim yu, long pre bilong em,
salim spirit bilong laikim pasin bilong yu i kam long mipela,
bai mipela i ken mekim wok bilong helpim ol bratasusa.
Olsem na long taim mipela i laik lusim dispela graun,
mipela bai i amamas long kam long yu.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.07-14.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Santu Manmeri: bilong ol manmeri i bin mekim wok marimari (p. 927).

sanctorale.07-15.title: Santu Bonaventura, Bisop na Tisa bilong Sios
sanctorale.07-15.collect:
God, yu strong olgeta, tude mipela i tingim de
bilong Bisop Santu Bonaventura i go long heven.
Mipela i askim yu,
helpim mipela long kisim save long ol skul bilong em,
na long bihainim laikim pasin bilong em,
bai mipela i ken laikim yu wantaim olgeta strong bilong mipela.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
