Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.07-15.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong wanpela Bisop (p. 890). O Misa bilong ol Tisa bilong Sios (p. 906).

sanctorale.07-16.title: Santu Maria Virgo bilong Maunten Karmel
sanctorale.07-16.collect:
Lord, pre bilong Santu Maria Virgo
i ken helpim mipela oltaim,
bai mipela i ken kisim strong long lukaut bilong em,
na bai mipela i ken kamap long gutpela maunten, em Krais yet.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.

sanctorale.07-20.title: Santu Apollinaris, Bisop na Martir
sanctorale.07-20.collect:
Lord, stiaim ol bilipmanmeri bilong yu
long rot bilong laip bilong oltaim,
wankain olsem Bisop Santu Apollinaris i bin soim
long skul na long indai bilong em olsem Martir.
Long pre bilong em,
helpim mipela long bihainim ol lo bilong yu,
bai bihain mipela i ken amamas wantaim em long heven.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.07-20.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Martir: bilong wanpela Martir (p. 874). O Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong wanpela Bisop (p. 890).

sanctorale.07-21.title: Santu Lorens bilong Brindisi, Pris na Tisa bilong Sios
sanctorale.07-21.collect:
God, yu bin bilasim sol bilong Pris Santu Lorens
wantaim spirit bilong skelim gut ol kain kain tingting,
na yu bin mekim em i sanap strong long taim bilong traim.
Na em i mekim wok bilong em bilong givim glori long yu,
na bilong helpim ol manmeri long i go long heven.
Mipela i askim yu, helpim mipela long save gut
long wanem wok mipela i mas mekim.
Na long pre bilong em, strongim mipela,
bai mipela i ken inapim gut ol dispela wok.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.07-21.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong wanpela Wasman (p. 895). O Misa bilong ol Tisa bilong Sios (p. 906). O Misa bilong ol Santu Manmeri: bilong ol Relijis (p. 924).

sanctorale.07-22.title: SANTU MARIA MAGDALENA

entrance.text:
Bikpela i tokim Maria Magdalena olsem, “Yu mas i go long ol brata
bilong mi, na tokim ol olsem, ‘Mi bai i go long Papa bilong mi, na Papa
bilong yupela, long God bilong mi, na God bilong yupela.’”
I gat Ona long God i stap antap.

sanctorale.07-22.collect:
God, taim Pikinini bilong yu i bin Kirap Bek,
em i laik bungim Maria Magdalena pastaim,
na em i bin salim em i go long tokaut long amamas bilong Ista.
Mipela i askim yu,
long pre na gutpela eksampel bilong Santu Maria Magdalena,
helpim mipela long tokaut oltaim olsem, Krais i stap laip.
Na bihain, kisim mipela i go long glori bilong yu long heven,
bai mipela i ken lukim em i stap King inap oltaim.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.07-22.offerings:
Lord, kisim ol dispela presen, mipela i bringim i kam
long de bilong tingim Santu Maria Magdalena.
Mipela i pre, bai yu ken amamas long ol presen bilong mipela,
wankain olsem Pikinini bilong yu i bin amamas
long gutpela pasin bilong Santu Maria Magdalena.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.
sanctorale.07-22.prefaceText:
Tru, em i gutpela na i stret,
oltaim na long olgeta ples,
mipela i tenkim yu, Lord, yu Papa na yu holi tru,
yu strong olgeta na yu God bilong oltaim.
Marimari bilong yu na strong bilong yu em i wankain tasol.
Olsem na oltaim mipela i mas tokaut
long Gutnius bilong yu long olgeta manmeri,
long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

Long gaden bilong matmat,
Krais i bin kamap long Maria Magdalena pastaim.
Long wanem, taim Krais i stap laip,
Maria i bin laikim em tru.
Taim Krais i dai long Diwai Kros,
Maria i bin witnesim indai bilong em.
Taim Krais i slip long matmat,
Maria i bin wok long painim em.
Na taim Krais i kirap bek,
Maria em i bin namba wan long adorim em.
Olsem na Krais i bin givim bikpela ona long em,
na makim em long kamap aposel,
bai em i ken bringim tok i go long ol Aposel,
na bai Gutnius bilong laip i ken kamap
long olgeta hap bilong graun.

Olsem na wantaim ol Ensel na ol Santu,
mipela tu i litimapim nem bilong yu,
Lord, na mipela i amamas na i sing (tok):

communion.text:
Laikim pasin bilong Krais i kirapim yumi, bai ol manmeri i stap laip, ol
i no ken tingting long ol yet tasol. Nogat. Ol i mas i tingting long Krais.
Long wanem, em bin dai na kirap bek bilong helpim ol.

sanctorale.07-22.postcommunion:
Lord, dispela Sakramen, mipela i kisim pinis,
i ken strongim mipela long bihainim pasin
bilong Santu Maria Magdalena long laikim tru Krais,
em i Tisa bilong em.
Em i stap laip na em i King, nau na oltaim.

sanctorale.07-23.title: Santu Bridget, Relijis
sanctorale.07-23.collect:
God, yu bin stiaim Santu Bridget
long olgeta wokabaut bilong em,
na em i bin tingting oltaim long Pen na Indai
bilong Pikinini bilong yu,
olsem na yu bin givim save bilong Diwai Kros long em.
Mipela i pre, helpim mipela long wokabaut oltaim
long rot yu bin makim bilong mipela,
bai mipela i ken wok long painim yu tasol.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.07-23.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Santu Manmeri: bilong ol Santu Meri (p. 930). O Misa bilong ol Santu Manmeri: bilong ol Relijis (p. 924).

sanctorale.07-24.title: Santu Sarbellus Makhluf, Pris
sanctorale.07-24.collect:
God, yu bin singautim Pris Santu Sarbellus
long i go long ples i no gat man,
bai em i ken i stap wantaim yu tasol.
Na long dispela ples, em i bin pait wantaim ol traim nogut,
na yu bin givim planti gutpela pasin holi long holi.
Mipela i askim yu,
helpim mipela long bihainim Pen na Indai bilong Bikpela,
bai mipela i ken i stap wantaim em long Kingdom bilong Heven.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.07-24.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong wanpela Wasman (p. 895). O Misa bilong ol Santu Manmeri: bilong ol Relijis (p. 924).

sanctorale.07-25.title: SANTU JEMS, APOSEL

entrance.text:
Jisas i wokabaut arere long solwara bilong Galili, na em i lukim Jems,
pikinini bilong Sebedi, wantaim brata bilong em, Jon. Tupela i wok
long stretim ol umben. Na Jisas i singautim tupela.
I gat Ona long God i stap antap.

sanctorale.07-25.collect:
God, yu strong olgeta na yu stap oltaim.
Aposel Santu Jems em i namba wan Aposel
i bin kapsaitim blut bilong em bilong givim witnes long Krais.
Na indai bilong em i bin mekim planti kaikai i kamap.
Mipela i askim yu,
bai bilip bilong Santu Jems i ken strongim Sios bilong yu,
na pre bilong em i ken helpim Sios long i stap gut.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.07-25.offerings:
Lord, tude em i Pestode bilong Santu Jems,
em i namba wan Aposel i bin dring
long kap bilong pen bilong Krais.
Mipela i pre,
long strong i kam long Pen na Indai bilong Pikinini bilong yu,
mekim mipela i kamap klin,
bai dispela sakrifais, mipela i laik ofarim nau,
i ken kamap stret long ai bilong yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Tupela i bin dring long kap bilong Bikpela, na tupela i bin kamap pren
bilong God.

sanctorale.07-25.postcommunion:
Lord, yu bin mekim mipela i amamas
long Pestode bilong Aposel Santu Jems,
na mipela i bin kisim ol presen holi bilong yu.
Mipela i askim yu, harim ol pre bilong em,
na helpim mipela oltaim.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.07-26.title: Santu Joakim na Ana, Papamama bilong Santu Maria Virgo

entrance.text:
Yumi litimapim nem bilong Joakim na Ana. Long wanem, long lain
bilong tupela, Bikpela i bin mekim kamap wanpela blesing bilong
helpim olgeta lain manmeri.

sanctorale.07-26.collect:
Lord, yu God bilong ol tumbuna bilong mipela.
Yu bin givim grasia long Santu Joakim na Ana,
na tupela i kamap papamama bilong Santu Maria,
em i Mama bilong Pikinini bilong yu i kamap man.
Mipela i askim yu,
bai pre bilong tupela i ken helpim pipel bilong yu
long kisim laip bilong oltaim,
em i dispela laip bipo yu bin promis long ol.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.07-26.offerings:
Lord, kisim ol dispela presen,
mipela i laik ofarim bilong litimapim nem bilong yu.
Mipela i pre, bai mipela tu i ken kisim dispela blesing
yu bin promis long Abraham
na long ol lain pikinini i kamap bihain long em.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Ol i bin kisim blesing bilong Bikpela. Na God, em i Sevia bilong ol, i
bin marimari long ol.

sanctorale.07-26.postcommunion:
God, Pikinini bilong yu i bin kamap man,
bilong mekim olgeta manmeri
i kamap nupela gen long laip i kam long yu.
Mipela i pre, Spirit bilong yu i ken helpim mipela
long i stap gutpela pikinini bilong yu.
Long wanem, long marimari bilong yu,
nau tasol yu bin givim Bret bilong ol pikinini long mipela.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.07-28.title: Santu Maria Virgo, Kwin bilong bel isi
sanctorale.07-28.collect:
God, yu Bikpela bilong mipela.
Yu bin salim Pikinini bilong yu i kam long graun
bilong bringim bel isi.
Long pre bilong Santu Maria, em i Virgo oltaim,
harim ol singaut bilong mipela.
Mipela i askim yu, givim gutpela taim long mipela,
bai mipela i ken bel isi na i stap gut olsem wanpela famili.
Na helpim mipela, bai mipela i ken laikim wanpela narapela.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.

sanctorale.07-29.title: Santu Marta, Maria na Lasarus

entrance.text:
Jisas i go insait long wanpela ples, na wanpela meri, nem bilong Marta,
i kisim em i go long haus bilong em.

sanctorale.07-29.collect:
God, Pikinini bilong yu i bin kirapim Lasarus long matmat,
na planti taim em i bin i go long haus bilong Marta.
Mipela i pre, bai mipela tu
i ken mekim mekim wok bilong helpim Krais,
taim mipela i mekim wok bilong helpim ol bratasusa.
Olsem na bai mipela i ken bihainim pasin bilong Maria,
na tingting oltaim long olgeta tok bilong em.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.07-29.offerings:
Lord, taim mipela i tingim ol Santu,
mipela i tokaut long ol bikpela wok yu bin mekim long ol.
Mipela i pre,
bai yu ken laikim na kisim dispela ofa bilong mipela,
wankain olsem yu bin laikim wok bilong ol Santu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Marta i tokim Jisas olsem, “Yu Krais, yu Pikinini bilong God i gat laip,
na i kam long dispela graun.”

sanctorale.07-29.postcommunion:
Lord, mipela i bin kisim Bodi na Blut
bilong Pikinini bilong yu.
Dispela Sakramen i ken helpim mipela
long abrusim pasin bilong tingting tumas
long ol samting bilong dispela graun.
Mipela i pre, helpim mipela long bihainim pasin
bilong Santu Marta, Maria na Lasarus,
bai mipela i ken laikim yu taim mipela i stap yet long graun,
na bihain mipela i ken lukim yu long heven inap oltaim.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.07-30.title: Santu Pita Krisologus, Bisop na Tisa bilong Sios
sanctorale.07-30.collect:
God, yu bin mekim Bisop Santu Pita Krisologus
i kamap wanpela bikpela Tisa,
na em i bin skulim ol manmeri long Tok bilong yu i kamap man.
Long pre bilong em, helpim mipela long tingting oltaim
long ol wok yu bin mekim bilong kisim bek mipela,
na long soim dispela bilip long ol pasin bilong mipela.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.07-30.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong wanpela Bisop (p. 890). O Misa bilong ol Tisa bilong Sios (p. 906).

sanctorale.07-31.title: Santu Ignesius bilong Loyola, Pris

entrance.text:
Long nem bilong Jisas olgeta samting long heven na long graun na
aninit long graun i mas brukim skru. Na olgeta maus i mas tokaut olsem
Jisas Krais em i Bikpela, bilong givim glori long God Papa.

sanctorale.07-31.collect:
God, yu bin givim Santu Ignesius long Sios bilong yu,
bai em i ken skulim olgeta manmeri
long mekim wok bilong givim glori long nem bilong yu tasol.
Mipela i askim yu, bai pre bilong em i ken helpim mipela
long mekim wok bilong yu hia long graun,
na long kisim laip bilong oltaim wantaim em long heven.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.07-31.offerings:
God, yu Bikpela bilong mipela.
Kisim dispela ofa bilong mipela, long de bilong Santu Ignesius.
Dispela Sakramen em i as bilong olgeta pasin i holi.
Mipela i pre, bai em i ken helpim mipela long kamap holi,
na long bihainim olgeta tok i tru.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Bikpela i tok olsem, “Mi bin kam bilong tromoi paia long graun, na mi
laikim tumas bai dispela paia i lait.”

sanctorale.07-31.postcommunion:
Lord, tude mipela i tingim Santu Ignesius,
na mipela i bin ofarim dispela sakrifais bilong tenkim yu.
Mipela i pre, bai dispela sakrifais i ken helpim mipela
long onarim biknem bilong yu oltaim.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.08-01.title: Santu Alfons Liguori, Bisop na Tisa bilong Sios
sanctorale.08-01.collect:
God, oltaim yu save givim ol Santu long Sios bilong yu,
bilong soim pasin holi long mipela.
Bisop Santu Alfons i bin wok hat
bilong helpim ol manmeri long save long yu,
na bilong helpim ol long wokabaut long rot bilong salvesen.
Mipela i pre, bai mipela i ken bihainim ol pasin bilong em,
na kisim gutpela pe wantaim em long heven.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.08-01.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong wanpela Bisop (p. 890). O Misa bilong ol Tisa bilong Sios (p. 906).
sanctorale.08-01.offerings:
Lord, taim Santu Alfons i bin ofarim dispela Sakramen long yu,
em i save ofarim em yet
olsem sakrifais i holi long ai bilong yu.
Mipela i pre, bai Spirit bilong yu
i ken laitim paia bilong laikim pasin insait long mipela tu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.
sanctorale.08-01.postcommunion:
God, yu bin givim Santu Alfons long mipela,
bai em i ken i stap gutpela wasman,
na bai em i ken skulim ol manmeri long Sakramen bilong Yukaris.
Mipela i pre, helpim ol bilipmanmeri bilong yu
long kisim dispela Sakramen planti taim,
bai ol i ken litimapim nem bilong yu inap oltaim.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.08-02.title: Santu Oisibius bilong Verselli, Bisop
sanctorale.08-02.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong wanpela Bisop (p. 890).
sanctorale.08-02.collect:
God, yu Bikpela bilong mipela.
Bisop Santu Oisibius i bin wok strong
bilong skulim ol manmeri long Pikinini bilong yu em i God tru.
Mipela i pre, bai mipela i ken holim dispela bilip bilong em,
na kisim laip i kam long Pikinini bilong yu.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.

sanctorale.08-03.title: Santu Dominik, Pris

entrance.text:
Em i bin autim tok namel long Sios, na Bikpela i bin pulapim em
long spirit bilong gutpela save na stretpela tingting. Na Bikpela i bin
karamapim em long klos bilong glori.

sanctorale.08-03.collect:
Lord, Santu Dominik i bin tokaut oltaim long tok i tru bilong yu,
na ol skul bilong em i bin kirapim tingting bilong ol manmeri.
Mipela i askim yu, bai ol gutpela pasin na skul bilong em
i ken helpim mipela na long Sios bilong yu.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.08-03.offerings:
Lord, marimari long mipela,
na harim ol pre mipela i mekim
wantaim helpim bilong Santu Dominik.
Long strong bilong dispela sakrifais, givim grasia bilong yu
long ol manmer i save skulim ol arapela long bilip,
na lukautim ol oltaim.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Dispela wokman i gat gutpela tingting, na i save gut long wok bilong
em. Bikpela i bin makim em bilong bosim famili bilong em, na bilong
skelim kaikai bilong ol.

sanctorale.08-03.postcommunion:
Lord, mipela i bin kisim dispela Sakramen bilong heven,
long de bilong tingim Santu Dominik.
Pastaim em i bin mekim Sios bilong yu i gro long skul bilong em.
Mipela i askim yu, bai pre bilong em i ken helpim Sios
long kisim oltaim strong i kam long dispela kaikai.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.08-04.title: Santu Jon Viani, Pris
sanctorale.08-04.collect:
God, yu strong olgeta, na yu pulap long marimari.
Yu bin mekim Pris Santu Jon Viani
i kamap gutpela wasman tru.
Na em i bin givim em yet olgeta long mekim wok aposel
bilong helpim ol manmeri.
Mipela i askim yu, bai pre na pasin bilong em
i ken helpim mipela long bringim ol bratasusa i kam long Krais,
bai mipela i ken kamap wantaim ol long laip bilong oltaim.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.08-04.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong wanpela Wasman (p. 895).

sanctorale.08-05.title: Blesing bilong Haus Lotu bilong Santu Maria, long Ples Rom
sanctorale.08-05.collect:
Lord, marimari long ol wokmanmeri bilong yu,
na lusim ol sin bilong ol.
Mipela i save, ol wok bilong mipela yet i no inap long yu.
Mipela i askim yu, bai pre bilong Mama bilong Pikinini bilong yu
i ken helpim mipela long kisim laip bilong oltaim.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.

sanctorale.08-06.title: BIKPELA JISAS I KAMAP NARAKAIN

entrance.text:
Insait long wanpela klaut i lait tumas ol i lukim Holi Spirit, na ol i harim
maus bilong Papa i tok olsem, “Dispela em i Pikinini bilong mi. Mi
laikim em tumas, na mi amamas long em. Yupela harim tok bilong em.”

sanctorale.08-06.collect:
God, tude mipela i tingim Pikinini bilong yu i kamap narakain,
long ai bilong tupela tumbuna, Moses na Elaija.
Long dispela pasin, yu bin strongim bilip bilong mipela,
na yu bin soim rot long mipela bilong kamap pikinini bilong yu.
Mipela i pre, helpim mipela, ol wokmanmeri bilong yu,
long harim tok bilong Pikinini bilong yu,
na bihain bringim mipela i go i stap wantaim em
long Kingdom bilong Heven.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.08-06.offerings:
Lord, mekim ol dispela ofa i kamap holi.
Tude mipela i selebretim Pikinini bilong yu i kamap narakain.
Mipela i pre, bai lait bilong em
i ken rausim olgeta sin bilong mipela.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.
sanctorale.08-06.preface: Prefasio: Misteri bilong Bikpela i kamap narakain.
sanctorale.08-06.prefaceText:
Tru, em i gutpela na i stret,
oltaim na long olgeta ples,
mipela i tenkim yu, Lord, yu Papa na yu holi tru,
yu strong olgeta na yu God bilong oltaim.
Givim tenkyu long yu em i wok bilong mipela,
na em i kisim bek mipela,
long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

Em i bin soim glori bilong em
long ai bilong ol tripela disaipel.
Bodi bilong em, em i wankain olsem bodi bilong mipela.
Tasol nau em i lait olgeta olsem san, na em i kamap narakain.
Krais i mekim olsem bilong helpim ol disaipel,
bai ol i no ken sem long em i mas i karim pen
na i dai long Diwai Kros.
Nau mipela tu i save olsem, wanpela de bai i kamap,
na dispela glori i bin lait long Krais, em bai i lait long Sios tu.
Long wanem, Krais em i Het bilong Sios,
na Sios em i Bodi bilong em.

Olsem na wantaim ol strongpela Ensel bilong heven,
mipela hia long graun i litimapim nem bilong yu,
na oltaim mipela i sing (tok):

communion.text:
Taim Krais i kamap ples klia, yumi bai i kamap olsem em. Long wanem,
yumi bai inap lukim em tru.

sanctorale.08-06.postcommunion:
Lord, yu bin mekim Pikinini bilong yu i kamap narakain,
na glori bilong em i kamap ples klia.
Mipela i pre, bai dispela kaikai bilong heven,
nau tasol mipela i kisim pinis,
i ken mekim mipela i senis na i kamap wankain olsem em.
Em i stap laip na em i King, nau na oltaim.

sanctorale.08-07.title: Santu Sikstas 2, Pop na Martir, Wantaim ol Lain Martir
sanctorale.08-07.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Martir: bilong planti Martir (p. 865).
sanctorale.08-07.collect:
God, yu strong olgeta, Santu Sikstas
wantaim ol lain Martir bilong em i bin givim laip bilong ol,
bilong givim witnes long tok bilong yu na long Jisas.
Mipela i pre, bai Holi Spirit i ken helpim mipela
long bilip strong, na long tokaut oltaim long bilip bilong mipela.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.

sanctorale.08-08.title: Santu Mary MacKillop, Relijis

entrance.text:
Bikpela i tok olsem, “Yupela kam long mi. Yupela i gat blesing bilong
Papa bilong mi. Mi gat sik, na yupela i bin lukautim mi. Mi tok tru
long yupela, olgeta samting yupela i bin mekim long wanpela bilong ol
dispela brata bilong mi i no gat nem liklik, ol dispela samting yupela i
bin mekim long mi.”

sanctorale.08-08.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Santu Manmeri: bilong ol Relijis (p. 924). O Misa bilong ol Santu Manmeri: bilong ol manmeri i bin mekim wok marimari (p. 927).
sanctorale.08-08.collect:
God, yu as bilong olgeta gutpela samting.
Yu bin givim Santu Mary MacKillop long mipela,
bilong skulim mipela long pasin bilong bilip
na bilong kisim strong i kam long Diwai Kros.
Mipela i askim yu,
helpim mipela long bihainim pasin bilong em,
bai mipela i ken givim witnes long Gutnius long dispela taim nau,
na bai mipela i ken mekim wok
bilong rispektim olgeta manmeri bilong kantri bilong mipela.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.08-08.offerings:
God, tude mipela i tingim Santu Mary bilong Diwai Kros,
na yu bin bungim mipela klostu long holi alta bilong yu.
Olsem na mipela i bringim ol ofa i kam long yu,
bilong litimapim nem bilong yu,
na bilong askim yu long helpim mipela.
Mipela i pre, bai ol dispela ofa
i ken strongim laikim pasin na bilip bilong mipela.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Bikpela i tok olsem, “Sapos yupela wan wan i laikim tru ol arapela,
orait dispela bai i soim olgeta man olsem, yupela i disaipel bilong mi.”

sanctorale.08-08.postcommunion:
God, yu Bikpela bilong mipela.
Dispela Sakramen, mipela i kisim pinis
long de bilong tingim Santu Mary MacKillop,
i ken strongim mipela long wokabaut long rot bilong Diwai Kros,
na i ken bringim mipela long glori bilong Kirap Bek.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.08-09.title: Santu Teresia Benedikta bilong Diwai Kros (Edith Stein), Virgo na Martir
sanctorale.08-09.collect:
God bilong ol tumbuna bilong mipela,
yu bin stiaim Martir Santu Teresia Benedikta
long save long Pikinini bilong yu i dai long Diwai Kros,
na yu bin helpim em long bihainim lek mak bilong Krais
inap long givim laip bilong em yet na i dai.
Long pre bilong em, helpim olgeta manmeri
long luksave olsem Krais em i Sevia bilong ol,
bai ol i ken pas long em,
na kamap long ples bilong lukim yu inap oltaim.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.08-09.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Martir: bilong wanpela Virgo Martir (p. 885). O Misa bilong ol Virgo: bilong wanpela Virgo (p. 910).

sanctorale.08-10.title: SANTU LORENS, DIKEN NA MARTIR

entrance.text:
Santu Lorens i bin givim laip bilong em bilong helpim Sios. Em i karim
pen na i dai olsem Martir. Olsem na Bikpela Jisas Krais i kisim em i go
long heven wantaim bikpela amamas.
I gat Ona long God i stap antap.

sanctorale.08-10.collect:
God, yu bin laitim paia bilong laikim pasin
insait long lewa bilong Santu Lorens,
na em i bin mekim gut wok bilong yu, na i dai olsem Martir.
Mipela i pre, bai mipela i ken laikim ol samting em yet i bin laikim,
na mipela i ken mekim ol pasin em yet i bin skulim mipela.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.08-10.offerings:
Lord, kisim dispela ofa, mipela i bringim i kam long yu
long pestode bilong Santu Lorens.
Mipela i pre, bai dispela ofa i ken helpim mipela
long kisim laip bilong oltaim.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Bikpela i tok olsem, “Sapos wanpela man i mekim wok bilong mi, em i
mas bihainim mi. Na long ples mi stap long em, wokman bilong mi tu
bai i stap wantaim mi.”

sanctorale.08-10.postcommunion:
Lord, yu bin pulapim mipela long ol presen bilong heven.
Mipela i pre, bai dispela Misa,
mipela i bin mekim long pestode bilong Santu Lorens,
i ken mekim grasia bilong yu i gro insait long mipela,
na yu ken kisim bek mipela.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.08-11.title: Santu Klara, Virgo
sanctorale.08-11.collect:
God, long marimari bilong yu,
yu bin stiaim Santu Klara
long bihainim laip bilong ol manmeri i no gat planti samting.
Long pre bilong em, helpim mipela long bihainim Krais gut,
na long lusim ol mangal bilong graun,
bai wanpela de mipela i ken lukim yu
long Kingdom bilong Heven.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.08-11.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Virgo: bilong wanpela Virgo (p. 910). O Misa bilong ol Santu Manmeri: bilong wanpela Sista (p. 923).

sanctorale.08-12.title: Santu Jen Franses bilong Santal, Relijis
sanctorale.08-12.collect:
God, yu bin singautim Santu Jen Franses
long mekim wok bilong yu
long kain kain rot long laip bilong em.
Long pre bilong em,
helpim mipela long inapim gut ol wok bilong mipela,
bai wokabaut bilong mipela i ken kamap
wanpela gutpela eksampel i givim lait long ol arapela manmeri.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.08-12.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Santu Manmeri: bilong ol Relijis (p. 924).

sanctorale.08-13.title: Santu Ponsian, Pop na Martir, na Santu Hipolitus, Pris na Martir
sanctorale.08-13.collect:
Lord, tude mipela i tingim Santu Ponsian na Hipolitus.
Mipela i pre, bai pen na indai bilong tupela
i ken helpim mipela long laikim yu moa yet,
na i ken strongim bilip insait long hat bilong mipela.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.08-13.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Martir: bilong planti Martir (p. 865). O Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong planti Wasman (p. 894).

sanctorale.08-14.title: Santu Maksimilian Kolbe, Pris na Martir

entrance.text:
Bikpela i tok olsem, “Yupela kam long mi. Yupela i gat blesing bilong
Papa bilong mi. Mi tok tru long yupela, olgeta samting yupela i bin
mekim long wanpela bilong ol dispela brata bilong mi i no gat nem
liklik, ol dispela samting yupela i bin mekim long mi.”

sanctorale.08-14.collect:
God, yu bin pulapim Pris na Martir Santu Maksimilian
long bikpela laik bilong onarim Maria Virgo i no gat sin.
Na yu bin mekim em i lus tru long laikim ol arapela manmeri,
na long mekim wok bilong helpim ol long kamap long heven.
Long pre bilong em,
helpim mipela long bihainim pasin bilong Pikinini bilong yu,
bai mipela i ken mekim wok bilong helpim ol manmeri
inap long indai bilong mipela.
Na mekim bai dispela wok bilong mipela
i ken givim glori long yu tasol.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.08-14.offerings:
Lord, mipela i bringim ol dispela presen i kam long yu
long de bilong tingim Santu Maksimilian.
Mipela i pre, bai mipela i ken bihainim pasin bilong em,
na ofarim laip mipela yet olsem wanpela ofa i go long yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Bikpela i tok olsem, “Sapos wanpela man i laikim tumas ol pren bilong
em, na em i lusim laip bilong em yet bilong helpim ol, orait dispela
pasin i winim tru ol arapela pasin bilong laikim ol arapela manmeri.”

sanctorale.08-14.postcommunion:
Lord, mipela i bin kisim nupela strong
long Bodi na Blut bilong Pikinini bilong yu.
Mipela i pre, mekim bai dispela Sakramen
i ken laitim paia bilong laikim pasin insait long mipela,
wankain olsem em i bin laitim insait long Santu Maksimilian.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.08-15.title: ASUNSIO BILONG SANTU MARIA VIRGO (God i kisim Santu Maria i go long heven)

entrance.text:
Wanpela bikpela mak i kamap long heven: wanpela meri i pasim san
olsem klos bilong em. Na mun i stap aninit long lek bilong em. Na 12-
pela sta i stap olsem hat bilong kwin long het bilong em.

alt.text: Yumi mas amamas long Bikpela, long dispela pestode bilong onarim Maria Virgo. Ol Ensel i amamas long lukim Maria i go antap long heven, na ol i litimapim nem bilong Pikinini bilong God.

sanctorale.08-15.collect:
God, yu strong olgeta na yu stap oltaim.
Maria Virgo i no gat sin,
na em i Mama bilong Pikinini bilong yu.
Na tude yu bin kisim em i go long glori bilong heven,
wantaim bodi na sol bilong em.
Mipela i pre, helpim mipela long tingting oltaim
long ol samting bilong antap,
bai wanpela de mipela tu i ken kisim glori wantaim em.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.08-15.offerings:
Lord, dispela ofa na pre bilong mipela
i ken kamap long pes bilong yu,
long dispela de bilong tingim Santu Maria Virgo i go long heven.
Harim ol pre bilong em,
na laitim paia bilong laikim pasin insait long hat bilong mipela,
bai mipela i ken mangal oltaim long yu tasol.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.
sanctorale.08-15.preface: bilong dispela Bikpela Pestode yet. Lukim neks Misa.

communion.text:
Nau na bihain tu bai olgeta lain manmeri i tok long God i bin givim
bikpela amamas long mi. Long wanem, God i strong olgeta i bin mekim
narakain samting tru bilong helpim mi.

sanctorale.08-15.postcommunion:
Lord, tude mipela i tingim Santu Maria Virgo,
yu bin kisim em i go long heven,
na mipela i bin kisim dispela Sakramen bilong laip bilong oltaim.
Mipela i askim yu, bai pre bilong Santu Maria
i ken helpim mipela long kamap long glori bilong kirap bek.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.
sanctorale.08-15.prefaceText:
Tru, em i gutpela na i stret,
oltaim na long olgeta ples,
mipela i tenkim yu, Lord, yu Papa na yu holi tru,
yu strong olgeta na yu God bilong oltaim.
Givim tenkyu long yu em i wok bilong mipela,
na em i kisim bek mipela,
long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

Tude mipela i tingim Santu Maria Virgo,
em i Mama bilong God,
na God yet i bin kisim em i go long heven.
Olsem na Maria i kamap piksa bilong Sios i holi olgeta
na i stap wan wantaim God.
Asunsio bilong Maria i save givim hop na bel isi
long pipel bilong yu i wokabaut yet long dispela graun,
na i wet long kisim nupela laip.

God Papa, yu no bin larim bodi bilong Santu Maria
i bagarap long matmat. Nogat.
Long wanem, Pikinini bilong yu i bin kamap man
insait long bel bilong Maria,
na Pikinini bilong yu i save givim laip long olgeta samting.

Olsem na wantaim ol Ensel,
mipela i amamas long litimapim nem bilong yu,
na mipela i sing (tok):

sanctorale.08-16.title: Santu Stiven bilong Hangari
sanctorale.08-16.collect:
God, yu strong olgeta,
taim Santu Stiven i stap king long dispela graun,
em i bin mekim planti wok bilong helpim Sios bilong yu i gro.
Mipela i askim yu, bai pre bilong em
i ken helpim Sios wantaim strong i kam long heven.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.08-16.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Santu Manmeri: bilong wanpela Santu (p. 919).

sanctorale.08-19.title: Santu Jon Eudes, Pris
sanctorale.08-19.collect:
God, yu bin makim Pris Santu Jon Eudes
bilong skulim ol manmeri long bikpela save bilong Krais.
Mipela i askim yu, bai ol pasin na skul bilong em
i ken helpim mipela long save gut long yu,
na long wokabaut oltaim long lait bilong Gutnius.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.08-19.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong wanpela Wasman (p. 895). O Misa bilong ol Santu Manmeri: bilong ol Relijis (p. 924).

sanctorale.08-20.title: Santu Bernard, Abbot na Tisa bilong Sios

entrance.text:
Bikpela i bin pulapim Santu Bernard long spirit bilong gutpela save.
Na em i bin helpim ol pipel bilong God wantaim ol gutpela skul.

sanctorale.08-20.collect:
God, yu bin pulapim Abbot Santu Bernard
long bikpela laik bilong helpim Sios, em i haus bilong yu.
Na yu bin mekim em i kamap olsem wanpela lam
i givim lait long ol arapela manmeri.
Long pre bilong em,
kirapim paia bilong laikim pasin insait long mipela,
bai mipela i ken wokabaut oltaim olsem pikinini bilong lait.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.08-20.offerings:
Lord, long tok na pasin bilong em,
Santu Bernard i bin wok strong bilong kamapim
gutpela taim na pasin wanbel insait long Sios bilong yu.
Tude mipela i tingim em,
na mipela i ofarim dispela Sakramen long yu.
Dispela Sakramen em i Sakramen bilong bel isi
na bilong helpim mipela long kamap wan.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Bikpela i tok olsem, “Papa i laikim mi tumas, na long wankain pasin mi
bin laikim yupela. Oltaim yupela i mas i stap insait long dispela laikim
bilong mi.”

sanctorale.08-20.postcommunion:
Lord, tude mipela i selebretim pestode bilong Santu Bernard,
na mipela i bin kisim kaikai bilong heven.
Mipela i pre, bai dispela kaikai i ken wok insait long mipela,
na em i ken helpim mipela long bihainim gut
ol pasin na skul bilong Santu Bernard,
bai mipela tu i ken laikim Krais, em i Tok bilong yu i kamap man.
Em i stap laip na em i King, nau na oltaim.

sanctorale.08-21.title: Santu Paius 10, Pop
sanctorale.08-21.collect:
God, yu bin makim Pop Santu Paius 10
bilong lukautim gut Katolik bilip,
na bilong mekim olgeta samting i bihainim laik bilong Krais.
Olsem na yu bin pulapim em long save i kam long heven
na long strong bilong ol Aposel.
Mipela i askim yu,
strongim mipela long bihainim ol skul na pasin bilong em,
bai mipela i ken kisim pe bilong oltaim.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.08-21.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong wanpela Pop (p. 887).
sanctorale.08-21.offerings:
Lord, marimari long mipela,
na kisim dispela ofa bilong mipela.
Mipela i pre, helpim mipela
long bihainim ol skul bilong Pop Santu Paius,
bai mipela i ken selebretim dispela Sakramen bilong heven
wantaim gutpela lotu, na kisim em wantaim bikpela bilip.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.
sanctorale.08-21.postcommunion:
God, yu Bikpela bilong mipela,
tude mipela i selebretim de bilong tingim Pop Santu Paius 10.
Mipela i askim yu, bai strong bilong dispela kaikai bilong heven
i ken strongim bilip bilong mipela,
na i ken helpim mipela long pas wantaim laikim pasin bilong yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.08-22.title: Santu Maria Virgo em i Kwin

entrance.text:
Kwin i sanap long raithan bilong yu, na ol i bin wokim ol klos bilong
em long gol. Em i bilasim em yet gut tru.

sanctorale.08-22.collect:
God, yu bin mekim Mama bilong Pikinini bilong yu
i kamap Mama na Kwin bilong mipela.
Mipela i askim yu, marimari long mipela,
na long pre bilong em,
helpim mipela long kamap long Kingdom bilong Heven,
bai mipela i ken kisim dispela glori
yu bin promis long ol pikinini bilong yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.
sanctorale.08-22.offerings:
Lord, tude mipela i tingim Santu Maria Virgo,
na mipela i ofarim ol dispela presen long yu.
Mipela i pre, bai mipela i ken kisim strong long Krais,
long wanem, em i bin ofarim em yet long Diwai Kros
olsem wanpela sakrifais i klin olgeta.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.
sanctorale.08-22.preface: 1 bilong Santu Maria Virgo (long Pestode), p. 520. O Prefasio 2 bilong Santu Maria Virgo, p. 521.

communion.text:
Maria, yu ken amamas tru. Long wanem, yu bin bilip long Bikpela bai
i mekim olsem em i bin tokim yu.

sanctorale.08-22.postcommunion:
Lord, tude mipela i tingim Santu Maria Virgo,
na mipela i bin kisim dispela Sakramen bilong heven.
Mipela i pre, bai dispela Sakramen i ken helpim mipela
long kamap long kaikai bilong oltaim long heven.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.08-23.title: Santu Rosa bilong Lima, Virgo
sanctorale.08-23.collect:
God, yu bin pulapim lewa bilong Santu Rosa
long paia bilong laikim pasin i go long yu.
Olsem na em i bin givim baksait long ol samting bilong graun,
na mekim kain kain wok penans,
long wanem, em i laik givim em yet olgeta long yu.
Long pre bilong em,
helpim mipela long bihain pasin bilong em hia long graun,
bai bihain mipela i ken painim amamas wantaim yu long heven.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.08-23.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Virgo: bilong wanpela Virgo (p. 910).

sanctorale.08-24.title: SANTU BARTOLOMYU, APOSEL

entrance.text:
Olgeta de yupela i mas tokaut long God i bin kisim bek yumi. Yupela i
mas stori long glori bilong em long olgeta lain pipel.
I gat Ona long God i stap antap.

sanctorale.08-24.collect:
Lord, Aposel Santu Bartolomyu
i bin bilip long Pikinini bilong yu,
na em i bihainim em gut.
Mipela i askim yu,
bai pre bilong em i ken strongim bilip bilong mipela,
na i ken mekim Sios bilong yu i kamap
Sakramen bilong kisim bek olgeta manmeri bilong graun.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.08-24.offerings:
Lord, tude mipela i selebretim pestode
bilong Aposel Santu Bartolomyu,
na mipela i ofarim dispela sakrifais
bilong litimapim nem bilong yu.
Mipela i askim yu, harim ol pre bilong em,
na helpim mipela oltaim.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Bikpela i tok olsem, “Papa bilong mi, em i givim Kingdom long mi.
Olsem tasol mi givim Kingdom long yupela. Na long Kingdom bilong
mi, yupela bai i sindaun long tebol bilong mi, na kaikai na dring.”

sanctorale.08-24.postcommunion:
Lord, mipela i amamas long selebretim
pestode bilong Aposel Santu Bartolomyu,
na mipela i bin kisim promis bilong laip bilong oltaim.
Mipela i askim yu,
bai dispela Sakramen i ken helpim mipela long dispela laip,
na i ken bringim mipela long laip bilong oltaim.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.08-25.title: Santu Luis
sanctorale.08-25.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Santu Manmeri: bilong wanpela Santu (p. 919).
sanctorale.08-25.collect:
God, Santu Luis i bin mekim gutpela wok king hia long graun,
olsem na yu bin bringim em
i go long glori bilong Kingdom bilong Heven.
Mipela i askim yu, bai ol pre bilong em i ken helpim mipela
long mekim gut ol wok bilong mipela hia long graun,
bai bihain mipela i ken kamap
long Kingdom bilong yu i stap oltaim.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.

sanctorale.08-27.title: Santu Monika
sanctorale.08-27.collect:
God, yu save mekim gut bel bilong ol manmeri i bel hevi.
Olsem na yu bin marimari long Santu Monika,
na yu bin kisim olgeta aiwara em i bin kapsaitim
bilong helpim pikinini bilong em Ogastin long tanim bel.
Mipela i askim yu, bai pre bilong tupela wantaim
i ken helpim mipela long krai sori long ol sin bilong mipela,
na long wok strong bilong painim grasia na marimari bilong yu.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.08-27.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Santu Manmeri: bilong ol Santu Meri (p. 930).

sanctorale.08-28.title: Santu Ogastin, Bisop na Tisa bilong Sios

entrance.text:
Em i bin autim tok namel long Sios, na Bikpela i bin pulapim em
long spirit bilong gutpela save na stretpela tingting. Na Bikpela i bin
karamapim em long klos bilong glori.

sanctorale.08-28.collect:
Lord, yu bin pulapim Bisop Santu Ogastin
long spirit bilong yu, na em i bin mangal long yu tasol.
Mipela i pre, kirapim gen dispela spirit insait long Sios bilong yu,
bai mipela tu i ken mangal long yu tasol,
na bai mipela i ken wok long painim yu.
Long wanem, yu tasol yu as bilong olgeta gutpela save,
na yu as bilong amamas bilong heven.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.08-28.offerings:
Lord, long dispela Misa mipela i tingim wok bilong yu
bilong kisim bek mipela,
na mipela i singaut long marimari bilong yu.
Mipela i pre, bai dispela Sakramen bilong marimari
i ken helpim mipela long i stap wan,
na long laikim wanpela narapela.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Bikpela i tok olsem, “Yupela i gat wanpela Tisa tasol, em i Krais. Na
yupela olgeta i stap bratasusa.”

sanctorale.08-28.postcommunion:
Lord, dispela kaikai bilong tebol bilong Krais
i ken helpim mipela long kamap holi,
na em i ken mekim mipela i kamap olsem Krais.
Long wanem, Krais em i Het bilong Sios
na mipela ol memba bilong em,
na nau yet mipela i bin kisim em long Santu Komunio.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.08-29.title: Pen na Indai bilong Santu Jon bilong Baptais

entrance.text:
Bikpela, mi bin tokaut long ol tok bilong yu long ai bilong ol king, na
mi no kisim sem. Mi bin skelim ol lo bilong yu, na mi bin laikim ol
tumas.

sanctorale.08-29.collect:
God, yu bin makim Santu Jon bilong Baptais,
bai em i go pas long Pikinini bilong yu.
Olsem na mama i bin karim em pastaim long Krais,
na tu em i bin dai pastaim long Krais.
Mipela i pre, bai mipela i ken sanap strong long bilip,
na givim witnes long olgeta skul bilong yu.
Long wanem, Santu Jon i bin dai olsem Martir,
bilong givim witnes long tok tru
na long stretpela pasin bilong yu.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.08-29.offerings:
Lord, Santu Jon bilong Baptais
i bin skulim ol manmeri long ples nating,
na em i bin kapsaitim blut bilong em
bilong givim witnes long yu.
Mipela i pre, bai ol dispela presen, mipela i ofarim long yu,
i ken helpim mipela long bihainim stretpela rot bilong yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Jon i bekim tok olsem, “Nem bilong em i mas kamap bikpela, na nem
bilong mi i Yu mas i go daun.”

sanctorale.08-29.postcommunion:
Lord, mipela i amamas long selebretim
de bilong Santu Jon bilong Baptais i go long heven,
na mipela i bin kisim dispela Sakramen bilong kisim bek mipela.
Mipela i pre, bai mipela i ken onarim oltaim dispela Sakramen,
na amamas long wok bilong em insait long mipela.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.
sanctorale.08-29.prefaceText:
Tru, em i gutpela na i stret,
oltaim na long olgeta ples,
mipela i tenkim yu, Lord, yu Papa na yu holi tru,
yu strong olgeta na yu God bilong oltaim.
Givim tenkyu long yu em i wok bilong mipela,
na em i kisim bek mipela,
long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

Santu Jon bilong Baptais i bin i go pas long Krais,
bilong redim rot bilong em.
Olsem na mipela i litimapim nem bilong yu,
long wanem, yu bin makim em bilong mekim dispela wok.
Na yu bin givim biknem long em
i winim nem bilong ol arapela manmeri.

Bikpela amamas i kamap taim mama i bin karim em.
Na taim em i stap yet long bel bilong mama,
em i bin amamas na kalap,
long wanem, salvesen bilong ol manmeri klostu i laik kam.

Na namel long ol profet, Jon wanpela tasol
i bin soim Lem bilong God i kam pinis
bilong kisim bek olgeta manmeri.

Krais i bin kamapim Sakramen bilong Baptais,
tasol Jon i baptaisim em.
Na taim em i mekim olsem, wara i kamap holi.
Na bihain Jon i bin kapsaitim blut bilong em,
bilong givim witnes long Krais.

Olsem na wantaim ol strongpela Ensel bilong heven,
mipela hia long graun i litimapim nem bilong yu,
na oltaim mipela i sing (tok):

sanctorale.09-03.title: Santu Gregori, Pop na Tisa bilong Sios

entrance.text:
Taim Santu Gregori i bin sindaun long sia bilong Pita, oltaim em i laik
lukim pes bilong Bikpela, na em i bin wokabaut long laikim pasin
bilong Bikpela.

sanctorale.09-03.collect:
God, yu save lukautim pipel bilong yu wantaim marimari,
na yu save stiaim ol wantaim laikim pasin.
Long pre bilong Pop Santu Gregori,
givim spirit bilong gutpela save
long ol man yu bin makim bilong i go pas.
Na helpim ol sipsip long bihainim pasin holi,
bai ol wasman i ken kisim amamas bilong oltaim.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.09-03.offerings:
Lord, tude mipela i tingim Santu Gregori,
na mipela i ofarim dispela sakrifais long yu.
Mipela i pre, bai dispela sakrifais i ken helpim mipela.
Long wanem, long strong dispela ofa
yu bin tekewe ol sin bilong olgeta manmeri bilong graun.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Dispela wokman i gat gutpela tingting, na i save gut long wok bilong
em. Bikpela i bin makim em bilong bosim famili bilong em, na bilong
skelim kaikai bilong ol.

sanctorale.09-03.postcommunion:
Lord, long dispela de bilong tingim Santu Gregori,
yu bin givim Krais long mipela, em i Bret i gat laip.
Mipela i pre, bai Krais, em i Tisa bilong mipela,
i ken skulim mipela long tok i tru bilong yu,
na em i ken helpim mipela long bihainim dispela tok i tru
long ol wok marimari bilong mipela.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.09-05.title: Santu Teresa bilong Kolkata, Virgo
sanctorale.09-05.collect:
God, taim Pikinini bilong yu i hangamap long Diwai Kros,
nek bilong em i drai olgeta.
Na yu bin singautim Virgo Santu Teresa
long bekim laikim pasin bilong Pikinini bilong yu.
Olsem na em i bin laikim tru ol tarangu,
na em i bin marimari long ol.
Mipela i askim yu, long pre bilong em,
helpim mipela long mekim wok bilong helpim Krais
taim mipela i mekim wok bilong helpim ol bratasusa i karim pen.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.09-05.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Virgo: bilong wanpela Virgo (p. 910).

sanctorale.09-08.title: TINGIM DE MAMA I KARIM SANTU MARIA VIRGO

entrance.text:
Yumi mas amamas long tingim de bilong mama i karim Santu Maria
Virgo. Long wanem, Maria Virgo i karim Krais, na Krais em i God
bilong yumi, na em i san i soim lait bilong stretpela pasin.
I gat Ona long God i stap antap.

sanctorale.09-08.collect:
Lord, salim grasia bilong heven i kam long mipela,
ol wokmanmeri bilong yu.
Tude mipela i tingim de, mama i karim Santu Maria Virgo,
na mipela i tingim Pikinini bilong em i bin kisim bek mipela.
Mipela i pre, bai dispela pestode i ken pulapim mipela
long gutpela taim na bel isi.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.09-08.offerings:
Lord, mipela i amamas long tingim de
bilong mama i karim Santu Maria Virgo,
na mipela i bringim ol ofa i kam long yu.
Pikinini bilong yu yet i bin kamap man
long bel bilong Maria Virgo.
Mipela i pre, bai Pikinini bilong yu i ken helpim mipela nau.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.
sanctorale.09-08.preface: 1 bilong Santu Maria Virgo (long de bilong tingim mama i karim), p. 520. O Prefasio 2 bilong Santu Maria Virgo, p. 521.

communion.text:
Lukim! Wanpela virgo bai i karim wanpela pikinini man. Na dispela
pikinini bai i lusim sin bilong pipel bilong em, na kisim bek ol.

sanctorale.09-08.postcommunion:
Lord, Sios bilong yu i amamas long tingim de
mama i karim Santu Maria Virgo.
Long wanem, Maria Virgo i bin givim hop long ol manmeri,
na em i bringim salvesen i kam long graun.
Mipela i pre, bai Sios i ken amamas oltaim
long kamap nupela gen long strong i kam long dispela Sakramen.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.09-09.title: Santu Pita Klaver, Pris
sanctorale.09-09.collect:
God, yu bin mekim Santu Pita Klaver
i kamap olsem wokboi nating
bilong helpim ol wokmanmeri nating i stap long kalabus.
Na yu bin strongim em wantaim bikpela laikim pasin na pasin isi.
Mipela i askim yu, bai pre bilong em i ken helpim mipela
long wok strong bilong painim Jisas Krais,
na long laikim ol arapela manmeri long ol pasin bilong mipela.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.09-09.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong wanpela Wasman (p. 895). O Misa bilong ol Santu Manmeri: bilong ol manmeri i bin mekim wok marimari (p. 927).

sanctorale.09-12.title: Holi Nem bilong Maria WASSANTU BILONG SOLOMON AILANS

entrance.text:
Maria Virgo, yu ken amamas. Long wanem, God, em i Bikpela bilong
yumi na em God I Stap Antap Tru, em i bin blesim yu, na givim biknem
long yu i winim tru nem bilong olgeta meri bilong graun. Olsem na
oltaim olgeta manmeri bai i litimapim nem bilong yu.

sanctorale.09-12.collect:
God, yu strong olgeta,
mipela i tingim Nem bilong Santu Maria Virgo,
na mipela i amamas long bikpela glori yu bin givim long em.
Mipela i pre, harim ol pre bilong Santu Maria,
na marimari long mipela.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.09-12.offerings:
Lord, tude mipela onarim Nem bilong Santu Maria,
em i Virgo oltaim, na mipela i bringim dispela ofa i kam.
Mipela i askim yu, bai pre bilong em
i ken mekim dispela ofa i kamap stret long ai bilong yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Nau na bihain tu bai olgeta lain manmeri i tok long God i bin givim
bikpela amamas long mi. Long wanem, God i bin lukim daunpasin
bilong wokmeri bilong em.

sanctorale.09-12.postcommunion:
Lord, tude mipela i onarim Nem bilong Santu Maria,
em i Mama bilong God.
Mipela i askim yu, long pre bilong em,
salim blesing bilong yu i kam long mipela,
na mekim bai mipela i ken pilim helpim bilong em
long olgeta nid bilong mipela.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.09-13.title: Santu Jon Krisostom, Bisop na Tisa bilong Sios

entrance.text:
Ol man i gat gutpela save bai i lait olsem skai i lait tumas. Na ol man i
bin skulim ol arapela long bihainim stretpela pasin, ol bai i lait oltaim
olsem ol sta.

sanctorale.09-13.collect:
God, yu strong bilong ol manmeri i hop long yu.
Yu bin givim bikpela save long Bisop Santu Jon Krisostom
bilong givim ol gutpela skul,
na yu bin mekim em i sanap strong long taim bilong karim pen.
Mipela i pre, bai mipela i ken kisim save long ol skul bilong em,
na kisim strong long pasin isi bilong em.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.09-13.offerings:
God, mipela i tingim Santu Jon Krisostom,
na mipela i ofarim dispela sakrifais long yu.
Kisim dispela ofa, na mekim em i kamap stret long ai bilong yu.
Mipela i askim yu, bai mipela i ken bihainim ol skul bilong em,
na givim mipela yet long yu olsem wanpela gutpela ofa
bilong litimapim nem bilong yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Mipela i autim tok long Krais i dai long Diwai Kros. Krais em i strong
bilong God, na em i save bilong God.

sanctorale.09-13.postcommunion:
God bilong marimari, mipela i tingim Santu Jon Krisostom,
na mipela i bin kisim dispela Sakramen bilong yu.
Mipela i askim yu, bai dispela Sakramen
i ken strongim laikim pasin bilong mipela,
na em i ken mekim mipela i kamap witnes
bilong tok tru bilong yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.09-14.title: HOLI DIWAI KROS I WIN

entrance.text:
Yumi mas litimapim nem bilong Bikpela bilong yumi, Jisas Krais. Em
i dai long Diwai Kros. Krais em i salvesen bilong yumi, na em i laip
na kirap bek bilong yumi. Em i kisim bek yumi, na mekim yumi i
kamap fri.
I gat Ona long God i stap antap.

sanctorale.09-14.collect:
God, yu bin laik long Pikinini bilong yu i dai long Diwai Kros,
bilong kisim bek olgeta manmeri bilong graun.
Mipela i stap yet long graun,
na mipela i save pinis long misteri bilong em.
Mipela i askim yu, bai wok ridima bilong em
i ken givim mipela laip bilong oltaim long heven.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
Sapos dispela Pestode i kamap long Sande, i gat Tok Bilip.
sanctorale.09-14.offerings:
Lord, Krais i bin ofarim dispela ofa long alta bilong Diwai Kros,
na em i bin tekewe ol sin bilong olgeta manmeri bilong graun.
Mipela i pre, bai dispela ofa i ken mekim mipela i kamap klin
long ol sin bilong mipela.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.
sanctorale.09-14.preface: bilong dispela Pestode yet (lukim neks pes), o Prefasio 1 bilong Pen na Indai bilong Bikpela, p. 501.
sanctorale.09-14.prefaceText:
Tru, em i gutpela na i stret,
oltaim na long olgeta ples,
mipela i tenkim yu, Lord, yu Papa na yu holi tru,
yu strong olgeta na yu God bilong oltaim.
Givim tenkyu long yu em i wok bilong mipela,
na em i kisim bek mipela.

Long Diwai Kros, yu bin kisim bek olgeta manmeri bilong graun.
Bipo, indai i bin kamap long diwai bilong paradais.
Tasol nau, laip i kamap long Diwai Kros.
Bipo, Satan i bin win long diwai bilong Paradais.
Tasol nau em i lus olgeta long Diwai Kros,
long wok bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

Long em, ol Ensel i presim glori bilong yu.
Ol Dominion i adorim yu,
na ol strongpela lain bilong heven i guria long ai bilong yu.
Heven wantaim ol strongpela lain bilong heven,
na ol Serafim i litimapim nem bilong yu
wantaim bikpela amamas.
Na mipela tu i laik bung wantaim ol na givim ona long yu,
na mipela i sing (tok):

communion.text:
Bikpela i tok olsem, “Taim ol bai i litimapim mi antap long graun, orait
bai mi pulim olgeta manmeri i kam long mi.”

sanctorale.09-14.postcommunion:
Bikpela Jisas Krais,
mipela i bin kisim strong long dispela kaikai holi bilong yu.
Yu bin kisim bek mipela long Diwai Kros bilong yu,
na yu bin givim nupela laip long mipela.
Mipela i pre, givim laip bilong oltaim long mipela,
na bringim mipela long glori bilong kirap bek.
Yu stap laip na yu King, nau na oltaim.

sanctorale.09-15.title: Santu Maria Virgo i Krai long Indai bilong Jisas

entrance.text:
Simeon i tokim Maria olsem, “Lukim. God i makim pinis dispela
pikinini, bilong mekim planti Israel i pundaun, na bilong mekim planti
i kirap gen. Em bai i stap olsem wanpela mak, na planti man bai i givim
baksait long em. Na wanpela bainat bai i sutim sol bilong yu tu.”

sanctorale.09-15.collect:
God, taim ol i bin nilim Pikinini bilong yu long Diwai Kros,
Mama bilong em i bin sanap klostu,
na em i bin karim pen wantaim em.
Mipela i pre, helpim Sios bilong yu
long bihainim Santu Maria long Pen na Indai bilong Krais,
bai bihain Sios i ken kamap long amamas
bilong Kirap Bek bilong em.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.09-15.offerings:
God bilong marimari, taim Santu Maria Virgo
i sanap klostu long Diwai Kros bilong Jisas,
yu bin givim em long mipela
olsem gutpela Mama bilong mipela tu.
Tude mipela i onarim em, na mipela i litimapim nem bilong yu.
Mipela i pre, kisim ol dispela ofa bilong sakrifais,
na kisim tu ol pre bilong mipela.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.
sanctorale.09-15.preface: 1 bilong Santu Maria Virgo (long Pestode), p. 520. O Prefasio 2 bilong Santu Maria Virgo, p. 521.

communion.text:
Taim yupela i karim pen wantaim Krais, yupela i mas amamas. Olsem na
taim glori bilong em i kamap ples klia, yupela bai inap amamas moa yet.

sanctorale.09-15.postcommunion:
Lord, mipela i kisim pinis dispela Sakramen
bilong kisim bek mipela,
na mipela i bin tingim Santu Maria Virgo
i karim pen wantaim Pikinini bilong em.
Mipela i pre, bai mipela i ken karim pen wantaim Krais,
na pen bilong mipela i ken helpim Sios bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King, nau na oltaim.

sanctorale.09-17.title: Santu Konilius, Pop na Martir, na Santu Siprian, Bisop na Martir
sanctorale.09-17.collect:
God, yu bin givim Santu Konilius na Siprian
long pipel bilong yu olsem gutpela wasman
na strongpela Martir.
Mipela i askim yu, bai pre bilong tupela
i ken strongim bilip na ol gutpela pasin bilong mipela,
bai mipela i ken mekim wok bilong helpim Sios
long kamap wanbel.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.09-17.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Martir: bilong planti Martir (p. 865). O Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong wanpela Bisop (p. 890).
sanctorale.09-17.offerings:
Lord, kisim ol dispela presen bilong pipel bilong yu,
bilong onarim indai bilong ol Santu Martir bilong yu.
Dispela ofa i bin strongim Santu Konilius na Siprian
long taim bilong karim pen.
Mipela i pre, bai em i ken strongim mipela tu
long ol traim bilong laip bilong mipela.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.
sanctorale.09-17.postcommunion:
Lord, tude mipela i tingim Martir Santu Konilius na Siprian,
na mipela i bin kisim dispela Sakramen bilong yu.
Mipela i askim yu, strongim mipela long Spirit bilong yu,
bai mipela i ken bihainim pasin bilong dispela tupela Martir,
na kamap witnes bilong tok i tru i kam long Gutnius.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.09-19.title: Santu Januerius, Bisop na Martir
sanctorale.09-19.collect:
God, yu bin makim dispela de
bai mipela i ken onarim Martir Santu Januerius.
Mipela i pre, bai wanpela de mipela i ken bung wantaim em
long amamas bilong oltaim.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.09-19.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Martir: bilong wanpela Martir (p. 874). O Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong wanpela Bisop (p. 890).

sanctorale.09-20.title: Santu Andru Kim, Pris, na Pol Song Husang, Wantaim ol Lain Martir bilong Korea

entrance.text:
Blut bilong ol holi Martir i bin kapsait long graun bilong givim witnes
long Krais. Olsem na ol i bin kisim pe bilong oltaim.

sanctorale.09-20.collect:
God, yu laik bai ol manmeri bilong olgeta hap bilong graun,
i ken kamap pikinini bilong yu.
Na yu bin mekim blut bilong Martir Santu Andru
na ol lain Martir bilong em i karim kaikai
na kamapim bikpela lain Kristen.
Mipela i askim yu, bai pre bilong ol Martir i ken helpim mipela,
na pasin bilong ol i ken strongim mipela.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.09-20.offerings:
God, yu strong olgeta,
lukdaun long ol ofa bilong pipel bilong yu.
Na long pre bilong ol Santu Martir bilong yu,
mekim mipela i kamap wanpela sakrifais i stret long ai bilong yu,
bilong helpim wok bilong kisim bek ol manmeri bilong graun.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Bikpela i tok olsem, “Man o meri i save tokim ol manmeri olsem em i
stap long lain bilong mi, mi tu bai mi tokim Papa bilong mi long heven
olsem dispela man o meri em i bilong mi.”

sanctorale.09-20.postcommunion:
Lord, mipela i bin selebretim ol Santu Martir bilong yu,
na mipela i bin kisim kaikai i save strongim mipela.
Mipela i pre, bai mipela i ken bihainim Krais gut,
na mekim wok insait long Sios bilong kisim bek olgeta manmeri.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.09-21.title: SANTU MATYU, APOSEL NA EVANGELIS

entrance.text:
Bikpela i tok olsem, “Yupela i mas i go na mekim olgeta lain manmeri
i kamap disaipel bilong mi. Na yupela baptaisim ol, na lainim ol long
bihainim olgeta tok mi bin givim long yupela.”
I gat Ona long God i stap antap.

sanctorale.09-21.collect:
God, long bikpela marimari bilong yu,
yu bin makim Santu Matyu, man bilong kisim takis,
bilong kamap Aposel.
Mipela i askim yu, bai pre na pasin bilong em
i ken helpim mipela long bihainim yu gut.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.09-21.offerings:
Lord, tude mipela i tingim Santu Matyu,
na mipela i kisim ol pre na ofa bilong mipela i kam long yu.
Yu bin strongim bilip bilong Sios long skul bilong ol Aposel.
Mipela i pre, lukdaun long Sios bilong yu, na marimari long em.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Bikpela i tok olsem, “Mi no kam bilong singautim ol stretpela manmeri.
Nogat. Mi kam bilong singautim ol manmeri bilong sin.”

sanctorale.09-21.postcommunion:
Lord, bipo Santu Matyu i bin amamas
long welkamim Sevia long haus bilong em.
Na nau mipela tu i amamas long kisim dispela kaikai
i save givim laip bilong oltaim long mipela.
Mipela i pre, bai mipela i ken kisim oltaim dispela kaikai
long han bilong Krais.
Long wanem, em i no bin kam bilong singautim
ol stretpela manmeri. Nogat.
Em i bin kam bilong singautim ol manmeri bilong sin
long kisim laip bilong oltaim.
Em i stap laip na em i King, nau na oltaim.

sanctorale.09-23.title: Santu Pio bilong Pietrelsina, Pris
sanctorale.09-23.collect:
God, yu strong olgeta na yu stap oltaim.
Yu bin givim grasia long Pris Santu Pio,
na em i bin pas tru long Diwai Kros bilong Pikinini bilong yu.
Na long wok Pris bilong em, yu bin mekim marimari bilong yu
i wokim ol bikpela samting insait long ol manmeri.
Mipela i askim yu, harim ol pre bilong em,
na helpim mipela long pas oltaim long Pen na Indai bilong Krais,
bai mipela tu i ken kamap long glori bilong Kirap Bek bilong em.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.09-23.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong wanpela Wasman (p. 895). O Misa bilong ol Santu Manmeri: bilong ol Relijis (p. 924).

sanctorale.09-25.title: Bleset Jon Baptais Masukoni, Pris na Martir
sanctorale.09-25.collect:
God, yu bin laik long mekim Kingdom bilong yu i gro
long wok misin na long indai
bilong Martir Bleset Jon Masukoni.
Mipela i askim yu,
bai pre bilong em i ken helpim mipela
long laikim yu wantaim olgeta strong bilong mipela,
na long givim witnes long Gutnius bilong yu
inap long indai bilong mipela.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.09-25.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Martir: bilong wanpela misinari Martir (p. 884).

sanctorale.09-26.title: Santu Kosmas na Demian, Martir
sanctorale.09-26.collect:
Lord, tude mipela i tingim Santu Kosmas na Demian,
na mipela i litimapim nem bilong yu.
Long wanem, yu bin givim glori bilong oltaim long tupela,
na yu bin givim helpim bilong yu long mipela.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.09-26.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Martir: bilong planti Martir (p. 865).
sanctorale.09-26.offerings:
Lord, mipela i laik onarim indai bilong ol stretpela man,
olsem na mipela i ofarim dispela sakrifais long yu.
Long wanem, sakrifais bilong Misa em i as na strong
bilong ol Martir bilong yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.
sanctorale.09-26.postcommunion:
Lord, mipela i tingim Martir Santu Kosmas na Demian,
na mipela i bin kisim dispela presen long han bilong yu.
Mipela i askim yu, lukautim dispela presen insait long mipela,
bai em i ken oraitim mipela, na em i ken givim bel isi
na laip bilong oltaim long mipela.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.09-27.title: Santu Vinsen de Pol, Pris

entrance.text:
Spirit bilong Bikpela i stap long mi. Long wanem, Bikpela i bin welim
mi, na em i salim mi long autim Gutnius long ol tarangu, na long oraitim
ol manmeri i pilim sori long bel bilong ol.

sanctorale.09-27.collect:
God, yu bin pulapim Pris Santu Vinsen de Pol
wantaim ol pasin bilong ol Aposel,
bai em i ken helpim ol tarangu,
na skulim gut ol man i laik kamap Pris.
Mipela i pre, kirapim paia bilong Spirit insait long mipela,
bai mipela i ken laikim ol samting em yet i bin laikim,
na bai mipela i ken bihainim ol pasin em yet i bin skulim mipela.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.09-27.offerings:
God, yu bin helpim Santu Vinsen
long bihainim gut ol pasin bilong Krais,
em i selebretim long dispela Sakramen bilong heven.
Mipela i askim yu, bai strong bilong dispela sakrifais
i ken mekim mipela i kamap wanpela ofa i stret long ai bilong yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Ol i mas tenkim Bikpela long marimari bilong em, na long ol bikpela
wok em i mekim bilong helpim ol manmeri. Em i givim wara long ol
manmeri i dai long wara, na em i givim planti gutpela samting long ol
manmeri i hangre.

alt.text: Ol manmeri i krai i stap, em ol i ken amamas. Long wanem, bel bilong ol bai i gut gen. Ol manmeri i laikim tumas long stretpela pasin i kamap, long wankain pasin olsem man i hangre tru na i laikim tumas long kisim kaikai na i dai long wara, em ol i ken amamas. Long wanem, God bai inapim ol tru.

sanctorale.09-27.postcommunion:
Lord, mipela i bin kamap nupela gen
long dispela Sakramen bilong heven.
Mipela i askim yu, bai pre na pasin bilong Santu Vinsen
i ken strongim mipela long bihainim Pikinini bilong yu,
na long autim Gutnius long ol tarangu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.09-28.title: Santu Wenseslaus, Martir
sanctorale.09-28.collect:
God, yu bin skulim Martir Santu Wenseslaus
long laikim Kingdom bilong Heven
moa long olgeta samting bilong graun.
Long pre bilong em,
helpim mipela long daunim laik bilong mipela yet,
bai mipela i ken pas long yu tasol,
wantaim olgeta strong bilong mipela.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.09-28.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Martir: bilong wanpela Martir (p. 874).

sanctorale.09-29.title: SANTU MAIKEL, GEBRIEL NA RAFAEL, AKENSEL AKENSEL SANTU MAIKEL, WASENSEL BILONG PAPUA NIUGINI

entrance.text:
Yupela ol Ensel bilong Bikpela, yupela i mas litimapim nem bilong em.
Yupela i gat bikpela strong, na yupela i save bihainim tok bilong em,
na harim nek bilong em.
I gat Ona long God i stap antap.

sanctorale.09-29.collect:
God, long bikpela save bilong yu,
yu save makim ol wok bilong ol Ensel na bilong ol manmeri.
Na ol Ensel i save mekim wok bilong yu oltaim long heven.
Mipela i askim yu, bai wokabaut bilong mipela hia long graun,
i ken i stap oltaim aninit long lukaut bilong ol Ensel bilong heven.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.09-29.offerings:
Lord, mipela i ofarim dispela sakrifais long yu,
bilong litimapim nem bilong yu.
Mipela i pre, bai ol Ensel i ken bringim dispela sakrifais
i go long ai bilong yu long heven, na yu ken amamas long em,
na mekim em i kamap Sakramen bilong kisim bek mipela.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.
sanctorale.09-29.prefaceText:
Tru, em i gutpela na i stret,
oltaim na long olgeta ples,
mipela i tenkim yu, Lord, yu Papa na yu holi tru,
yu strong olgeta na yu God bilong oltaim.
Givim tenkyu long yu em i wok bilong mipela,
na em i kisim bek mipela.
Mipela i mas litimapim nem bilong yu oltaim
long wok yu bin mekim long ol Akensel na ol Ensel.

Yu save amamas long ol Ensel bilong heven,
na taim mipela i onarim ol,
mipela i givim ona long nem bilong yu yet.
Long wanem, yu yet i bin kamapim ol Ensel,
na namba na bilas bilong ol i soim mipela olsem,
yu tasol yu Bikpela, na yu strong olgeta, na yu stap antap tru,
long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

Long em, ol lain bilong Ensel i adorim glori bilong yu.
Na mipela tu i laik bung wantaim ol na givim ona long yu,
na mipela i sing (tok):

communion.text:
Bikpela, bai mi tenkim yu long bel bilong mi olgeta. Bai mi litimapim
nem bilong yu, long ai bilong ol Ensel.

sanctorale.09-29.postcommunion:
Lord, yu bin givim Bret bilong Heven long mipela.
Mipela i pre, bai dispela kaikai i ken strongim mipela,
na ol Ensel bilong yu i ken was long mipela,
bai oltaim mipela i ken wokabaut
long rot bilong laip bilong oltaim.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.09-30.title: Santu Jerom, Pris na Tisa bilong Sios

entrance.text:
Dispela man i ken amamas. Long wanem, em i save tingting long lo
bilong Bikpela long san na long nait. Na wok bilong em bai i karim
kaikai.

sanctorale.09-30.collect:
God, yu bin pulapim Pris Santu Jerom
long gutpela mangal bilong kisim save
long olgeta Tok bilong yu i kam long Buk Baibel.
Mipela i pre,
bai pipel bilong yu i ken painim strong long Tok bilong yu,
na dispela Tok i ken givim laip bilong oltaim long ol.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.09-30.offerings:
Lord, helpim mipela long bihainim pasin bilong Santu Jerom,
bai mipela tu i ken tingting oltaim long Tok bilong yu.
Na dispela Tok bilong yu i ken helpim mipela
long ofarim gut dispela sakrifais i save kisim bek mipela.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
God, yu Bikpela, mi bin painim ol tok bilong yu, na mi kisim ol olsem
man i kisim kaikai. Na tok bilong yu i bin givim bikpela amamas long
bel bilong mi.

sanctorale.09-30.postcommunion:
Lord, mipela i amamas long kisim dispela holi Sakramen
long de bilong tingim Santu Jerom.
Mipela i pre, helpim ol bilipmanmeri bilong yu
long putim yau long ol skul bilong yu.
Na givim gutpela tingting long ol,
bai ol i ken save gut long rot ol i mas bihainim
bilong kamap long laip bilong oltaim.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.10-01.title: Santu Teresia bilong Pikinini Jisas, Virgo na Tisa bilong Sios

entrance.text:
Bikpela yet i bin lukautim em na skulim em. Bikpela i bin was long em
olsem em i save was long ai bilong em yet. Olsem tarangau i opim wing
bilong em, olsem tasol Bikpela i bin karim em na lukautim em. Bikpela
tasol i bin soim rot long em.

sanctorale.10-01.collect:
God, yu save opim dua bilong Kingdom bilong yu,
bai ol manmeri bilong daunpasin na ol liklik pikinini
i ken kam insait. Mipela i askim yu,
helpim mipela long bihainim gut rot bilong Santu Teresia.
Na long pre bilong em,
bringim mipela long glori bilong yu long heven.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.10-01.offerings:
Lord, mipela i litimapim nem bilong yu
long ol bikpela wok yu bin mekim long Santu Teresia.
Nau mipela i daunim mipela yet, na mipela i askim yu,
kisim dispela ofa bilong mipela na amamas long em,
wankain olsem bipo yu bin amamas
long ol gutpela wok bilong Santu Teresia.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Bikpela i tok olsem, “Sapos yupela i no senis na kamap olsem ol liklik
pikinini, bai yupela i no inap i go insait long Kingdom bilong Heven.”

sanctorale.10-01.postcommunion:
Lord, dispela Sakramen, mipela i kisim pinis,
i ken laitim paia bilong laikim pasin insait long mipela.
Em dispela paia tasol i bin strongim Santu Teresia
long givim em yet olgeta long yu,
na long askim yu long marimari long olgeta manmeri.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.10-02.title: Ol Holi Ensel i Lukaut

entrance.text:
Yupela ol Ensel bilong Bikpela, yupela litimapim nem bilong Bikpela.
Yupela singsing amamas na litimapim nem bilong em oltaim.

sanctorale.10-02.collect:
God, yu save lukautim gut olgeta samting,
olsem na yu save salim ol holi Ensel bilong yu i kam,
na ol i was oltaim long mipela.
Mipela i pre, bai ol i ken lukautim mipela hia long graun,
na bihain mipela i ken amamas wantaim ol long heven
inap oltaim.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.10-02.offerings:
Lord, kisim ol dispela presen,
mipela i givim long yu bilong onarim ol holi Ensel bilong yu.
Mipela i pre, marimari long mipela,
na long helpim bilong ol Ensel,
tekewe ol samting nogut i laik bagarapim mipela,
na bringim mipela long laip bilong oltaim.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.
sanctorale.10-02.prefaceText:
Tru, em i gutpela na i stret,
oltaim na long olgeta ples,
mipela i tenkim yu, Lord, yu Papa na yu holi tru,
yu strong olgeta na yu God bilong oltaim.
Givim tenkyu long yu em i wok bilong mipela,
na em i kisim bek mipela.
Mipela i mas litimapim nem bilong yu oltaim
long wok yu bin mekim long ol Akensel na ol Ensel.

Yu save amamas long ol Ensel bilong heven,
na taim mipela i onarim ol,
mipela i givim ona long nem bilong yu yet.
Long wanem, yu yet i bin kamapim ol Ensel,
na namba na bilas bilong ol i soim mipela olsem,
yu tasol yu Bikpela, na yu strong olgeta, na yu stap antap tru,
long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

Long em, ol lain bilong Ensel i adorim glori bilong yu.
Na mipela tu i laik bung wantaim ol na givim ona long yu,
na mipela i sing (tok):

communion.text: God bilong mi, bai mi litimapim nem bilong yu, long ai bilong ol Ensel.

sanctorale.10-02.postcommunion:
Lord, yu bin strongim mipela
long dispela Sakramen i save givim laip bilong oltaim.
Mipela i pre, long wok bilong ol Ensel,
yu ken stiaim wokabaut bilong mipela
long rot bilong salvesen na bel isi.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.10-04.title: Santu Fransis bilong Assisi

entrance.text:
Fransis em i man bilong God. Em i bin lusim haus bilong em, na olgeta
samting bilong em, na em i laik kamap tarangu, na em i no gat wanpela
samting. Tasol Bikpela i bin litimapim nem bilong em.

sanctorale.10-04.collect:
God, yu bin mekim Santu Fransis
i kamap olsem Krais yet long pasin bilong daunim em yet
na long pasin bilong i stap tarangu.
Mipela i pre, helpim mipela long bihainim lek mak bilong Fransis,
bai mipela i ken wokabaut long rot bilong Pikinini bilong yu,
na amamas long laikim yu, na pas wantaim yu tasol.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.10-04.offerings:
Lord, dispela Sakramen em i sakrifais bilong Diwai Kros.
Mipela i askim yu, kisim ol ofa bilong mipela,
na helpim mipela long selebretim gut dispela sakrifais,
bai mipela i ken bihainim pasin bilong Santu Fransis,
na pas oltaim long Diwai Kros bilong Pikinini bilong yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Ol manmeri i stap rabis long spirit bilong ol, em ol i ken amamas. Long
wanem, Kingdom bilong Heven em i bilong ol.

sanctorale.10-04.postcommunion:
Lord, yu bin pulapim Santu Fransis
long bikpela laikim pasin, na long pasin bilong ol Aposel.
Mipela i pre, bai dispela holi Sakramen,
nau tasol mipela i bin kisim,
