i ken strongim mipela long bihainim ol pasin bilong em,
bai mipela i ken pilim laikim pasin bilong yu,
na mekim wok bilong kisim bek olgeta manmeri.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.10-05.title: Santu Faustina Kowalska, Virgo
sanctorale.10-05.collect:
God, yu bin makim Santu Faustina,
bai em i ken tokaut long olgeta manmeri
long bikpela marimari bilong yu i no gat arere bilong em.
Long pre bilong em, helpim mipela long trastim yu
wantaim olgeta strong bilong mipela.
Na strongim mipela, bai mipela i ken mekim planti wok marimari
bilong helpim ol arapela manmeri.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.10-05.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Virgo: bilong wanpela Virgo (p. 910). O Misa bilong ol Santu Manmeri: bilong ol Relijis (p. 924).

sanctorale.10-06.title: Santu Bruno, Pris
sanctorale.10-06.collect:
God, yu bin singautim Santu Bruno
long lusim ples bilong ol manmeri,
na long mekim wok bilong yu tasol long ples i no gat man.
Long pre bilong em, helpim mipela,
bai ol samting bilong dispela graun
i no ken paulim tingting bilong mipela,
na bai mipela i ken tingting long painim yu tasol.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.10-06.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Santu Manmeri: bilong wanpela Monk (p. 922). O Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong wanpela Wasman (p. 895).

sanctorale.10-07.title: Santu Maria Virgo bilong Pre Rosari

entrance.text:
Ave, Maria, yu pulap long grasia. Bikpela i stap wantaim yu. God i bin
mekim gut tru long yu, na givim yu blesing i winim blesing em i bin
givim long ol arapela meri. Na dispela pikinini i stap long bel bilong
yu, em tu i kisim blesing bilong God.

sanctorale.10-07.collect:
Lord, kapsaitim grasia bilong yu long hat bilong mipela.
Long tok bilong Ensel mipela i bin save olsem,
Krais, Pikinini bilong yu, i kamap man.
Long pre bilong Santu Maria Virgo,
na long wok bilong Pen na Indai bilong Krais long Diwai Kros,
bringim mipela long glori bilong Kirap Bek bilong em.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.10-07.offerings:
Lord, dispela ofa i ken helpim mipela
long kamap stret long ai bilong yu.
Mipela i pre, bai mipela i ken onarim gut
dispela Sakramen bilong Pikinini bilong yu,
bai bihain mipela i ken kisim ol samting
em i bin promisim mipela.
Em i stap laip na em i King, nau na oltaim.
sanctorale.10-07.preface: 1 bilong Santu Maria Virgo (long Pestode), p. 520. O Prefasio 2 bilong Santu Maria Virgo, p. 521.

communion.text:
Lukim! Yu bai i kisim bel, na karim wanpela pikinini man. Na yu mas
kolim nem bilong em Jisas.

sanctorale.10-07.postcommunion:
God, yu Bikpela bilong mipela.
Long dispela Sakramen mipela i tokaut gen
long Indai na Kirap Bek bilong Pikinini bilong yu.
Mipela i askim yu, helpim mipela long karim pen wantaim em,
bai em i ken pulapim mipela long bel isi bilong em,
na bihain em i ken bringim mipela long glori bilong heven.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.10-09.title: Santu Denis, Bisop, Wantaim ol Lain Martir
sanctorale.10-09.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Martir: bilong planti Martir (p. 865).
sanctorale.10-09.collect:
God, yu bin salim Santu Denis wantaim ol lain bilong em,
bilong telimautim biknem bilong yu long ol lain pipel.
Na yu bin givim pasin holi long ol,
bai ol i ken sanap strong long taim bilong karim pen na i dai.
Mipela i pre, strongim mipela long bihainim pasin bilong ol,
bai mipela i ken givim baksait long bilas bilong dispela graun,
na winim ol samting nogut i laik daunim mipela.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.

sanctorale.10-11.title: Santu Jon 23, Pop
sanctorale.10-11.collect:
God, yu strong olgeta na yu stap oltaim.
Yu bin givim Pop Santu Jon
long olgeta manmeri bilong graun,
bai em i ken kamap olsem piksa bilong Krais yet,
em i Gutpela Wasman bilong ol sipsip.
Mipela i askim yu, bai pre bilong em i ken helpim mipela
long soim laikim pasin bilong Krais long olgeta manmeri.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.10-11.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong wanpela Pop (p. 887).

sanctorale.10-14.title: Santu Kalistus 1, Pop na Martir
sanctorale.10-14.collect:
God, yu bin singautim Pop Santu Kalistus
long mekim wok bilong helpim Sios,
na long mekim wok bilong lukautim gut
ol matmat bilong ol Kristen manmeri i dai pinis.
Mipela i askim yu, bilip bilong em i ken strongim mipela,
bai mipela i ken lusim kalabus bilong sin,
na kisim laip bilong oltaim.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.10-14.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Martir: bilong wanpela Martir (p. 874). O Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong wanpela Pop (p. 887).

sanctorale.10-15.title: Santu Teresia bilong Jisas, Virgo na Tisa bilong Sios

entrance.text:
Olsem wel abus i dai long dring wara na i wok long painim baret i gat
wara, olsem tasol sol bilong mi i mangal long yu, God bilong mi. Sol
bilong mi i dai long painim yu, God i gat laip.

sanctorale.10-15.collect:
God, Spirit bilong yu i bin kirapim Santu Teresia
long soim rot bilong pasin holi long Sios bilong yu.
Mipela i pre, strongim mipela long ol gutpela skul bilong em,
bai mipela i ken mangal long bihainim pasin holi tasol.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.10-15.offerings:
Lord, kisim ol dispela presen bilong mipela,
na mekim ol i kamap stret long ai bilong yu.
Mipela i pre, bai yu ken laikim ol presen bilong mipela,
wankain olsem yu bin laikim ol gutpela wok bilong Santu Teresia.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Oltaim bai mi singim song i tokaut long marimari bilong Bikpela.
Oltaim maus bilong mi bai i tokaut olsem yu tru olgeta, na yu no save
senis.

sanctorale.10-15.postcommunion:
God, yu Bikpela bilong mipela.
Yu bin givim Bret bilong Heven long mipela,
ol famili bilong yu.
Mipela i pre, bai mipela i ken bihainim pasin bilong Santu Teresia,
na singsing amamas long marimari bilong yu inap oltaim.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.10-16.title: Santu Hetwik, Relijis
sanctorale.10-16.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Santu Manmeri: bilong ol Relijis (p. 924). O Misa bilong ol Santu Manmeri: bilong ol Santu Meri (p. 930).
sanctorale.10-16.collect:
God, yu strong olgeta,
long daunpasin bilong Santu Hetwik,
yu bin skulim mipela long wanem kain pasin yu save laikim.
Long pre bilong em,
salim helpim bilong heven i kam long mipela.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.

sanctorale.10-17.title: Santu Ignesius bilong Antiok, Bisop na Martir

entrance.text:
Mi hangamap long Diwai Kros wantaim Krais, na mi stap laip. Tasol
dispela laip em i no laip bilong mi yet. Nogat. Krais i stap laip long mi.
Mi stap laip long bilip bilong Pikinini bilong God. Em i bin laikim mi
tru, na em i lusim laip bilong em yet bilong helpim mi.

sanctorale.10-17.collect:
God, yu strong olgeta na yu stap oltaim.
Yu save bilasim Sios bilong yu long gutpela pasin
na long witnes bilong ol Santu Martir.
Tude mipela i tingim Santu Ignesius bilong Antiok.
Long pen na indai bilong em, em i bin kisim glori bilong heven.
Mipela i askim yu, bai pre bilong em i ken helpim mipela oltaim.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.10-17.offerings:
Lord, kisim dispela ofa wantaim ol wok bilong mipela,
na mekim em i kamap stret long ai bilong yu.
Santu Ignesius i bin lusim laip bilong em
olsem wanpela pikinini wit i dai,
na ofa bilong em i kamap gutpela
wankain olsem ofa bilong Krais.
Mipela i pre, bai yu ken amamas long ofa bilong mipela,
wankain olsem yu bin amamas long pen na indai bilong em.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Mi pikinini wit bilong Krais. Ol tit bilong ol wel abus i mas kaikaim
mi, bai mi ken kamap gutpela bret i no gat doti long em.

sanctorale.10-17.postcommunion:
Lord, tude mipela i tingim Santu Ignesius,
na mipela i bin kisim Bret bilong Heven.
Mipela i pre, bai dispela Bret bilong Heven
i ken mekim mipela i kamap nupela,
na i ken helpim mipela long kamap trupela Kristen,
long nem na long pasin bilong mipela.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.10-18.title: SANTU LUK, EVANGELIS

entrance.text:
Em i naispela tumas long lukim man i wokabaut long maunten, na em
i kam bilong bringim gutnius bilong bel isi na bilong gutpela taim. Na
em i tokaut olsem God i laik kisim bek olgeta manmeri.
I gat Ona long God i stap antap.

sanctorale.10-18.collect:
God, yu Bikpela bilong mipela,
yu bin makim Santu Luk,
bai long ol skul na buk bilong em,
em i ken tokaut long bikpela laik bilong yu i go long ol tarangu.
Mipela i pre, bai ol manmeri i save amamas long nem bilong yu,
ol i ken kamap wanpela hat na wanpela sol tasol,
na olgeta lain manmeri i ken save long salvesen i kam long yu.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.10-18.offerings:
Lord, ol dispela presen bilong heven
i ken helpim mipela long mekim gut wok bilong yu.
Mipela i askim yu,
bai ol ofa mipela i mekim long pestode bilong Santu Luk,
i ken oraitim mipela,
na i ken bringim mipela long laip bilong oltaim.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Bikpela i bin salim ol disaipel i go long olgeta taun, na ol i mas tokaut
olsem, Kingdom bilong God i kam klostu pinis.

sanctorale.10-18.postcommunion:
God, yu strong olgeta, mipela i askim yu,
bai dispela presen mipela i bin kisim long alta bilong yu,
i ken mekim mipela i kamap holi.
Na em i ken helpim mipela long kamap strong long bilip
i kam long Gutnius, Santu Luk yet i bin telimautim.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.10-19.title: Santu Jon de Brebeuf na Aisak Joks, Pris na Martir, Wantaim ol Lain Martir
sanctorale.10-19.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Martir: bilong ol misinari Martir (p. 883).
sanctorale.10-19.collect:
God, yu bin makim Santu Jon na Aisak wantaim ol lain Martir,
bai ol i ken soim hop long Kingdom bilong yu i no save pinis.
Olsem na ol i bin karim pen na i kapsaitim blut bilong ol.
Mipela i askim yu,
bai ol pre bilong ol i ken strongim bilip bilong olgeta Kristen.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.

sanctorale.10-22.title: Santu Jon Pol 2, Pop
sanctorale.10-22.collect:
God, yu pulap long marimari,
na yu bin makim Pop Santu Jon Pol 2
bai em i go pas long Sios bilong yu long olgeta hap bilong graun.
Mipela i askim yu,
helpim mipela long bihainim ol skul bilong em,
bai mipela i ken opim hat bilong mipela long grasia bilong Krais.
Long wanem, Krais tasol em i Ridima bilong olgeta manmeri.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.10-22.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong wanpela Pop (p. 887).

sanctorale.10-23.title: Santu Jon bilong Kapestrano, Pris
sanctorale.10-23.collect:
God, yu bin kirapim Santu Jon bilong Kapestrano
bilong helpim ol bilipmanmeri bilong yu
i bin painim hevi na taim nogut.
Na em i bin wok hat bilong mekim gut bel bilong ol.
Mipela i pre, putim mipela aninit long lukaut bilong yu,
na givim gutpela taim long Sios bilong yu.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.10-23.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong wanpela Misinari (p. 902). O Misa bilong ol Santu Manmeri: bilong ol Relijis (p. 924).

sanctorale.10-24.title: Santu Antoni Klaret, Bisop
sanctorale.10-24.collect:
God, yu bin pulapim Bisop Santu Antoni Klaret
wantaim laikim pasin na pasin isi,
bai em i ken autim Gutnius long olgeta lain pipel.
Long pre bilong em,
helpim mipela long tingting long ol samting bilong yu tasol,
bai mipela i ken mekim wok
bilong helpim ol bratasusa long kam long Krais.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.10-24.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong wanpela Misinari (p. 902). O Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong wanpela Bisop (p. 890).

sanctorale.10-28.title: SANTU SAIMON NA JUT, APOSEL

entrance.text:
Bikpela i bin makim ol dispela man holi, long wanem, em i laikim ol
tumas. Na em i givim glori bilong oltaim long ol.
I gat Ona long God i stap antap.

sanctorale.10-28.collect:
God, long wok bilong ol Santu Aposel,
yu bin mekim mipela i save long nem bilong yu.
Mipela i askim yu, bai pre bilong Santu Saimon na Jut
i ken mekim Sios bilong yu i gro,
na i ken helpim planti lain pipel long bilip long yu.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.10-28.offerings:
Lord, tude mipela i tingim tupela Aposel Santu Saimon na Jut,
na mipela i amamas long glori yu bin givim long tupela.
Mipela i askim yu, kisim ol pre bilong mipela,
na helpim mipela long selebretim gut dispela holi Sakramen.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Bikpela i tok olsem, “Man o meri i laikim mi, em bai i bihainim gut ol
tok bilong mi. Na Papa bilong mi bai i laikim em. Na mitupela bai i
kam long em, na i stap wantaim em.”

sanctorale.10-28.postcommunion:
Lord, mipela i tingim pen na indai
bilong tupela Aposel Saimon na Jut,
na mipela i bin kisim dispela Sakramen bilong yu.
Mipela i pre, bai long strong bilong Holi Spirit,
yu ken helpim mipela long pas oltaim
long laikim pasin bilong yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.11-01.title: OLGETA SANTU

entrance.text:
Yumi mas amamas long Bikpela, long dispela pestode bilong onarim
olgeta Santu. Ol Ensel i amamas long dispela de, na ol i litimapim nem
bilong Pikinini bilong God.
I gat Ona long God i stap antap na Tok Bilip.

sanctorale.11-01.collect:
God, yu strong olgeta na yu stap oltaim.
Yu laik bai mipela i makim dispela de
bilong tingim ol gutpela wok na pasin bilong olgeta Santu.
Mipela i bilip long ol Santu i save pre bilong helpim mipela.
Nau mipela i askim yu, harim ol pre bilong ol,
na marimari long mipela.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.11-01.offerings:
Lord, mipela i laik onarim olgeta Santu,
na mipela i bringim dispela ofa i kam long yu.
Mipela i bilip olsem ol Santu i kisim pinis laip bilong oltaim.
Mipela i pre, bai mipela i ken pilim helpim bilong pre bilong ol.
Long wanem, ol i save pre bilong helpim mipela
long kamap long laip bilong oltaim.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.
sanctorale.11-01.prefaceText:
Tru, em i gutpela na i stret,
oltaim na long olgeta ples,
mipela i tenkim yu, Lord, yu Papa na yu holi tru,
yu strong olgeta na yu God bilong oltaim.
Givim tenkyu long yu em i wok bilong mipela,
na em i kisim bek mipela.

Tude yu mekim mipela i amamas
long tingim Jerusalem bilong heven,
em i ples tru bilong yu, na em i mama bilong mipela.
Long dispela ples, planti brata na susa bilong mipela i stap pinis,
na ol i litimapim nem bilong yu inap oltaim.

Mipela i stap yet long graun,
na mipela i bilip long yu,
olsem na mipela i wokabaut i go long ples bilong yu.

Nau mipela i amamas long glori yu bin givim
long ol lain bilong Sios i stap pinis long heven.
Long pre bilong ol Santu, yu save strongim mipela.
Na long pasin bilong ol,
yu save skulim mipela long bihainim pasin holi.

Olsem na wantaim ol lain bilong Ensel na ol Santu,
mipela tu i givim ona long yu, na mipela i sing (tok):

communion.text:
Ol manmeri bel bilong ol i klin, em ol i ken amamas. Long wanem,
ol bai i lukim God. Ol manmeri i save wok bilong mekim bel isi na
gutpela sindaun i kamap, em ol i ken amamas. Long wanem, ol bai i
kolim ol pikinini bilong God. Ol manmeri i save bihainim stretpela
pasin na long dispela as ol i kisim hevi long ol arapela, em ol i ken
amamas. Long wanem, Kingdom bilong Heven em i bilong ol.

sanctorale.11-01.postcommunion:
God, mipela i adorim yu tasol.
Long wanem, yu tasol yu holi,
na yu bin mekim planti gutpela wok long ol Santu bilong yu.
Mipela i askim yu, salim grasia bilong yu i kam long mipela,
bai mipela i ken laikim yu tru,
na wokabaut oltaim long rot bilong pasin holi.
Na helpim mipela, bai wanpela de
mipela i ken lusim dispela kaikai yu givim mipela long graun,
na mipela i ken kamap long bikpela kaikai bilong heven,
em i ples tru bilong mipela.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.11-02.title: DE BILONG TINGIM OLGETA BILIPMANMERI I DAI PINIS Pris i ken yusim ol dispela tripela Misa long laik bilong em yet. Tude Pris inap long selebretim tripela Misa. MISA 1

entrance.text:
Jisas i bin dai na i kirap bek gen. Olsem na long strong bilong Jisas, God
bai i kirapim ol manmeri i slip long matmat, na bringim ol i go wantaim
em. Tru, olgeta manmeri bilong lain bilong Adam i save dai. Olsem tasol
olgeta manmeri bilong lain bilong Krais bai i kisim laip gen.

sanctorale.11-02.collect:
Lord, marimari long mipela, na harim ol pre bilong mipela.
Mipela i bilip long Pikinini bilong yu i kirap long indai.
Mipela i pre, strongim hop bilong mipela,
bai mipela i ken wet long kirap bek
bilong ol wokmanmeri bilong yu.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.11-02.offerings:
Lord, long dispela Sakramen,
mipela i kamap wan wantaim Pikinini bilong yu.
Mipela i askim yu, lukdaun long ol ofa bilong mipela,
na bringim ol wokmanmeri bilong yu i dai pinis
i go long glori bilong Krais.
Em i stap laip na em i King, nau na oltaim.
sanctorale.11-02.preface: bilong ol manmeri i dai pinis, p. 536-540.

communion.text:
Bikpela i tok olsem, “Kirap bek, em mi yet. Na laip, em mi yet. Na man
o meri i bilip long mi, maski sapos em i dai, em bai i stap laip yet. Na
olgeta manmeri i stap laip na i bilip long mi, bai ol i no i dai inap oltaim.”

sanctorale.11-02.postcommunion:
Lord, mipela i bin selebretim dispela Sakramen
bilong Pen na Indai na Kirap Bek bilong Krais,
bilong helpim ol wokmanmeri bilong yu i dai pinis.
Long marimari bilong yu,
bringim ol i go long ples bilong lait na bilong bel isi bilong yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.11-03.title: Santu Martin de Porres, Relijis
sanctorale.11-03.collect:
God, yu bin stiaim Santu Martin de Porres
long bihainim rot bilong daunpasin,
bai em i ken kamap long glori bilong heven.
Mipela i pre,
helpim mipela long bihainim gutpela pasin bilong em,
bai mipela i ken bungim em long heven.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.11-03.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Santu Manmeri: bilong ol Relijis (p. 924).

sanctorale.11-04.title: Santu Charles Borromeo, Bisop
sanctorale.11-04.collect:
Lord, yu bin pulapim Bisop Santu Charles Borromeo
long Spirit bilong yu.
Mipela i pre, salim dispela Spirit i kam long mipela.
Na helpim Sios bilong yu long kamap strong
na bihainim pasin bilong Krais,
bai em i ken givim witnes long olgeta hap bilong graun.
Em i stap laip na em i King, nau na oltaim.
sanctorale.11-04.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong wanpela Bisop (p. 890).
sanctorale.11-04.offerings:
Lord, lukdaun long ol ofa,
mipela i bringim i kam long alta bilong yu,
bilong tingim Santu Charles Borromeo.
Yu bin mekim em i kamap gutpela wasman,
na em i bin pulap long planti gutpela pasin.
Mipela i pre, bai strong bilong dispela sakrifais
i ken helpim mipela long mekim wok bilong yu,
na karim gutpela kaikai.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.
sanctorale.11-04.postcommunion:
Lord, yu bin strongim Santu Charles Borromeo,
na em i bin mekim gut wok bilong yu,
na em i bin pulap long pasin bilong helpim ol arapela.
Mipela i pre, bai dispela holi Sakramen,
nau tasol mipela i kisim pinis, i ken strongim mipela tu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.11-09.title:
BLESING BILONG HAUS LOTU
BILONG SANTU JON LONG LATERAN, LONG PLES ROM

entrance.text:
Mi lukim dispela taun holi, em i nupela Jerusalem. Em i stap wantaim
God, na em i lusim heven na i kam daun. Em i gat gutpela bilas, olsem
meri i laik marit na i redi long maritim man bilong em.

alt.text: Lukim! Dispela em i haus bilong God namel long ol manmeri. God bai i stap namel long ol, na ol bai i kamap pipel bilong em. Na God bai i stap God bilong ol yet.

sanctorale.11-09.collect:
God, mipela i pipel yu bin makim pinis bilong yu yet,
na mipela i olsem ston i gat laip.
Long ol dispela ston yu save wokim wanpela haus
bilong litimapim nem bilong yu.
Mipela i askim yu,
bai grasia bilong yu i ken gro insait long Sios bilong yu.
Olsem na ol bilipmanmeri bilong yu i ken wok wantaim
bilong kamapim Jerusalem bilong heven.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.11-09.offerings:
Lord, kisim dispela ofa long han bilong mipela,
na lukim pipel bilong yu i singaut long yu.
Mipela i askim yu, bai yu ken harim ol pre bilong ol,
na ol i ken kisim strong i kam long ol Sakramen.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.
sanctorale.11-09.preface:
Prefasio: Misteri bilong Sios, em i Maritmeri bilong Krais
na Tempel bilong Spirit.
sanctorale.11-09.prefaceText:
Tru, em i gutpela na i stret,
oltaim na long olgeta ples,
mipela i tenkim yu, Lord, yu Papa na yu holi tru,
yu strong olgeta na yu God bilong oltaim.
Givim tenkyu long yu em i wok bilong mipela,
na em i kisim bek mipela.

Yu gutpela tumas,
olsem na yu laik i stap namel long mipela,
long dispela haus bilong pre.
Yu laik bai mipela i kamap holi,
na yu save givim grasia bilong yu long mipela,
bai mipela i ken pulap long planti gutpela pasin,
na kamap tempel bilong Holi Spirit.

Dispela haus lotu em i olsem piksa bilong Sios,
em i Maritmeri bilong Krais.
Na oltaim yu save wok
bilong mekim Sios bilong yu i kamap holi.
Olsem na Sios i amamas long ol pikinini bilong em,
na em i amamas tu long glori yu bai i givim em long heven.

Olsem na wantaim ol Santu na ol Ensel,
mipela i givim ona long yu, na oltaim mipela sing (tok):

communion.text:
Yupela i olsem ston i gat laip, na God i laik mekim yupela i kamap haus
bilong Spirit. Olsem na yupela i ken i stap lain pris i holi.

sanctorale.11-09.postcommunion:
God, Sios bilong yu hia long graun
em i olsem piksa bilong Jerusalem bilong heven.
Mipela i pre, bai dispela Sakramen mipela i kisim pinis,
i ken mekim mipela i kamap tempel bilong grasia bilong yu,
na i ken helpim mipela long i go insait long glori bilong yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.11-10.title: Santu Leo, Pop na Tisa bilong Sios

entrance.text:
Bikpela i bin mekim kontrak bilong gutpela taim wantaim em, na
makim em olsem bikpris, bai em i ken holim namba bilong pris inap
oltaim oltaim.

sanctorale.11-10.collect:
God, yu no save larim strong bilong hel
i daunim Sios bilong yu,
long wanem, yu bin sanapim em antap long ston bilong ol Aposel.
Mipela i askim yu, bai pre bilong Pop Santu Leo,
i ken helpim Sios long sanap strong long tok i tru,
na long painim gutpela taim.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.11-10.offerings:
Lord, mipela i pre, bai dispela ofa bilong mipela
i ken helpim Sios bilong yu.
Mekim bai ol lain sipsip bilong yu i ken gro
long olgeta hap bilong graun.
Na stiaim ol wasman,
bai wok bilong ol i ken givim ona long nem bilong yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Pita i tokim Jisas olsem, “Yu Krais, yu Pikinini bilong God i gat laip.”
Na Jisas i bekim tok long em olsem, “Yu Pita, na bai mi wokim Sios
bilong mi antap long dispela ston.”

sanctorale.11-10.postcommunion:
Lord, yu bin givim kaikai holi long Sios bilong yu.
Mipela i askim yu, bai yu ken stiaim Sios bilong yu oltaim,
na helpim em long i stap fri,
na long sanap strong long trupela bilip.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.11-11.title: Santu Martin bilong Tours, Bisop

entrance.text:
Bikpela i tok olsem, “Bai mi makim wanpela gutpela pris, na em bai i
bihainim laik na tingting bilong mi.”

sanctorale.11-11.collect:
God, Bisop Santu Martin i bin litimapim nem bilong yu
long laip na long indai bilong em.
Mipela i askim yu,
mekim mipela i kamap nupela gen long grasia bilong yu,
bai mipela i no ken lusim yu long taim mipela i stap laip,
na long taim mipela i laik i dai.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.11-11.offerings:
God, yu Bikpela bilong mipela.
Mipela i tingim Santu Martin,
na mipela i bringim ol dispela presen i kam long yu.
Mipela i pre, mekim ol dispela presen i kamap holi,
na mekim bai strong bilong ol
i ken helpim mipela long taim nogut na long gutpela taim.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Bikpela i tok olsem, “Mi tok tru long yupela, olgeta samting yupela i
bin mekim long wanpela bilong ol dispela brata bilong mi i no gat nem
liklik, ol dispela samting yupela i bin mekim long mi.”

sanctorale.11-11.postcommunion:
Lord, Santu Martin i bin givim em yet olgeta long yu.
Mipela i pre, bai dispela Sakramen, mipela i kisim pinis,
i ken mekim mipela i kamap wan.
Na em i ken helpim mipela long bihainim laik bilong yu oltaim,
na amamas long i stap manmeri bilong yu tasol.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.11-12.title: Santu Josafat, Bisop na Martir

entrance.text:
Kontrak bilong Bikpela na ol lo bilong ol tumbuna, i bin stiaim ol
Santu bilong God long laikim wanpela narapela olsem bratasusa. Ol i
bin gat wanpela spirit na wanpela bilip tasol.

sanctorale.11-12.collect:
Lord, yu bin pulapim Santu Josafat long Spirit bilong yu,
na em i bin givim laip bilong em bilong helpim ol sipsip.
Long pre bilong em, givim dispela Spirit gen long Sios bilong yu,
bai mipela tu i no ken pret long givim laip bilong mipela
bilong helpim ol bratasusa.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.11-12.offerings:
God bilong marimari,
Santu Josafat i bin givim witnes long bilip,
olsem na em i kapsaitim blut bilong em.
Mipela i pre, salim blesing bilong yu antap long dispela ofa,
na strongim bilip bilong mipela.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Bikpela i tok olsem, “Man i ting long mi na i lusim laip bilong em, em
bai i kisim laip bilong oltaim.”

sanctorale.11-12.postcommunion:
Lord, dispela kaikai bilong heven
i ken givim spirit bilong bel isi na bilong strong long mipela.
Olsem na mipela bai inap long bihain pasin bilong Santu Josafat,
na givim laip bilong mipela yet bilong onarim Sios,
na bilong helpim Sios long kamap wan.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.11-15.title: Santu Albert, Bisop na Tisa bilong Sios
sanctorale.11-15.collect:
God, yu bin mekim Bisop Santu Albert i kamap bikpela,
long wanem, em i bin bungim save bilong graun
wantaim bilip bilong heven.
Mipela i pre, helpim mipela long bihainim ol skul bilong em,
bai mipela i ken save gut long yu, na laikim yu moa yet.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.11-15.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong wanpela Bisop (p. 890). O Misa bilong ol Tisa bilong Sios (p. 906).

sanctorale.11-16.title: Santu Margaret bilong Skotland
sanctorale.11-16.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Santu Manmeri: bilong ol manmeri i bin mekim wok marimari (p. 927).
sanctorale.11-16.collect:
God, yu bin mekim Santu Margaret i pulap long marimari
bilong helpim ol manmeri i sot long ol samting.
Long pre na pasin bilong em,
helpim mipela long soim laikim pasin bilong yu
namel long olgeta manmeri.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.

sanctorale.11-17.title: Santu Elisabet bilong Hangari, Relijis
sanctorale.11-17.collect:
God, yu bin helpim Santu Elisabet
long luksave long Krais i stap long ol tarangu,
na em i bin mekim planti wok bilong helpim ol.
Long pre bilong em, strongim laikim pasin bilong mipela,
bai mipela i ken wok oltaim
bilong helpim ol manmeri i sot long ol samting,
na ol manmeri i bel hevi.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.11-17.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Santu Manmeri: bilong ol manmeri i bin mekim wok marimari (p. 927).

sanctorale.11-18.title: Blesing bilong Tupela Haus Lotu bilong Santu Pita na Pol, Aposel, long Ples Rom

entrance.text:
Yu bai i givim bikpela namba long ol, bilong bosim olgeta hap bilong
graun. Ol bai i tokaut long nem bilong yu, na olgeta lain i kamap bihain
bai i tingim yu inap oltaim. Olsem na olgeta pipel bai i litimapim nem
bilong yu inap oltaim oltaim.

sanctorale.11-18.collect:
Lord, sambai long Sios bilong yu
wantaim helpim bilong tupela Aposel Pita na Pol.
Long pasin na skul bilong tupela,
Sios bilong yu i bin kisim bilip bilong ol samting bilong antap.
Mipela i askim yu, bai pre tupela i ken helpim Sios
long kisim grasia bilong heven olgeta de,
inap long dispela graun i pinis.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.11-18.offerings:
Lord, mipela i bringim ol ofa bilong mipela i kam long yu.
Na mipela i pre, marimari long mipela,
na strongim mipela long bilip mipela i bin kisim
long wok bilong tupela Aposel Pita na Pol.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
“Bikpela, yu tasol i gat tok i save givim laip bilong oltaim. Na mipela i
bilip, na mipela i save olsem, yu Krais, yu Pikinini bilong God.”

sanctorale.11-18.postcommunion:
Lord, yu bin strongim pipel bilong yu long Bret bilong Heven.
Mipela i pre, bai mipela i ken amamas oltaim
long tingim tupela Aposel Pita na Pol.
Long wanem, yu yet i bin makim tupela
bilong stiaim na lukautim mipela.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.11-21.title: Papamama i Bringim Santu Maria Virgo i Go long Tempel
sanctorale.11-21.collect:
Lord, tude mipela i amamas long tingim Santu Maria Virgo,
na mipela i laik onarim nem bilong em.
Mipela i askim yu, long pre bilong em,
pulapim mipela tu long grasia bilong yu.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.

sanctorale.11-22.title: Santu Sisilia, Virgo na Martir
sanctorale.11-22.collect:
God, olgeta yia yu save givim amamas long mipela
long pestode bilong Santu Sisilia.
Mipela i askim yu, bai laip bilong dispela wokmeri bilong yu
i ken kirapim mipela long bihainim pasin bilong em.
Na em i ken helpim mipela long tokaut oltaim
long ol bikpela wok, Krais, Pikinini bilong yu,
i bin mekim long ol wokmanmeri bilong em.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.11-22.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Martir: bilong wanpela Virgo Martir (p. 885). O Misa bilong ol Virgo: bilong wanpela Virgo (p. 910).

sanctorale.11-23.title: Santu Klemens 1, Pop na Martir
sanctorale.11-23.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Martir: bilong wanpela Martir (p. 874). O Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong wanpela Pop (p. 887).
sanctorale.11-23.collect:
God, yu strong olgeta na yu stap oltaim.
Yu save mekim planti gutpela wok long laip bilong ol Santu.
Tude mipela i tingim Santu Klemens,
em i Pris na Martir bilong Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i bin givim witnes long Pen na Indai bilong Krais,
na ol skul bilong em i bin kamap ples klia long ol wok bilong em.
Mipela i pre, bai mipela i ken amamas long pestode bilong em,
na bihainim ol gutpela pasin bilong em.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.

sanctorale.11-24.title: Santu Andru Dung Lak, Pris, Wantaim ol Lain Martir bilong Vietnam

entrance.text:
Yumi no ken litimapim nem bilong yumi yet long ol samting bilong
graun. Nogat. Yumi mas amamas tasol long Diwai Kros bilong Bikpela
bilong yumi, Jisas Krais. Long wanem, Diwai Kros em i strong bilong
God, em i givim long ol manmeri em i kisim bek pinis.

sanctorale.11-24.collect:
God, olgeta famili i kam long yu tasol,
na yu Papa bilong olgeta samting.
Yu bin mekim Martir Santu Andru wantaim ol lain Martir
i givim witnes long Diwai Kros bilong Pikinini bilong yu,
inap long ol i kapsaitim blut bilong ol.
Long pre bilong ol, helpim mipela
long bringim laikim pasin bilong yu i go long olgeta manmeri,
bai mipela i ken i stap pikinini bilong yu
long nem na long wok bilong mipela.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.11-24.offerings:
God Papa, yu holi tru, kisim dispela ofa,
mipela i bringim i kam bilong onarim pen na indai
bilong ol holi Martir bilong yu.
Mipela i pre, bai mipela i ken holim bilip bilong mipela
namel long ol hevi bilong dispela graun,
na bai mipela i ken ofarim mipela yet
olsem wanpela sakrifais i stret long ai bilong yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Ol manmeri i save bihainim stretpela pasin na long dispela as ol i kisim
hevi long ol arapela, em ol i ken amamas. Long wanem, Kingdom bilong
Heven em i bilong ol.

sanctorale.11-24.postcommunion:
Lord, yu bin strongim mipela long wanpela Bret bilong yu.
Tude mipela i tingim ol holi Martir, na mipela i askim yu,
helpim mipela long pas tru long laikim pasin bilong yu,
bai mipela i ken karim gut ol hevi, na winim laip bilong oltaim.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.11-25.title: Santu Katarina bilong Aleksandria, Virgo na Martir
sanctorale.11-25.collect:
God, yu strong olgeta na yu stap oltaim.
Yu bin givim Santu Katarina long pipel bilong yu,
olsem gutpela Virgo na strongpela Martir.
Long pre bilong em,
strongim bilip na gutpela pasin bilong mipela,
bai mipela i ken wok strong
bilong helpim Sios long kamap wanbel.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.11-25.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Martir: bilong wanpela Virgo Martir (p. 885). O Misa bilong ol Virgo: bilong wanpela Virgo (p. 910).

sanctorale.11-30.title: SANTU ANDRU, APOSEL

entrance.text:
Bikpela i wokabaut arere long solwara bilong Galili, na em i lukim
tupela brata, Pita na Andru. Na em i tokim tupela olsem, “Yutupela
kam wantaim mi, na bai mi lainim yutupela long pasin bilong kisim ol
manmeri.”
I gat Ona long God i stap antap.

sanctorale.11-30.collect:
Lord, Aposel Santu Andru i bin helpim Sios bilong yu
long skul na long wok wasman bilong em.
Mipela i askim yu, marimari long mipela,
na helpim mipela long pre bilong em.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.11-30.offerings:
God, yu strong olgeta,
tude mipela i tingim pestode bilong Santu Andru,
na mipela i bringim dispela ofa i kam long yu.
Mipela i pre, bai dispela ofa i ken kamap stret long ai bilong yu,
na i ken givim laip bilong oltaim long mipela.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Andru i tokim brata bilong em Saimon olsem, “Mipela i lukim pinis
Mesaia.” Dispela nem “Mesaia” em i olsem “Krais.” Na Andru i bringim
em i go long Jisas.

sanctorale.11-30.postcommunion:
Lord, dispela Sakramen, mipela i kisim pinis,
i ken strongim mipela.
Mipela i pre,
helpim mipela long bihainim pasin bilong Aposel Santu Andru,
bai mipela i ken karim pen wantaim Krais,
na bihain mipela i ken i stap laip wantaim em long heven.
Em i stap laip na em i King, nau na oltaim.

sanctorale.12-03.title: Santu Fransis Sevier, Pris

entrance.text:
Bikpela, bai mi litimapim nem bilong yu long ai bilong olgeta lain
manmeri. Na bai mi tokaut long nem bilong yu long ol bratasusa
bilong mi.

sanctorale.12-03.collect:
God, long skul bilong Santu Fransis Sevier,
yu bin mekim planti lain pipel i kam long yu.
Mipela i askim yu,
kirapim strongpela laikim pasin insait long ol bilipmanmeri,
bai ol i ken strong long bilip, na mekim dispela wok i go het.
Olsem na holi Sios bilong yu bai i kamap bikpela
long olgeta hap bilong graun,
na amamas long ol pikinini bilong em.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.12-03.offerings:
Lord, mipela i tingim Santu Fransis Sevier,
na mipela i bringim ol dispela presen i kam long yu.
Em i bin i go long ol longwe ples,
bilong helpim ol manmeri long sevim sol bilong ol.
Mipela i askim yu, kisim ol presen bilong mipela.
Na helpim mipela long kamap witnes bilong Gutnius,
bai mipela i ken wokabaut wantaim ol bratasusa bilong mipela
long rot i go long yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Bikpela i tok olsem, “Tok mi autim long yupela long tudak, em yupela i
mas autim long san. Na tok yupela i harim isi tasol long yau, em yupela
i mas sanap antap long haus na autim long ol manmeri.”

sanctorale.12-03.postcommunion:
God, dispela Sakramen bilong yu
i ken laitim paia bilong laikim pasin insait long mipela.
Dispela paia tasol i bin kirapim Santu Fransis
long mekim wok bilong sevim sol bilong ol manmeri.
Mipela i pre,
strongim mipela long bihainim laik bilong yu oltaim,
bai mipela i ken kisim dispela pe
yu bin promisim long ol gutpela wokmanmeri bilong yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.12-04.title: Santu Jon Damasen, Pris na Tisa bilong Sios
sanctorale.12-04.collect:
Lord, Pris Santu Jon Damasen i bin mekim planti wok
bilong skulim ol manmeri long trupela bilip.
Mipela i askim yu, helpim mipela long pre bilong em,
bai dispela bilip i ken kamap lait na strong bilong mipela.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.12-04.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong wanpela Wasman (p. 895). O Misa bilong ol Tisa bilong Sios (p. 906).

sanctorale.12-06.title: Santu Nikolas, Bisop
sanctorale.12-06.collect:
Lord, mipela i daunim mipela yet,
na mipela i singaut long marimari bilong yu.
Mipela i askim yu,
bai pre bilong Bisop Santu Nikolas i ken lukautim mipela,
bai ol samting nogut i no ken kamap long mipela.
Na em i ken helpim mipela long wokabaut oltaim
long rot bilong salvesen.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.12-06.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong wanpela Bisop (p. 890).

sanctorale.12-07.title: Santu Ambros, Pris na Tisa bilong Sios

entrance.text:
Em i bin autim tok namel long Sios, na Bikpela i bin pulapim em
long spirit bilong gutpela save na stretpela tingting. Na Bikpela i bin
karamapim em long klos bilong glori.

sanctorale.12-07.collect:
God, yu bin mekim Bisop Santu Ambros
i kamap Tisa bilong Katolik Bilip,
na yu bin givim strong bilong ol Aposel long em.
Mipela i pre, kirapim planti gutpela man
insait long Sios bilong yu,
bai ol i ken bihainim laik bilong yu tasol,
na bai ol i ken stiaim Sios wantaim bikpela strong na gutpela save.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.12-07.offerings:
Lord, mipela i tingim Santu Ambros,
na mipela i mekim dispela Misa.
Holi Spirit i bin pulapim em long lait bilong bilip.
Olsem na em i bin wok strong bilong tokaut long glori bilong yu.
Mipela i pre, salim Holi Spirit i kam long mipela,
na pulapim mipela tu long lait bilong bilip.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Ol manmeri i save tingting long lo bilong Bikpela long san na long nait,
ol bai i karim kaikai long taim bilong em.

sanctorale.12-08.title: SANTU MARIA VIRGO I NO GAT SIN

entrance.text:
Mi amamas tru long Bikpela, na sol bilong mi i singsing amamas long
God bilong mi. Long wanem, em i bin kisim bek mi, na stretpela pasin
bilong em i bin karamapim mi olsem gutpela klos. Em i bin bilasim mi
olsem wanpela meri i bilas gut long taim bilong marit.

sanctorale.12-08.collect:
God, long strong bilong Indai bilong Pikinini bilong yu,
yu bin mekim Santu Maria Virgo i no gat doti bilong sin.
Olsem na taim Maria i stap yet long bel bilong mama,
yu bin mekim em i kamap Klin Olgeta,
na yu bin redim wanpela gutpela mama long Pikinini bilong yu.
Long pre bilong Santu Maria Virgo,
helpim mipela long kamap klin long ai bilong yu,
bai wanpela de mipela i ken sanap long pes bilong yu.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.12-08.offerings:
Lord, tude em i Bikpela Pestode
bilong Santu Maria Virgo i no gat sin.
Olsem na mipela i laik ofarim long yu dispela sakrifais
i save givim laip bilong oltaim long mipela.
Long strong bilong grasia bilong yu, yu bin banisim Maria,
olsem na sin i no bin mekim em i kamap doti.
Mipela i askim yu, kisim dispela sakrifais bilong mipela,
na long pre bilong Santu Maria Virgo,
helpim mipela long i stap klin long sin.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.
sanctorale.12-08.preface: Prefasio: Misteri bilong Maria na Sios.
sanctorale.12-08.prefaceText:
Tru, em i gutpela na i stret,
oltaim na long olgeta ples,
mipela i tenkim yu, Lord, yu Papa na yu holi tru,
yu strong olgeta na yu God bilong oltaim.
Givim tenkyu long yu em i wok bilong mipela,
na em i kisim bek mipela.

Yu bin banisim Santu Maria Virgo long sin bilong Adam.
Na yu bin mekim em i pulap long grasia,
bai em i ken kamap gutpela Mama bilong Pikinini bilong yu.
Olsem na yu bin mekim Maria i kamap
bigin na piksa bilong Sios.
Long wanem, Sios em i Maritmeri bilong Krais,
na em i klin olgeta, na i no gat doti long em.
Yu bin makim Santu Maria, em i klinpela Virgo,
bai em i ken karim wanpela Pikinini man.
Na dispela Pikinini em i Lem tru
i tekewe olgeta sin bilong mipela.
Na yu bin makim Maria,
bai em i ken helpim pipel bilong yu long kisim grasia,
na bai em i ken soim pasin holi long ol.

Olsem na wantaim ol Ensel,
mipela i amamas long litimapim nem bilong yu,
na mipela i sing (tok):

communion.text:
Maria, olgeta manmeri i litimapim nem bilong yu. Long wanem, yu
bin karim Krais, em i God bilong mipela, na em i san i soim lait bilong
stretpela pasin.

sanctorale.12-08.postcommunion:
God, yu Bikpela bilong mipela.
Taim Santu Maria i stap yet long bel bilong mama,
yu bin banisim em long sin bilong Adam.
Mipela i pre, bai dispela Sakramen mipela i kisim pinis,
i ken oraitim mipela long asua bilong sin.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.12-09.title: Santu Jon Diego Kuauatlatoatsin
sanctorale.12-09.collect:
God, long laip bilong Santu Jon Diego,
yu bin skulim mipela long bikpela laik
bilong Santu Maria Virgo i go long pipel bilong yu.
Na long ples Guadalupe, Maria, em i Mama bilong mipela,
i bin givim planti gutpela skul long Santu Jon.
Long pre bilong Santu Jon,
helpim mipela long bihainim gut ol skul bilong Maria,
bai mipela i ken bihainim laik bilong yu oltaim.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.12-09.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Santu Manmeri: bilong wanpela Santu (p. 919).

sanctorale.12-10.title: Santu Maria Virgo bilong Loreto
sanctorale.12-10.collect:
God, yu bin makim Santu Maria Virgo
bilong inapim ol promis
bipo yu bin mekim long ol tumbuna bilong Israel,
na yu bin mekim em i kamap Mama bilong Sevia bilong mipela.
Mipela i pre, bai mipela i ken bihainim gut ol pasin bilong em.
Long wanem, daunpasin bilong em i bin givim amamas long yu,
na obidiens bilong em i bin helpim mipela.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.

sanctorale.12-11.title: Santu Damasus 1, Pop
sanctorale.12-11.collect:
Lord, Pop Santu Damasus
i bin laikim pasin bilong ol Martir bilong yu,
na em i bin onarim ol gut.
Mipela i pre, bai mipela tu i ken litimapim nem bilong ol oltaim.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.12-11.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong wanpela Pop (p. 887).

sanctorale.12-12.title: Santu Maria Virgo bilong Guadalupe
sanctorale.12-12.collect:
God, yu Papa bilong marimari.
Yu bin bungim pipel bilong yu
aninit long lukaut bilong Santu Maria,
em i Mama bilong Pikinini bilong yu.
Mipela i pre, bai olgeta manmeri
i singaut long Santu Maria bilong Guadalupe,
i ken sanap strong long bilip,
na i ken wok bilong kamapim stretpela pasin
na gutpela taim namel long ol pipel.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.

sanctorale.12-13.title: Santu Lusi, Virgo na Martir
sanctorale.12-13.collect:
Lord, tude mipela i tingim Virgo na Martir Santu Lusi
i bin lusim dispela graun na i go long heven.
Mipela i askim yu, bai pre bilong em i ken helpim mipela,
ol manmeri i stap yet long graun,
long tingting oltaim long ol samting bilong heven,
bai wanpela de mipela i ken lukim yu long ai bilong mipela.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.12-13.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Martir: bilong wanpela Virgo Martir (p. 885). O Misa bilong ol Virgo: bilong wanpela Virgo (p. 910).

sanctorale.12-14.title: Santu Jon bilong Diwai Kros, Pris na Tisa bilong Sios

entrance.text:
Mi no ken litimapim nem bilong mi yet long ol samting bilong graun.
Nogat. Mi mas amamas tasol long Diwai Kros bilong Bikpela bilong
yumi, Jisas Krais. Long em, olgeta samting bilong graun i dai pinis
insait long mi. Na em i olsem mi yet tu i dai pinis long Diwai Kros, na
mi no inap bihainim pasin bilong graun gen.

sanctorale.12-14.collect:
God, yu bin mekim Pris Santu Jon i laikim tumas Diwai Kros,
na oltaim em i bin wok bilong daunim laik bilong em yet.
Mipela i askim yu,
strongim mipela long bihainim pasin bilong em,
bai wanpela de mipela i ken kamap long laip bilong oltaim,
na lukim glori bilong yu long ai bilong mipela.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.12-14.offerings:
God, yu strong olgeta,
mipela i tingim Santu Jon bilong Diwai Kros,
na mipela i bringim ol ofa bilong sakrifais i kam long yu.
Long dispela Sakramen
mipela i selebretim Pen na Indai bilong Bikpela.
Mipela i pre, lukdaun long ol ofa bilong mipela,
na helpim mipela long bihainim pasin bilong Krais.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Bikpela i tok olsem, “Sapos wanpela man i laik bihainim mi, orait em
i mas daunim laik bilong em yet, na em i mas karim diwai kros bilong
em, na bihainim mi.”

sanctorale.12-14.postcommunion:
God, long laip bilong Santu Jon
yu bin skulim mipela long misteri bilong Diwai Kros.
Mipela i pre, bai dispela sakrifais i ken strongim mipela
long pas wantaim Krais,
na i ken helpim mipela long wok insait long Sios
bilong helpim salvesen bilong olgeta manmeri.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.12-21.title: Santu Pita Kanisius, Pris na Tisa bilong Sios
sanctorale.12-21.collect:
God, yu bin givim gutpela pasin na gutpela save
long Pris Santu Pita Kanisius,
bai em i ken lukautim gut Katolik bilip.
Long pre bilong em,
helpim olgeta manmeri i wok long painim tok i tru,
bai ol i ken painim yu, God bilong ol.
Na helpim pipel bilong yu
long givim witnes long nem bilong yu oltaim.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.12-21.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong wanpela Wasman (p. 895). O Misa bilong ol Tisa bilong Sios (p. 906).

sanctorale.12-23.title: Santu Jon bilong Kenti, Pris
sanctorale.12-23.collect:
God, yu strong olgeta, mipela i pre,
bai pasin bilong Pris Santu Jon bilong Kenti
i ken helpim mipela long save gut long ol samting i holi.
Na strongim mipela, bai mipela i ken mekim planti wok
bilong helpim olgeta manmeri,
na bai mipela yet i ken painim marimari bilong yu.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.12-23.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong wanpela Wasman (p. 895). O Misa bilong ol Santu Manmeri: bilong ol manmeri i bin mekim wok marimari (p. 927).

sanctorale.12-26.title: SANTU STIVEN, NAMBA WAN MARTIR

entrance.text:
Ol dua bilong heven i op long Santu Stiven. Long wanem, God i bin
makim em bilong kamap namba wan Martir. Olsem na em i kisim pe
bilong oltaim long heven.
I gat Ona long God i stap antap.

sanctorale.12-26.collect:
Lord, tude mipela i selebretim Santu Stiven i go long heven.
Em i bin pre bilong helpim ol man i mekim nogut long em.
Helpim mipela long bihainim pasin bilong em,
bai mipela tu i ken laikim ol birua bilong mipela.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.12-26.offerings:
Lord, tude mipela i tingim Martir Santu Stiven,
na mipela i bringim dispela ofa i kam long yu,
olsem mak bilong mipela i laik mekim wok bilong yu.
Mipela i pre, kisim dispela ofa bilong mipela,
na mekim em i kamap stret long ai bilong yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Taim ol i wok long tromoi ston long Stiven, em i pre olsem, “Bikpela
Jisas, yu kisim spirit bilong mi.”

sanctorale.12-26.postcommunion:
Lord, mipela i tenkim yu long ol wok marimari
yu save mekim bilong helpim mipela.
Long wanem, yu kisim bek mipela
long Krismas bilong Pikinini bilong yu,
na yu givim amamas long mipela
long pestode bilong Martir Santu Stiven.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.12-27.title: SANTU JON, APOSEL NA EVANGELIS

entrance.text:
Dispela em i Jon. Long kaikai bilong Gut Fonde, em i bin putim het
bilong em long bros bilong Bikpela. Dispela Aposel i ken amamas,
long wanem, planti tok hait bilong heven i bin kamap klia long em. Em
i bin tokaut long tok i gat laip long olgeta hap bilong graun.

alt.text: Em i bin autim tok namel long Sios, na Bikpela i bin pulapim em long spirit bilong gutpela save na stretpela tingting. Na Bikpela i bin karamapim em long klos bilong glori.

sanctorale.12-27.collect:
God, long wok bilong Aposel Santu Jon,
yu bin mekim tok bilong Krais i kamap klia long mipela.
Mipela i askim yu, helpim mipela long save gut
long olgeta skul mipela i bin harim long em.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.12-27.offerings:
Lord, taim Krais i bin mekim Las Kaikai bilong em,
yu bin mekim klia planti tok hait long Aposel Jon.
Mipela i pre, mekim dispela ofa bilong mipela i kamap holi,
na helpim mipela long holim strong ol tok bilong yu
i save givim laip bilong oltaim.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Tok bilong God i bin kamap man, na em i kam i stap namel long mipela.
Grasia i pulap moa yet long em. Na long grasia bilong em, yumi olgeta
i bin kisim planti grasia.

sanctorale.12-27.postcommunion:
God, yu strong olgeta,
Aposel Santu Jon i bin tokaut
long Tok bilong yu i kamap man.
Mipela i pre, bai dispela Sakramen mipela i bin selebretim,
i ken mekim Krais i stap oltaim wantaim mipela.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.12-28.title: OL LIKLIK HOLI PIKININI, KING HEROT I BIN KILIM OL I DAI, MARTIR

entrance.text:
Ol liklik pikinini i no gat rong i bin kisim ples bilong Krais, na ol i bin
kilim ol i dai. Nau ol i bihainim Lem i no gat doti long em, na oltaim ol
i sing: Ona long yu, Bikpela.
I gat Ona long God i stap antap.

sanctorale.12-28.collect:
God, tude mipela i tingim ol liklik holi pikinini,
King Herot i bin kilim ol i dai.
Ol i no bin save yet long toktok,
tasol long indai bilong ol, ol i bin givim witnes long yu.
Mipela i askim yu,
bai mipela i ken givim witnes long bilip bilong mipela
long tok na long pasin bilong mipela.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.12-28.offerings:
Lord, kisim dispela ofa bilong ol wokmanmeri bilong yu.
Mipela i pre, long strong bilong dispela Sakramen,
mekim mipela i kamap klin long ai bilong yu.
Long wanem, long marimari bilong yu,
yu bin kisim bek ol liklik pikinini i no gat tingting yet.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
God i bin baim bek ol dispela lain namel long olgeta manmeri bilong
graun, na ol i stap olsem namba wan lain God i kisim bek, bai ol i stap
ol lain bilong em yet na bilong Lem. Olgeta ples Lem i laik i go long em,
orait ol dispela man i save bihainim em i go.

sanctorale.12-28.postcommunion:
Lord, mipela i bin kisim dispela Sakramen bilong yu,
long de bilong tingim ol liklik pikinini,
King Herot i bin kilim ol i dai.
Ol i liklik tumas, olsem na ol i no inap yet
long givim witnes long Pikinini bilong yu long maus,
tasol yu bin givim pe bilong oltaim long heven long ol.
Mipela i askim yu, bai Krismas bilong Pikinini bilong yu
i ken pulapim mipela long grasia bilong yu,
na i ken givim laip bilong oltaim long mipela.
Em i stap laip na em i King, nau na oltaim.

sanctorale.12-29.title: Santu Tomas Beket, Bisop na Martir
sanctorale.12-29.collect:
God, yu bin givim strong long Martir Santu Tomas Beket,
bai em i ken lusim laip bilong em,
bilong givim witnes long stretpela pasin.
Long pre bilong em, helpim mipela long givim witnes long Krais
na long daunim laik bilong mipela yet hia long graun,
bai bihain mipela i ken kisim laip bilong oltaim long heven.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.12-29.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Martir: bilong wanpela Martir (p. 874). O Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong wanpela Bisop (p. 890).

sanctorale.12-31.title: Santu Silvesta 1, Pop
sanctorale.12-31.collect:
Lord, harim pre bilong Pop Santu Silvesta,
na helpim pipel bilong yu.
Mipela i askim yu, stiaim wokabaut bilong mipela hia long graun,
na bringim mipela long laip bilong oltaim.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.12-31.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Wasman: bilong wanpela Pop (p. 887).

sanctorale.09-16.title: Independens De Long de 16 Septemba em i de bilong tingim Independens De bilong Papua Niugini. Ol i mas kisim Pre bilong Bigin bilong Misa bilong Helpim Kantri o Ples (p. 1073) na ol arapela pre long Misa bilong Helpim ol Lain Pipel long Kamap Gutpela Moa Yet (p. 1083) na long Misa bilong Strongim Gutpela Sindaun na Stretpela Pasin (p. 1085).
sanctorale.09-16.collect:
God, yu save stiaim olgeta samting
long gutpela save na tingting bilong yu.
Mipela i pre, marimari long mipela,
na harim ol pre mipela i mekim
bilong helpim kantri (ples) bilong mipela.
Givim gutpela save long ol lida,
na gutpela pasin long ol manmeri,
bai ol i ken wok gut wantaim,
na olgeta manmeri i ken painim gutpela sindaun na bel isi.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.

entrance.text:
Sapos wanpela man o meri i gat ol samting bilong dispela graun, na em
i lukim brata bilong em i sot long ol samting, na em i no sori long brata,
orait, laikim pasin bilong God bai i stap long em olsem wanem?

sanctorale.09-16.offerings:
Lord, kisim ol dispela ofa bilong Sios bilong yu.
Marimari long ol manmeri i singaut long yu,
na harim ol pre bilong ol.
Pulapim ol long spirit bilong yu,
bai ol i ken i stap gutpela pikinini bilong yu,
na bai pasin bilong laikim ol arapela manmeri
i ken winim olgeta pasin i no stret.
Olsem na olgeta lain pipel i ken kamap wanpela famili tasol,
na sindaun gut wantaim bel isi.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Bikpela, graun i pulap long ol kaikai bilong wok bilong yu. Yu save
mekim bret na wain i kamap long graun, bai ol manmeri i ken amamas.

alt.text: Bikpela i tok olsem, “Yupela i mas askim ol samting, na God bai i givim long yupela. Yupela i mas wok long painim ol samting, na yupela bai i lukim. Yupela i mas paitim dua, na dua bai i op long yupela.”

sanctorale.09-16.postcommunion:
Lord, mipela i bin kisim strong long dispela wanpela Bret,
yu save givim long famili bilong yu.
Mipela i pre, bai dispela Sakramen bilong kamap wanbel
i ken helpim mipela long kamap gutpela moa yet,
na long bihainim laik bilong yu
long ol pasin i gutpela na i stret long ai bilong yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.
sanctorale.09-16.preface: Prefasio 5 bilong ol Sande bilong Taim bilong Yia, p. 514.
sanctorale.09-16.note: Pre bilong Bigin i kam long Misa bilong Helpim Kantri o Ples. Ol arapela pre i kam long Misa bilong Helpim ol Lain Pipel long Kamap Gutpela Moa Yet.

sanctorale.12-25.title: Karim de bilong Bikpela — Krismas

entrance.text:
Wanpela pikinini i kamap pinis namel long yumi. Em i wanpela pikinini
God i givim long yumi. Olgeta strong bai i stap oltaim wantaim em. Na
ol bai i kolim em “Man bilong bringim gutpela tingting tru.”

sanctorale.12-25.collect:
God, yu bin kamapim ol manmeri.
Na dispela wok bilong yu em i gutpela tru.
Tasol bihain ol i bin pundaun long sin,
na yu bin mekim ol i kamap nupela gen.
Na dispela wok bilong oraitim ol em i gutpela moa yet.
Krais em i God tru, na em i bin daunim em yet,
na i kisim laip bilong mipela.
Mipela i pre, bai mipela i ken pas tru wantaim em,
na kisim laip bilong God.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.12-25.offerings:
Lord, kisim dispela ofa bilong mipela,
na mekim em i kamap stret long ai bilong yu.
Long dispela de, wok bilong kisim bek mipela i kamap ples klia,
na yu givim mipela wanpela nupela ofa
i winim olgeta ofa bilong bipo.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.
sanctorale.12-25.preface: Prefasio bilong Krismas bilong Bikpela, p. 493-495.

communion.text:
Olgeta manmeri bilong olgeta hap bilong graun i lukim pinis, God
bilong yumi i kisim bek yumi.

sanctorale.12-25.postcommunion:
God bilong marimari,
Sevia bilong olgeta manmeri bilong graun i kamap tude.
Na long wok bilong em,
mipela tu i kamap pikinini bilong yu.
Mipela i pre, bai em i ken givim laip bilong oltaim long mipela.
Em i stap laip na em i King, nau na oltaim

temporale.easter-octave.sun.title: Sande namba 2 Bilong Ista

entrance.text:
Olsem ol nupela pikinini, yupela tu i mas laikim tumas long kisim
gutpela na klinpela susu i kam long God, bai em i ken helpim yupela
long kamap bikpela na strong long nupela laip, God i givim long yupela.
Aleluya.

alt.text: Yupela i mas amamas long glori bilong yupela, na yupela i mas tenkim God. Em i bin singautim yupela long kam insait long Kingdom bilong Heven. Aleluya.

temporale.easter-octave.sun.collect:
God, marimari bilong yu i stap oltaim.
Olgeta yia yu save kirapim bilip bilong pipel bilong yu
long Pestode bilong Ista.
Strongim grasia yu bin givim long mipela,
bai mipela i ken save gut, wanem kain wara i bin wasim mipela,
na wanem kain Spirit i bin mekim mipela i kamap nupela gen,
na wanem kain blut i bin kisim bek mipela.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
temporale.easter-octave.sun.offerings:
Lord, kisim dispela ofa bilong pipel bilong yu
(na bilong ol manmeri yu bin mekim kamap nupela gen).
Ol i bin kisim nupela laip long bilip na long Baptais.
Helpim ol, bai ol i ken kamap long amamas bilong oltaim.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.
temporale.easter-octave.sun.preface: Prefasio 1 bilong Ista, p. 503 (long dispela de).

communion.text:
Putim han bilong yu i kam hia, na yu lukim mak bilong ol nil. Na yu no
ken tubel long bilip. Yu mas bilip tasol. Aleluya.

temporale.easter-octave.sun.postcommunion:
God, yu strong olgeta, helpim mipela,
bai dispela Sakramen bilong Ista,
nau tasol mipela i kisim pinis,
i ken wok oltaim insait long sol bilong mipela.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

temporale.epiphany.title: Epifani bilong Bikpela

entrance.text:
Lukim! Bikpela i kam pinis. Em i bosim olgeta samting. Em i King, na
olgeta pawa na strong i stap long han bilong em.

temporale.epiphany.collect:
God, tude yu bin mekim Pikinini bilong yu
i kamap ples klia long ai bilong olgeta lain manmeri.
Lait bilong wanpela sta i bin soim rot long ol.
Mipela i pre, marimari long mipela, ol manmeri i bilip long yu.
Na helpim mipela, bai wanpela de mipela i ken lukim yu tru
long bikpela glori bilong heven.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
temporale.epiphany.offerings:
Lord, lukdaun long ol presen bilong Sios bilong yu.
Mipela i no givim gol, na insens, na gutpela sanda. Nogat.
Mipela i givim Jisas Krais yet long yu.
Long dispela ofa mipela i tokaut long nem bilong em,
na em i ofarim em yet olsem sakrifais,
bai mipela i ken kisim em.
Em i stap laip na em i King, nau na oltaim.
temporale.epiphany.preface: Prefasio bilong Epifani bilong Bikpela, p. 496.

communion.text:
Mipela i lukim sta bilong em long hap sankamap, na mipela i kam
bilong adorim Bikpela.

temporale.epiphany.postcommunion:
Lord, givim lait bilong heven long mipela,
bai oltaim mipela i ken luksave long bikpela presen
yu save givim mipela long dispela Sakramen.
Olsem na bai mipela i ken laikim dispela Sakramen moa yet,
na mipela i ken wok hat bilong kamap gutpela
inap long kisim em.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

sanctorale.01-20.sebastian.title: Santu Sebastian, Martir
sanctorale.01-20.sebastian.collect:
Lord, tude mipela i tingim Martir bilong yu Santu Sebastian.
Mipela i pre, helpim mipela tu long sanap strong long bilip,
bai mipela i no ken pret long ol man bilong graun,
na bai mipela i ken bihainim tok bilong yu tasol.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.01-20.sebastian.commonRef: Misa bilong ol Martir: bilong wanpela Martir (p. 874)

sanctorale.06-24.vigil.title: Santu Jon bilong Baptais — Misa long Vijil

entrance.text:
Em bai i gat biknem long ai bilong Bikpela, na Holi Spirit bai i pulap
long em, stat long taim em i stap long bel bilong mama yet. Na planti
manmeri bai i amamas long mama i karim em.

sanctorale.06-24.vigil.collect:
God, yu strong olgeta,
Santu Jon bilong Baptais i bin i go pas long Krais,
na em i bin givim witnes long Ridima i kam.
Mipela i pre, helpim famili bilong yu
long wokabaut long rot bilong salvesen,
bai mipela i ken kamap long Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.06-24.vigil.offerings:
Lord, lukdaun long ol presen bilong pipel bilong yu,
long Bikpela Pestode bilong Santu Jon bilong Baptais.
Nau mipela i selebretim Krais long Sakramen.
Mipela i askim yu, bai mipela i ken bihainim em gut
long wokabaut bilong mipela.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.
sanctorale.06-24.vigil.preface: bilong dispela Bikpela Pestode yet. Lukim neks Misa.

communion.text:
Yumi litimapim nem bilong Bikpela, God bilong Israel. Em i kam long
ol manmeri bilong em, na em i kisim bek ol.

sanctorale.06-24.vigil.postcommunion:
Lord, tude mipela i tingim Santu Jon bilong Baptais,
na yu bin pulapim mipela long kaikai bilong heven.
Santu Jon i bin tokaut olsem
Pikinini bilong yu em i Lem tru i tekewe olgeta sin bilong mipela.
Mipela i askim yu, bai Pikinini bilong yu
i ken harim ol pre bilong Jon, na marimari long mipela.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.
sanctorale.06-24.vigil.prefaceText:
Tru, em i gutpela na i stret,
oltaim na long olgeta ples,
mipela i tenkim yu, Lord, yu Papa na yu holi tru,
yu strong olgeta na yu God bilong oltaim.
Givim tenkyu long yu em i wok bilong mipela,
na em i kisim bek mipela,
long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.
Santu Jon bilong Baptais i bin i go pas long Krais,
bilong redim rot bilong em.
Olsem na mipela i litimapim nem bilong yu,
long wanem, yu bin makim em bilong mekim dispela wok.
Na yu bin givim biknem long em
i winim nem bilong ol arapela manmeri.

Bikpela amamas i kamap taim mama i bin karim em.
Na taim em i stap yet long bel bilong mama,
em i bin amamas na kalap,
long wanem, salvesen bilong ol manmeri klostu i laik kam.

Na namel long ol profet, Jon wanpela tasol
i bin soim Lem bilong God i kam pinis
bilong kisim bek olgeta manmeri.

Krais i bin kamapim Sakramen bilong Baptais,
tasol Jon i baptaisim em.
Na taim em i mekim olsem, wara i kamap holi.
Na bihain Jon i bin kapsaitim blut bilong em,
bilong givim witnes long Krais.

Olsem na wantaim ol strongpela Ensel bilong heven,
mipela hia long graun i litimapim nem bilong yu,
na oltaim mipela i sing (tok):

sanctorale.06-29.vigil.title: Santu Pita na Pol — Misa long Vijil

entrance.text:
Pita, hetman bilong ol Aposel, na Pol, tisa bilong ol lain pipel, tupela i
bin skulim mipela long lo bilong yu, Bikpela.

sanctorale.06-29.vigil.collect:
God, yu Bikpela bilong mipela.
Long wok bilong tupela Aposel Santu Pita na Pol,
yu bin mekim Sios bilong yu i sanap strong.
Mipela i askim yu, bai pre bilong tupela i ken strongim mipela,
na i ken helpim Sios bilong yu
long wokabaut oltaim long rot bilong laip bilong oltaim.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.06-29.vigil.offerings:
Lord, mipela i litimapim nem bilong tupela Aposel,
Santu Pita na Pol,
na mipela i bringim ol ofa i kam long alta bilong yu.
Mipela i pre, yu no ken skelim ol wok bilong mipela,
long wanem, mipela yet i no gat strong.
Tasol mekim mipela i amamas long marimari bilong yu
i save kisim bek mipela.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
“Saimon, pikinini bilong Jon, ating yu laikim mi moa long ol dispela
man, a?” “Bikpela, yu save long olgeta samting. Yu save, mi laikim yu.”

sanctorale.06-29.vigil.postcommunion:
Lord, mipela i pre,
bai dispela Sakramen bilong heven
i ken strongim ol bilipmanmeri bilong yu.
Long wanem,
ol i bin kisim lait bilong bilip long skul bilong ol Aposel.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.
sanctorale.06-29.vigil.prefaceText:
Tru, em i gutpela na i stret,
oltaim na long olgeta ples,
mipela i tenkim yu, Lord, yu Papa na yu holi tru,
yu strong olgeta na yu God bilong oltaim.
Givim tenkyu long yu em i wok bilong mipela,
na em i kisim bek mipela.

Yu mekim mipela i amamas
long tingim tupela Aposel, Santu Pita na Pol.
Pita i go pas long autim bilip long Krais.
Na Pol i tokaut long dispela bilip long ai bilong olgeta manmeri.
Pita i kirapim namba wan Sios,
namel long ol manmeri bilong Israel.
Na Pol em i bikpela tisa
i skulim ol manmeri bilong ol arapela lain.

Wan wan i gat rot bilong em yet,
tasol tupela wantaim i bin kamapim wanpela famili bilong Krais.
Tupela wantaim i bin kisim biknem long olgeta hap bilong graun.
Na tupela wantaim i bin kisim pe bilong ol Martir long heven.

Olsem na wantaim ol Santu na ol Ensel,
mipela i givim ona long yu, na oltaim mipela sing (tok):

sanctorale.08-15.vigil.title: Asunsio — Misa long Vijil

entrance.text:
Maria, ol manmeri i litimapim nem bilong yu. Tude God i bin litimapim
yu antap moa, na yu winim lain bilong ol Ensel, na yu win wantaim
Krais inap oltaim.

sanctorale.08-15.vigil.collect:
God, yu bin lukim daunpasin bilong Santu Maria Virgo,
na yu bin givim grasia long em
bilong karim Pikinini bilong yu.
Na tude yu bin litimapim em,
na yu bin givim bikpela glori long em long heven.
Mipela i askim yu, harim ol pre bilong em,
na inapim wok bilong yu bilong kisim bek mipela,
bai wanpela de yu ken kisim mipela tu i go long heven.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
sanctorale.08-15.vigil.offerings:
Lord, kisim dispela sakrifais, mipela i ofarim long yu,
bilong kamap wanbel wantaim yu,
na bilong litimapim nem bilong yu.
Tude mipela i tingim Asunsio bilong Santu Maria,
em i Mama bilong God.
Mipela i pre, marimari long mipela,
na helpim mipela long tok tenkyu oltaim long yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.
sanctorale.08-15.vigil.preface: bilong dispela Bikpela Pestode yet. Lukim neks Misa.

communion.text:
Maria Virgo, yu ken amamas. Long wanem, long bel bilong yu, yu bin
karim Pikinini bilong God Papa i stap oltaim.

sanctorale.08-15.vigil.postcommunion:
God, yu Bikpela bilong mipela.
Long dispela de bilong onarim Asunsio bilong Santu Maria,
em i Mama bilong God, mipela i bin kisim kaikai bilong heven
long tebol bilong yu.
Mipela i pre, marimari long mipela,
na tekewe olgeta samting nogut long mipela.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.
sanctorale.08-15.vigil.prefaceText:
Tru, em i gutpela na i stret,
oltaim na long olgeta ples,
mipela i tenkim yu, Lord, yu Papa na yu holi tru,
yu strong olgeta na yu God bilong oltaim.
Givim tenkyu long yu em i wok bilong mipela,
na em i kisim bek mipela,
long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

Tude mipela i tingim Santu Maria Virgo,
em i Mama bilong God,
na God yet i bin kisim em i go long heven.
Olsem na Maria i kamap piksa bilong Sios i holi olgeta
na i stap wan wantaim God.
Asunsio bilong Maria i save givim hop na bel isi
long pipel bilong yu i wokabaut yet long dispela graun,
na i wet long kisim nupela laip.

God Papa, yu no bin larim bodi bilong Santu Maria
i bagarap long matmat. Nogat.
Long wanem, Pikinini bilong yu i bin kamap man
insait long bel bilong Maria,
na Pikinini bilong yu i save givim laip long olgeta samting.

Olsem na wantaim ol Ensel,
mipela i amamas long litimapim nem bilong yu,
na mipela i sing (tok):

temporale.immaculate-heart.title: Hat bilong Santu Maria Virgo i no gat sin

entrance.text: Hat bilong mi bai i amamas long salvesen i kam long yu. Na bai mi singim song long Bikpela, long wanem, em i bin mekim gut tru long mi.

temporale.immaculate-heart.collect:
God, long Hat bilong Santu Maria Virgo,
yu bin redim wanpela gutpela ples,
bai Holi Spirit i ken i stap long em.
Mipela i askim yu, bai pre bilong Santu Maria
i ken helpim mipela long kamap tempel bilong glori bilong yu.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
temporale.immaculate-heart.offerings:
Lord, lukdaun long ol pre na ofa
bilong ol bilipmanmeri bilong yu,
long dispela de bilong tingim Santu Maria,
em i Mama bilong God.
Mipela i pre, bai dispela ofa i ken kamap stret long ai bilong yu,
na long strong bilong em, yu ken marimari long mipela,
na helpim mipela.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.
temporale.immaculate-heart.preface: Prefasio 1 bilong Santu Maria Virgo (long Pestode), p. 520. O Prefasio 2 bilong Santu Maria Virgo, p. 521.

communion.text: Maria i putim olgeta dispela tok long bel bilong em, na em i tingim i stap.

temporale.immaculate-heart.postcommunion:
Lord, tude mipela i tingim Mama bilong Pikinini bilong yu,
na mipela i bin kisim dispela Sakramen
i save givim laip bilong oltaim.
Mipela i pre, bai mipela i ken amamas oltaim
long grasia bilong yu,
na dispela grasia i ken gro insait long mipela,
na i ken helpim mipela long kisim laip bilong oltaim.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

PREFASIO 1 BILONG ATVEN.title: Prefasio 1 Bilong Atven
PREFASIO 1 BILONG ATVEN.subtitle: Krais i kam tupela taim long graun
PREFASIO 1 BILONG ATVEN.text:
Tru, em i gutpela na i stret,
oltaim na long olgeta ples,
mipela i tenkim yu, Lord, yu Papa na yu holi tru,
yu strong olgeta na yu God bilong oltaim.
Givim tenkyu long yu em i wok bilong mipela,
na em i kisim bek mipela,
long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

Long namba wan taim Krais i bin kam,
em i daunim em yet, na em i kamap man.
Em inapim promis bilong yu bilong bipo, na em i opim rot,
bai mipela i ken kisim laip i stap gut oltaim.

Long namba 2 taim Krais bai i kam bek gen
wantaim bikpela glori na strong bilong em,
na olgeta samting bai i kamap ples klia.
Na long dispela de, mipela bai inap kisim ol gutpela samting,
em i bin promis long mipela, ol manmeri i hop long em.

Olsem na wantaim ol Ensel na ol Akensel,
wantaim ol Tron na ol Dominion,
na wantaim olgeta strongpela lain bilong heven,
mipela i singim song bilong givim glori long yu,
na oltaim mipela i sing (tok):

PREFASIO 2 BILONG ATVEN.title: Prefasio 2 Bilong Atven
PREFASIO 2 BILONG ATVEN.subtitle: Krais i kam pinis, na yumi hop em bai i kam bek gen
PREFASIO 2 BILONG ATVEN.text:
Tru, em i gutpela na i stret,
oltaim na long olgeta ples,
mipela i tenkim yu, Lord, yu Papa na yu holi tru,
yu strong olgeta na yu God bilong oltaim.
Givim tenkyu long yu em i wok bilong mipela,
na em i kisim bek mipela,
long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

Ol profet bilong bipo i bin tok olsem, em bai i kam.
Maria Virgo, em i gutpela Mama, i wetim em,
wantaim bikpela laik.
Jon bilong Baptais i tok, Ridima bai i kam klostu.
Na taim Krais i kam, Jon i tokaut olsem, em i kam pinis.

Olsem na mipela i amamas long misteri bilong Krismas,
na mipela i laik redim mipela yet,
bai em i ken painim mipela i was na pre i stap,
na bai mipela i ken amamas long litimapim nem bilong em.

Olsem na wantaim ol Ensel na ol Akensel,
wantaim ol Tron na ol Dominion,
na wantaim olgeta strongpela lain bilong heven,
mipela i singim song bilong givim glori long yu,
na oltaim mipela i sing (tok):

PREFASIO 1 BILONG KRISMAS BILONG BIKPELA.title: Prefasio 1 Bilong Krismas Bilong Bikpela
PREFASIO 1 BILONG KRISMAS BILONG BIKPELA.subtitle: Krais em i lait
PREFASIO 1 BILONG KRISMAS BILONG BIKPELA.text:
Tru, em i gutpela na i stret,
oltaim na long olgeta ples,
mipela i tenkim yu, Lord, yu Papa na yu holi tru,
yu strong olgeta na yu God bilong oltaim.
Givim tenkyu long yu em i wok bilong mipela,
na em i kisim bek mipela.

Long misteri bilong Tok bilong yu i kamap man,
yu bin soim nupela lait bilong glori bilong yu long mipela.
Na taim mipela i lukim Krais,
mipela inap lukim God long ai bilong mipela,
olsem na mipela i mangal long ol samting bilong heven,
em ol samting mipela i no inap lukim long ai bilong mipela.

Olsem na wantaim ol Ensel na ol Akensel,
wantaim ol Tron na ol Dominion,
na wantaim olgeta strongpela lain bilong heven,
mipela i singim song bilong givim glori long yu,
na oltaim mipela i sing (tok):

PREFASIO 2 BILONG KRISMAS BILONG BIKPELA.title: Prefasio 2 Bilong Krismas Bilong Bikpela
PREFASIO 2 BILONG KRISMAS BILONG BIKPELA.subtitle: God i kamap man, na olgeta samting i kamap nupela gen
